}
.ecp-wait-sub {
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
  font: 400 11px/1.3 "Malgun Gothic", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
.event-command-comment-body {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.m2-command-body {
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.weighted-branch-command-body {
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.weighted-branch-help {
  margin: 0;
}
.weighted-branch-field {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.weighted-branch-label {
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
  font: 600 12px/1.3 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
.weighted-branch-variable-warn {
  color: var(--text-1);
  font: 500 11px/1.45 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  margin: 0;
}
.weighted-branch-rows {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.weighted-branch-row {
  align-items: center;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-raised, #FFFDF8) 92%, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 8%);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(42,37,33,.12));
  border-radius: 10px;
  display: grid !important;
  gap: 8px;
  grid-template-columns: 42px minmax(0, 1.4fr) 72px 56px 36px !important;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 8px;
}
.weighted-branch-index {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-surface) 80%, var(--bg-surface) 20%);
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: var(--text-1);
  display: grid;
  font: 700 11px/1 "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;
  height: 24px;
  place-items: center;
  width: 34px;
}
.weighted-branch-index.is-inactive {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-raised, #FFFDF8) 70%, var(--text-3, #6B5F52) 30%);

}
.weighted-branch-label-input,
.weighted-branch-weight-input {
  background: var(--event-popup-field, var(--bg-raised, #EFE9DC));
  border: 1px solid var(--border-soft, var(--border-subtle, rgba(42,37,33,.20)));
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
  font: 500 12px/1.3 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 7px 8px;
  width: 100%;
}
.weighted-branch-weight-input {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  text-align: center;
}
.weighted-branch-pct {
  color: var(--text-1);
  font: 700 12px/1 "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;
  text-align: right;
}
.weighted-branch-remove {
  min-width: 32px;
  padding-inline: 0;
}
.weighted-branch-add {
  border-style: dashed;
  justify-self: stretch;
  width: 100%;
}
.weighted-branch-bar {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-raised, #FFFDF8) 80%, rgba(42,37,33,.12));
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(42,37,33,.12));
  border-radius: 999px;
  display: flex;
  height: 16px;
  overflow: hidden;
  width: 100%;
}
.weighted-branch-bar-seg {
  min-width: 0;
}
.weighted-branch-bar-empty {
  margin: 0;
}
.weighted-branch-legend {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px 12px;
}
.weighted-branch-legend-item {
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--text-2, #6B5F52);
  display: inline-flex;
  font: 500 11px/1.35 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  gap: 6px;
}
.weighted-branch-legend-swatch {
  border-radius: 3px;
  display: inline-block;
  height: 10px;
  width: 10px;
}
.weighted-branch-guide {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-raised, #FFFDF8) 86%, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 14%);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border-subtle, rgba(42,37,33,.12)) 65%, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 35%);
  border-radius: 10px;
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
}
.weighted-branch-guide strong {
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
  font: 700 12px/1.3 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
.weighted-branch-guide p {
  color: var(--text-2, #6B5F52);
  font: 500 12px/1.5 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  margin: 0;
}
.weighted-branch-guide-list {
  color: var(--text-2, #6B5F52);
  display: grid;
  font: 500 12px/1.5 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  gap: 4px;
  margin: 0;
  padding-left: 1.15em;
}
.weighted-branch-summary-live {
  margin: 0;
}
.m2-command-intent-card {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-raised, #FFFDF8) 88%, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 12%);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border-subtle, rgba(42,37,33,.12)) 70%, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 30%);
  border-radius: 8px;
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
}
.m2-command-intent-title {
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
  font: 700 12px/1.35 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
.m2-command-intent-body {
  color: var(--text-2, #6B5F52);
  font: 500 12px/1.5 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  margin: 0;
}
.m2-command-intent-list {
  color: var(--text-2, #6B5F52);
  display: grid;
  font: 500 12px/1.45 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  gap: 4px;
  margin: 0;
  padding-left: 1.15em;
}
.m2-command-intent-list li {
  margin: 0;
}
.m2-command-no-params {
  margin: 0;
}
.event-command-comment-textarea {
  min-height: 110px;
  resize: vertical;
  width: 100%;
}
.event-command-comment-preview-wrap {
  display: grid;
  gap: 4px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-command-comment-preview {
  border: 1px solid var(--border-soft, var(--border-subtle));
  border-radius: 6px;
  font: 600 13px/1.4 "Malgun Gothic", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  min-height: 36px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  word-break: keep-all;
}
.event-command-comment-preview[data-comment-color="green"],
.cmd-item-comment[data-comment-color="green"] .cmd-kind {
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.event-command-comment-preview[data-comment-color="yellow"],
.cmd-item-comment[data-comment-color="yellow"] .cmd-kind {
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.event-command-comment-preview[data-comment-color="cyan"],
.cmd-item-comment[data-comment-color="cyan"] .cmd-kind {
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.event-command-comment-preview[data-comment-color="pink"],
.cmd-item-comment[data-comment-color="pink"] .cmd-kind {
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.event-command-comment-preview[data-comment-color="gray"],
.cmd-item-comment[data-comment-color="gray"] .cmd-kind {
  color: var(--text-2);
}
.event-command-comment-preview[data-comment-color="white"],
.cmd-item-comment[data-comment-color="white"] .cmd-kind {
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.cmd-item-comment > .cmd-head {
  font-style: italic;
  opacity: 0.95;
}
.event-command-context-menu {
  background: var(--event-rm-chrome, var(--bg-raised));
  border-color: var(--event-rm-light, var(--border-subtle)) var(--event-rm-shadow, rgba(42,37,33,.20)) var(--event-rm-shadow, rgba(42,37,33,.20)) var(--event-rm-light, var(--border-subtle));
  border-style: solid;
  border-width: 1px;
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 2px var(--shadow-pop);
  display: grid;
  font: 400 14px/20px "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
  min-width: 214px;
  padding: 2px;
  position: fixed;
  z-index: var(--z-popover-top);
}
.event-command-context-menu button {
  align-items: center;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  color: var(--event-rm-text, var(--text-1));
  display: grid;
  font: inherit;
  grid-template-columns: 22px minmax(78px, 1fr) 64px;
  min-height: 24px;
  padding: 1px 8px 1px 2px;
  text-align: left;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.event-command-context-menu button:hover,
.event-command-context-menu button:focus {
  background: var(--oprn-command-selected, var(--accent));
  color: var(--text-inverse, var(--text-1));
  outline: 0;
}
.event-command-context-menu button:disabled {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--event-rm-disabled, var(--text-2));
}
.event-command-menu-label,
.event-command-menu-shortcut {
  line-height: 20px;
}
.event-command-menu-shortcut {
  justify-self: end;
}
.event-command-menu-separator {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--event-rm-mid, var(--border-default));
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--event-rm-light, var(--border-subtle));
  height: 0;
  margin: 3px 4px;
}
.event-command-menu-icon {
  height: 16px;
  justify-self: center;
  position: relative;
  width: 16px;
}
.event-command-context-menu button:disabled .event-command-menu-icon {
  opacity: 0.35;
}
.event-command-menu-icon.insert::before {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--border-subtle);
  content: "";
  height: 12px;
  left: 2px;
  position: absolute;
  top: 2px;
  width: 12px;
}
.event-command-menu-icon.insert::after {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  content: "";
  height: 2px;
  left: 5px;
  position: absolute;
  top: 7px;
  width: 7px;
}
.event-command-menu-icon.edit::before,
.event-command-menu-icon.copy::before,
.event-command-menu-icon.copy::after,
.event-command-menu-icon.paste::before {
  background: var(--bg-raised);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
}
.event-command-menu-icon.edit::before {
  height: 12px;
  left: 2px;
  top: 2px;
  width: 10px;
}
.event-command-menu-icon.edit::after {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent) 0 45%, #E8D9A8 45% 70%, var(--bg-inset) 70%);
  content: "";
  height: 9px;
  left: 7px;
  position: absolute;
  top: 6px;
  transform: rotate(-35deg);
  width: 3px;
}
.event-command-menu-icon.cut::before,
.event-command-menu-icon.cut::after {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  content: "";
  height: 13px;
  left: 7px;
  position: absolute;
  top: 1px;
  width: 2px;
}
.event-command-menu-icon.cut::before {
  transform: rotate(38deg);
}
.event-command-menu-icon.cut::after {
  transform: rotate(-38deg);
}
.event-command-menu-icon.copy::before {
  height: 10px;
  left: 5px;
  top: 2px;
  width: 8px;
}
.event-command-menu-icon.copy::after {
  height: 10px;
  left: 2px;
  top: 5px;
  width: 8px;
}
.event-command-menu-icon.paste::before {
  height: 11px;
  left: 3px;
  top: 4px;
  width: 10px;
}
.event-command-menu-icon.paste::after {
  background: var(--bg-overlay);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  content: "";
  height: 4px;
  left: 5px;
  position: absolute;
  top: 1px;
  width: 6px;
}
.event-command-menu-icon.delete::before,
.event-command-menu-icon.delete::after {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  content: "";
  height: 17px;
  left: 7px;
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  width: 3px;
}
.event-command-menu-icon.delete::before {
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}
.event-command-menu-icon.delete::after {
  transform: rotate(-45deg);
}
.event-command-menu-icon.select-all::before {
  background: var(--bg-raised);
  border: 1px dotted var(--border-default);
  content: "";
  height: 13px;
  left: 1px;
  position: absolute;
  top: 1px;
  width: 13px;
}
.event-page-props {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  min-height: 0;
}
.event-conditions-grid,
.event-condition-row,
.event-page-movement,
.event-page-movement-basics {
  gap: 3px;
}
.event-conditions-grid {
  display: grid;
}
/* 조건 칩 팔레트 — 종류는 늘 다 보이고, 켠 것만 아래 목록에 행으로 내려간다.
   토큰만 쓴다(하드코딩 색 금지, TOKENS.md §4.1). */
.event-condition-palette {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 3px;
  padding-bottom: 3px;
}
.event-condition-chip {
  appearance: none;
  background: var(--bg-raised);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: var(--text-2);
  cursor: pointer;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  padding: 1px 8px;
}
.event-condition-chip:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.event-condition-chip:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 1px;
}
.event-condition-chip.active {
  background: var(--accent-muted);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
}
.event-condition-list {
  display: grid;
  gap: 3px;
}
.event-condition-empty {
  color: var(--text-3);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 2px 0 3px;
}
.event-editor-modal-body [data-testid="event-classic-conditions"].event-oprn-fieldset {
  padding: 4px 5px 3px;
}
.event-editor-modal-body [data-testid="event-classic-conditions"] .event-conditions-grid {
  gap: 3px;
}
.event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-row {
  align-items: center;
  column-gap: 6px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 14px 4.5rem minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  justify-content: start;
  min-height: 22px;
  min-width: 0;
  row-gap: 0;
}
.event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-control {
  align-items: center;
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px 4px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-control.record {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-control.variable {
  gap: 4px;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.event-condition-main {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.event-condition-id-picker {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 22px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-condition-threshold {
  display: grid;
  gap: 4px;
  grid-template-columns: 64px 48px;
  justify-content: start;
}
.event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-control.timer {
  grid-template-columns: 36px max-content 36px max-content;
  justify-content: start;
}
.event-condition-time-unit {
  font: 700 12px/16px "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
}
.event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-control input,
.event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-control select {
  font: 400 12px/16px "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
  height: 20px;
  min-height: 20px;
  min-width: 0;
  padding-block: 0;
  width: 100%;
}
.event-condition-id-picker .btn.small {
  font: 700 11px/16px "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
  min-height: 20px;
  min-width: 22px;
  padding-inline: 0;
}
.event-condition-label,
.event-condition-suffix,
.event-editor-modal-body label {
  color: var(--event-rm-text);
  font: 700 12px/16px "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
}
.event-condition-row > input[type="checkbox"] {
  height: 12px;
  margin: 0;
  width: 12px;
}
.event-condition-row.disabled .event-condition-label,
.event-condition-row.disabled .event-condition-suffix {
  color: var(--event-rm-disabled);
}
.event-advanced-conditions {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--event-rm-mid);
  margin-top: 3px;
  padding-top: 3px;
}
.event-advanced-conditions > summary {
  color: var(--event-rm-text);
  cursor: pointer;
  font: 700 12px/16px "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
  list-style-position: inside;
  outline-offset: 2px;
  width: max-content;
}
.event-advanced-conditions > summary:focus-visible {
  outline: 1px dotted var(--accent);
}
.event-advanced-condition-list {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.event-advanced-condition-row {
  align-items: center;
  display: grid;
  gap: 3px;
  grid-template-columns: 76px minmax(0, 1fr) 46px;
  max-width: 520px;
  min-height: 20px;
}
.event-advanced-condition-control {
  display: grid;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-advanced-condition-control.variable {
  gap: 3px;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 86px 48px;
}
.event-advanced-condition-control.timer {
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
  grid-template-columns: 78px 42px max-content 42px max-content;
  justify-content: start;
}
.event-advanced-condition-row input,
.event-advanced-condition-row select,
.event-advanced-condition-add select {
  font: 400 12px/16px "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
  height: 20px;
  min-height: 20px;
  min-width: 0;
  padding-block: 0;
  width: 100%;
}
.event-advanced-condition-empty {
  color: var(--event-rm-disabled);
  font: 700 12px/16px "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
}
.event-advanced-condition-add {
  display: grid;
  gap: 3px;
  grid-template-columns: 98px 66px;
  margin-top: 3px;
}
.event-advanced-condition-row .btn.small,
.event-advanced-condition-add .btn.small {
  font: 700 11px/16px "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
  min-height: 20px;
  padding-inline: 5px;
}
.event-graphic-control {
  align-items: center;
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px 10px;
  grid-template-columns: 58px minmax(0, 1fr);
  min-height: 66px;
}
/* 몸 크기와 통행 행 — 2차 스펙 §5. */
.event-footprint-control {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}
.event-footprint-body {
  align-items: end;
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px 10px;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
}
.event-footprint-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px 10px;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
}
/* 몸 사각 격자 + 실제 배율 스프라이트. 통행 행만 진하게 칠해 "발밑 한 줄만 막힘" 을 보인다. */
.event-footprint-preview-host {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-footprint-preview {
  flex: none;
  position: relative;
}
.event-footprint-preview-grid {
  display: grid;
  position: absolute;
}
.event-footprint-preview-cell {
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentcolor 26%, transparent);
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.event-footprint-preview-cell[data-pass="true"] {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, currentcolor 22%, transparent);
}
.event-footprint-preview-cell[data-anchor="true"] {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, currentcolor 62%, transparent);
}
.event-footprint-preview-sprite {
  image-rendering: pixelated;
  position: absolute;
}
.event-footprint-field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-footprint-field > span {
  font-size: 11px;
  opacity: 0.85;
}
.event-footprint-field input {
  min-width: 0;
  width: 100%;
}
.event-footprint-summary {
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  margin: 0;
  opacity: 0.85;
}
.event-footprint-scale {
  align-items: end;
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px 10px;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 96px;
}
.event-footprint-scale-manual {
  align-items: center;
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 5px;
  min-height: 20px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.event-footprint-control input:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
}
.event-graphic-preview {
  align-self: center;
  background: var(--event-rm-field);
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  border-color: var(--event-rm-mid) var(--event-rm-light) var(--event-rm-light) var(--event-rm-mid);

/* fork RM rhythm: condition-only dialog */

}

.event-condition-eval-summary {

}
.event-condition-eval-note {

.event-condition-group {

.event-condition-group-item {

.event-condition-group-item-title {

.event-condition-group-list {

}
.event-condition-error,
.event-condition-warning,
.event-command-variable-error,

.event-condition-error,
.event-command-variable-error {

}
.event-condition-warning,
.event-command-variable-warning {

}
.event-loop-empty-warning,
.event-loop-no-break-warning {

}
.event-loop-break-badge {

}

/* 묶음 조건(all/any/not) 편집기와 겹침·통행 안내문.
 * 이 블록은 233px 좌측 레일 폭에서 실측하고 맞췄다 — 고정 px 컬럼을 되돌리면
 * select 라벨과 버튼 글자가 잘린다(«조건 추가» → «건 추가»). */
/* 고정 98px/66px 이라 버튼 글자가 잘렸다. 라벨 길이에 맞춰 준다. */
.event-advanced-condition-add {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
}
.event-advanced-condition-group {
  border: 1px solid var(--event-rm-mid);
  display: grid;
  gap: 3px;
  max-width: 520px;
  padding: 3px;
}
/* 1행: 종류 select + 삭제. 2행: 사람이 읽는 요약(폭이 좁아 같은 줄에 못 둔다). */
.event-advanced-condition-group-head {
  align-items: center;
  display: grid;
  gap: 3px;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
}
.event-advanced-condition-group-head > select {
  font: 400 12px/16px "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
  grid-area: 1 / 1;
  height: 20px;
  min-width: 0;
  width: 100%;
}
.event-advanced-condition-group-head > .btn {
  grid-area: 1 / 2;
}
.event-advanced-condition-group-head > .event-advanced-condition-summary {
  color: var(--event-rm-text);
  font: 700 12px/16px "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
  grid-area: 2 / 1 / 3 / 3;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
/* 하위 조건은 얕은 들여쓰기 + 좌측 선으로 소속을 보인다(깊게 넣으면 컨트롤이 찌그러진다). */
.event-advanced-condition-children {
  border-left: 2px solid var(--event-rm-light);
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  margin-left: 4px;
  padding-left: 5px;
}
.event-advanced-condition-children .event-advanced-condition-row {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 90px) minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
}
.event-advanced-condition-group .event-advanced-condition-add {
  margin-left: 9px;
  margin-top: 0;
}
.event-page-overlap-hint {
  color: var(--event-rm-text);
  font: 400 12px/16px "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 16px;
}
.event-page-overlap-hint.is-quiet {
  color: var(--event-rm-disabled);
}
/* 분할 목차 — 아래 @import 순서가 캐스케이드(규칙 순서)를 결정하므로 재배열 금지. */
.event-editor-modal-backdrop,
.event-editor-modal-backdrop.event-editor-modal-backdrop {
  align-content: stretch;
  align-items: stretch;
  background: var(--bg-scrim);
  backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
  display: grid;
  inset: 0;
  justify-content: stretch;
  justify-items: stretch;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 12px;
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 1000;
}
body.event-editor-modal-open {
  overflow: hidden;
}
body.event-editor-modal-open .coach-mark-card {
  display: none;
}
.event-editor-modal-window {
  --event-modern-accent: var(--accent);
  --event-modern-accent-soft: var(--accent-muted);
  --event-modern-border: var(--border-subtle);
  --event-modern-border-strong: var(--border-strong);
  --event-modern-card: var(--bg-raised);
  --event-modern-field: var(--bg-inset);
  --event-modern-field-muted: var(--bg-surface);
  --event-modern-line: var(--border-default);
  --event-modern-success: var(--success);
  --event-modern-text: var(--text-1);
  --event-modern-text-soft: var(--text-2);

  border-radius: 10px;
  box-shadow: 0 16px 48px var(--shadow-pop), 0 1px 0 var(--shadow-pop) inset;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  color: var(--event-modern-text);
  display: grid;
  font-family: var(--font-ui);
  grid-template-rows: 52px minmax(0, 1fr) 44px;
  height: min(88dvh, 820px);
  max-height: calc(100dvh - 80px);
  max-width: min(1080px, calc(100vw - 80px));
  width: min(1080px, calc(100vw - 80px));
  place-self: center;
}
.event-editor-modal-header {

.event-editor-modal-header h2 {

.event-editor-window-eyebrow {

.event-editor-modal-header > .event-editor-window-controls,

.event-editor-modal-body {

.event-editor-modal-window,

.event-character-social-extras {

.event-editor-name-field input,
.event-editor-modal-body input,
.event-editor-modal-body select,

.event-editor-modal-body select:focus-visible,
.event-editor-modal-body textarea:focus-visible {

.event-editor-name-field input {

.event-editor-modal-body input[type="checkbox"] {

.event-page-tabs {

.event-classic-marker {

.event-page-action-buttons {

.event-page-number-tabs .btn,
.event-editor-modal-footer .btn {

  background: var(--bg-raised);

.event-page-action-buttons .btn:focus-visible,
.event-page-number-tabs .btn:focus-visible,

.event-page-action-buttons .btn.disabled {

.event-editor-workbench {

.event-editor-column-resizer.dragging::before {

.event-editor-settings-main {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  min-height: 0;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: auto;
  padding-right: 4px;
  scrollbar-gutter: stable;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
}
.event-editor-settings-main .event-page-props {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  max-width: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  overflow-y: auto;
}
.event-page-number-tabs {
  align-content: start;
  align-items: stretch;
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  grid-row: 1 / -1;
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: auto;
  padding: 0 0 4px;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
}
.event-page-number-tabs .btn {
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--event-modern-accent);
  font-size: 16px;
  height: auto;
  min-height: 52px;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 0;
  width: 100%;
}
/* 리치 페이지 탭: 캐릭터 그래픽 fill + 하단 번호 overlay (세부 스타일은 p1-pagetabs) */
.event-page-number-tabs .btn.event-page-tab-rich {
  min-height: 72px;
}
.event-page-number-tabs .event-page-tab-add {
  align-items: center;
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px dashed var(--event-modern-border);
  color: var(--event-modern-text-soft);
  display: flex;
  font: 500 22px/1 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 40px;
}
.event-page-number-tabs .event-page-tab-add:hover {
  background: var(--event-modern-accent-soft);
  border-color: var(--event-modern-accent);
  border-style: solid;
  color: var(--event-modern-accent);
}
.event-page-number-tabs .btn.active {
  background: var(--event-modern-accent-soft);
  border-color: var(--event-modern-accent);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--event-modern-accent) 35%, transparent);
}
/* 조건 접이식 — 기본 펼침(RM), 메타로 활성 개수만 표시 */
.event-collapsible-section {
  padding-top: 10px;
}
.event-collapsible-summary {
  align-items: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  justify-content: space-between;
  list-style: none;
  min-height: 26px;
  user-select: none;
}
.event-collapsible-summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}
.event-collapsible-summary::before {
  color: var(--event-modern-text-soft);
  content: "▸";
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1;
  transition: transform 0.12s ease;
  width: 10px;
}
.event-collapsible-section[open] > .event-collapsible-summary::before {
  transform: rotate(90deg);
}
.event-collapsible-title {
  color: var(--text-1);
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  font: 700 13px/1.2 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
.event-collapsible-meta {
  background: var(--event-modern-field);
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: var(--event-modern-text-soft);
  font: 600 11px/1 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.event-collapsible-body {
  margin-top: 10px;
}
.event-page-props {
  align-content: start;
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  /* auto 행은 overflow:hidden 인 필드셋의 자동 최소 크기가 0이라
     컨테이너가 좁을 때 내용보다 줄어든다(레일 겹침). min-content 로 고정. */
  grid-auto-rows: min-content;
  max-width: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding-right: 0;
}
.event-oprn-fieldset {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-raised) 92%, var(--event-modern-field));
  border: 1px solid var(--event-modern-border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: none;
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  /* 고정 패널만 가로 넘침 차단. details 접이식(조건)은 콘텐츠 높이가 잘리면 안 됨 */
  overflow-x: hidden;
  overflow-y: visible;
  padding: 12px 14px;
}
.event-oprn-fieldset.event-collapsible-section {
  /* 조건 접이식: 요약+본문이 자연 높이로 펼쳐지도록 */
  overflow: visible;
}
.event-oprn-fieldset legend {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-1);
  font: 700 13px/1.2 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  padding: 0 0 6px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.event-conditions-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 5px;
}
/* RM 조건 한 줄: [✓] 라벨 | 컨트롤 | 접미어 */
.event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-row {
  align-items: center;
  column-gap: 8px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 16px 4.75rem minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  max-width: 100%;
  min-height: 26px;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 1px 0;
  row-gap: 0;
}
.event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-row.disabled {
  opacity: 0.7;
}
.event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-row > input[type="checkbox"] {
  height: 14px;
  justify-self: center;
  margin: 0;
  width: 14px;
}
.event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-label {
  color: var(--event-modern-text);
  font: 700 12px/1.2 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-suffix {
  color: var(--event-modern-text-soft);
  font: 600 12px/1.2 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  justify-self: end;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-row.disabled .event-condition-label,
.event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-row.disabled .event-condition-suffix {
  color: var(--event-modern-text-soft);
}
.event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-control {
  align-items: center;
  display: grid;
  max-width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-control.switch,
.event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-control.record,
.event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-control.time-phase,
.event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-control.season,
.event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-control.npc-activity,
.event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-control.friendship {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-control.variable {
  gap: 4px;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-control.timer {
  column-gap: 4px;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(28px, 40px) auto minmax(28px, 40px) auto;
  justify-content: start;
}
.event-condition-id-picker {
  align-items: center;
  display: grid;
  gap: 4px;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 28px;
  max-width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-condition-id-picker .btn.small {
  min-height: 26px;
  min-width: 28px;
  padding: 0;
}
.event-condition-threshold {
  align-items: center;
  display: grid;
  gap: 4px;
  grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0, 72px);
  max-width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-condition-time-unit {
  color: var(--event-modern-text-soft);
  font: 600 11px/1 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.event-condition-suffix {
  color: var(--event-modern-text-soft);
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  max-width: 6.5em;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-align: left;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.event-condition-control select,
.event-condition-control input {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  max-width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  width: 100%;
}
.event-graphic-control {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px 10px;
  grid-template-columns: 72px minmax(0, 1fr);
  max-width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-graphic-control input[data-testid="event-page-sprite-input"] {
  display: none;
}
.event-graphic-control .btn {
  max-width: 100%;
  min-height: 34px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-priority-block,
.event-overlap-label {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
}
.event-overlap-label {
  align-items: center;
  grid-template-columns: 18px minmax(0, 1fr);
  font: 600 13px/1.2 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
.event-editor-commands-column {
  background: transparent;
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  /* 실행 내용 최소 높이 확보 + aux 는 auto 행만 (cmd-list 비고갈) */
  grid-template-rows: minmax(220px, 1fr) auto;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}
/* 실행 내용: 툴바 한 줄, 리스트가 나머지 높이를 채움 */
.event-contents-fieldset {
  align-content: start;
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  min-height: 220px;
  padding: 12px 12px 10px;
}
.event-contents-fieldset > .event-contents-legend,
.event-contents-fieldset > legend {
  align-self: center;
  color: var(--text-1);
  float: none;
  font: 700 14px/1.2 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  grid-column: 1;
  grid-row: 1;
  padding: 0;
  width: auto;
}
.event-contents-fieldset > .event-editor-command-toolbar {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  grid-column: 2;
  grid-row: 1;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  min-height: 32px;
  position: static;
  right: auto;
  top: auto;
  z-index: 1;
}
.event-contents-fieldset > .cmd-list {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  grid-row: 2;
  min-height: 0;
}
/* 1024x768 에서 툴바가 열 밖으로 새지 않게 한다.
 * 왜 이렇게 무거운 선택자인가: event-editor.mockup.css / .balanced.css 가 이 파일보다
 * 나중에 로드되면서 같은 (0,2,0)~(0,3,0) 규칙으로 justify-content: flex-end · 고정 32px 행을
 * 잡는다. flex-end + 줄바꿈 없음이면 넘친 폭이 왼쪽으로 밀려 [+ 명령] 이 열 밖에서 잘렸다.
 * 그래서 한 단계 높은 특이성으로 줄바꿈 행 + 자동 높이 행을 확정한다. */
.event-editor .event-contents-fieldset.event-oprn-fieldset {
  /* 툴바가 두 줄이 되면 행이 같이 자란다 — 고정 32px 는 목록 위로 겹쳐 흘렀다. */
  grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.event-editor .event-contents-fieldset > .toolbar.event-editor-command-toolbar {
  align-content: center;
  column-gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  min-width: 0;
  /* 마지막 보조 버튼이 명령 컬럼 오른쪽 경계에 닿아 있었다(실측 1439 vs 컬럼 1440).
     컬럼 안쪽으로 10px 들여 액션 줄의 끝을 분명히 만든다. */
  padding-right: 10px;
  row-gap: 6px;
}
/* 1순위 액션은 항상 첫 칸에서 라벨 폭을 온전히 지킨다. */
.event-editor .event-contents-fieldset > .toolbar.event-editor-command-toolbar
  > [data-testid="event-command-toolbar-add"] {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
/* 남는 폭은 검색이 흡수한다 — 줄바꿈 전에 먼저 줄어드는 유일한 컨트롤.
   단 320px 이상으로는 늘지 않는다: 1440px 에서 423px 까지 부풀어 툴바가 검색 상자로
   읽혔다. 이 줄의 주인공은 검색이 아니라 왼쪽 액션들이다. */
.event-editor .event-contents-fieldset > .toolbar.event-editor-command-toolbar
  > .event-editor-command-search {
  flex: 1 1 140px;
  max-width: 320px;
  min-width: 96px;
  width: auto;
}
.event-editor-command-tool-group {
  align-items: center;
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 3px;
}
.event-editor-command-tool-group + .event-editor-command-tool-group,
.event-editor-command-tool-group + .event-editor-command-tool {
  border-left: 1px solid var(--event-modern-border);
  margin-left: 2px;
  padding-left: 8px;
}
.event-editor-command-tool {
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--event-modern-field);
  border: 1px solid var(--event-modern-border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  color: var(--text-1);
  display: inline-flex;
  font: 600 16px/1 "Segoe UI Symbol", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  height: 30px;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 32px;
  padding: 0;
  transition: border-color 0.12s ease, background 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease;
}
.event-editor-command-tool:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: var(--bg-hover, var(--bg-raised));
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--event-modern-accent) 45%, var(--event-modern-border));
}
.event-editor-command-tool:focus-visible {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--event-modern-accent) 22%, transparent);
  outline: none;
}
.event-editor-command-tool.primary {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--event-modern-accent) 18%, var(--bg-raised));
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--event-modern-accent) 55%, var(--event-modern-border));
  color: var(--event-modern-accent);
  font-weight: 700;
  min-width: 36px;
}
.event-editor-command-tool:disabled {
  color: var(--text-3);
  opacity: 0.55;
}
/* 툴바 도구 팝오버 안의 기능 칩. 본문도 오버레이로 열어 캔버스 기하를 유지한다.
   AI 작성기는 여기 살지 않는다 — 명령 칼럼 맨 아래 인플로우 도크다(event-editor-ai.css). */
.event-editor-aux-tools {
  align-items: start;
  display: flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
  min-width: 0;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
}
/* 플로우차트 칩(`.event-script-flowchart`) 규칙은 여기 없다 — 플로우는 도구 팝오버 안
   아코디언이 아니라 보기 방식 세그먼트의 「플로우」이고, 칼럼 전체를 쓴다.
   `.event-aux-chip-*` 는 다른 보조 도구가 계속 쓰므로 남는다. */
.event-aux-chip-summary {
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--text-2);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 8px;
  list-style: none;
  min-height: 38px;
  padding: 0 14px;
  user-select: none;
}
.event-aux-chip-summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}
.event-aux-chip-icon {
  color: var(--event-modern-accent);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1;
}
.event-aux-chip-label {
  font: 700 13px/1 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
.event-aux-chip-status {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--event-modern-accent) 12%, var(--event-modern-field));
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--event-modern-accent) 28%, var(--event-modern-border));
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: var(--text-2);
  font: 600 10px/1 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  margin-left: 2px;
  padding: 3px 7px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.event-aux-chip-status[data-kind="busy"] {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, var(--event-modern-border));
  color: var(--accent);
}
.event-aux-chip-status[data-kind="error"] {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 45%, var(--event-modern-border));
  color: var(--danger);
}
.event-aux-chip-status[data-kind="ready"] {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--event-modern-accent) 50%, var(--event-modern-border));
  color: var(--event-modern-accent);
}
.event-aux-chip-status[data-kind="empty"],
.event-aux-chip-status[data-kind="idle"] {
  border-color: var(--event-modern-border);
  color: var(--text-3);
}
/* idle/빈 칩 상태 배지 — 시각·스크린리더 모두 숨김 */
.event-aux-chip-status[hidden],
.event-aux-chip-status[aria-hidden="true"],
.event-aux-chip-status:empty {
  display: none;
}
/* 플로우 본문을 도구 칩 아래 절대 배치 오버레이로 띄우던 규칙은 삭제했다.
   그 방식은 크기를 팝오버 폭(실측 618×280)에 묶어 최상위 명령 7개 중 2개만 보였고,
   무엇보다 미리보기 **위에** 떠서 「자동 재생」과 단계 카운터를 덮었다.
   지금 플로우 레이아웃은 `.event-page-flow` (event-editor.modernize.css) 가 소유한다. */
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-list {
  background: var(--event-modern-field);
  border: 1px solid var(--event-modern-border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  counter-reset: command-row;
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  overflow: auto;
  padding: 4px 0;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
}
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-item {
  border: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
/* RM2K3 클래식 명령 라인 + 스레드형 parent/child 위계.
   depth마다 넓은 들여쓰기 + 연속 세로 레일 + 자식 행 배경 밴드로 분기를 즉시 읽는다. */
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-list {
  --cmd-indent-step: 18px;
  --cmd-indent-base: 0px;
  --cmd-rail: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 55%, var(--border-default));
  --cmd-rail-choices: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warning, #d9a441) 70%, var(--border-default));
  --cmd-rail-fork: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 70%, var(--border-default));
  --cmd-rail-shop: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success, #18764F) 70%, var(--border-default));
}
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-head,
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-line-marker,
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-empty-line {
  align-items: center;
  background-color: transparent;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 0;
  color: var(--text-1);
  display: flex;
  font: 400 12px/1.35 "Malgun Gothic", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  gap: 6px;
  min-height: 24px;
  overflow: hidden;
  /* 목업 parity: depth당 18px 들여쓰기(목업 --indent와 동일). */
  padding: 1px 8px 1px calc(var(--cmd-indent-base) + (var(--cmd-depth, 0) * var(--cmd-indent-step)));
  position: relative;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  /* 깊이마다 세로 레일(스레드). 연한 선이 아니라 확실한 트랙. */
  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(
    to right,
    transparent 0,
    transparent calc(var(--cmd-indent-step) - 2px),
    var(--cmd-rail) calc(var(--cmd-indent-step) - 2px),
    var(--cmd-rail) calc(var(--cmd-indent-step) - 1px),
    transparent calc(var(--cmd-indent-step) - 1px),
    transparent var(--cmd-indent-step)
  );
  background-position: var(--cmd-indent-base) 0;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-size: calc(var(--cmd-depth, 0) * var(--cmd-indent-step)) 100%;
}
/* 자식 행(depth≥1): 레일 안쪽 틴트로 parent 블록이 한 덩어리로 보이게. */
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-item[data-cmd-depth="1"] > .cmd-head,
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-item[data-cmd-depth="2"] > .cmd-head,
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-item[data-cmd-depth="3"] > .cmd-head,
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-item[data-cmd-depth="4"] > .cmd-head,
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-line-marker[data-cmd-depth="1"],
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-line-marker[data-cmd-depth="2"],
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-line-marker[data-cmd-depth="3"],
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-line-marker[data-cmd-depth="4"] {
  background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 6%, transparent);
}
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-item[data-cmd-depth="2"] > .cmd-head,
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-item[data-cmd-depth="3"] > .cmd-head,
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-item[data-cmd-depth="4"] > .cmd-head {
  background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 10%, transparent);
}
/* zebra 줄무늬는 스레드 틴트/레일과 충돌하므로 비활성화(아래 transparent 규칙 없음).
   part-2.css zebra 특이도는 modern의 depth tint / hover 규칙이 이긴다. */
/* hover/선택 — 레일 보존, 배경만 강조. */
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-list > .cmd-item > .cmd-head:hover,
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-list > .cmd-empty-line:hover {
  background-color: var(--bg-hover);
}
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-list > .cmd-item.selected > .cmd-head,
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-list > .cmd-item.editing > .cmd-head {
  background-color: var(--accent-muted);
  box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--accent);
  color: var(--text-1);
}
/* ◆ 프리픽스(RM2003 명령 다이아몬드). */
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-prefix {
  color: var(--event-modern-accent, var(--accent));
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1;
}
/* 분기 라벨 — parent 스레드 헤더. 트리 글리프 + 굵기 + 배경 밴드로 child와 구분. */
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-line-marker {
  color: var(--text-2);
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warning, #d9a441) 10%, transparent);
  border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border-default) 70%, transparent);
  border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border-default) 40%, transparent);
}
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-line-marker.cmd-marker-choices {
  color: var(--warning, #d9a441);
  background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warning, #d9a441) 12%, transparent);
  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(
    to right,
    transparent 0,
    transparent calc(var(--cmd-indent-step) - 2px),
    var(--cmd-rail-choices) calc(var(--cmd-indent-step) - 2px),
    var(--cmd-rail-choices) calc(var(--cmd-indent-step) - 1px),
    transparent calc(var(--cmd-indent-step) - 1px),
    transparent var(--cmd-indent-step)
  );
  background-position: var(--cmd-indent-base) 0;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-size: calc(var(--cmd-depth, 0) * var(--cmd-indent-step)) 100%;
}
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-line-marker.cmd-marker-fork {
  color: var(--event-modern-accent, var(--accent));
  background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 12%, transparent);
  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(
    to right,
    transparent 0,
    transparent calc(var(--cmd-indent-step) - 2px),
    var(--cmd-rail-fork) calc(var(--cmd-indent-step) - 2px),
    var(--cmd-rail-fork) calc(var(--cmd-indent-step) - 1px),
    transparent calc(var(--cmd-indent-step) - 1px),
    transparent var(--cmd-indent-step)
  );
  background-position: var(--cmd-indent-base) 0;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-size: calc(var(--cmd-depth, 0) * var(--cmd-indent-step)) 100%;
}
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-line-marker.cmd-marker-shop {
  color: var(--success, #18764F);
  background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success, #18764F) 12%, transparent);
}
/* 명령 추가 빈 줄(◆). */
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-empty-line {
  color: var(--event-modern-accent, var(--accent));
  font-weight: 700;
}
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-kind {
  color: var(--text-1);
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-summary-token.command {
  color: var(--event-modern-accent);
  font-weight: 700;
}
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-summary-token.value {
  color: var(--event-modern-success);
  font-weight: 700;
}
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-drag-handle,
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-actions,
.event-contents-fieldset .terminal-command-editor {
  display: none;
}
.event-contents-fieldset .cmd-item.editing .cmd-inline-editor {
  background: var(--bg-overlay);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  display: grid;
  /* 편집 패널도 대상 명령의 들여쓰기 깊이만큼 함께 밀어 정렬한다. */
  margin: 0 0 10px calc(8px + (var(--cmd-depth, 0) * 18px));
  padding: 14px;
}
.event-command-edit-body {
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
  min-height: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
.event-command-edit-body .event-command-edit-summary,
.cmd-inline-editor .event-command-edit-summary {
  display: none;
}
.event-command-edit-body > div {
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
}
/* changeFace form — selected card + 낱장 얼굴 갤러리 + option chips */
.event-command-face-editor {
  align-items: stretch;
  background: var(--bg-raised);
  border: 1px solid var(--event-modern-line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  display: grid;
  gap: 0;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  width: 100%;
}
.event-command-face-selected-card {
  align-items: start;
  background: var(--event-modern-field-muted);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--event-modern-line);
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(120px, 160px) minmax(0, 1fr);
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 14px;
}
.event-command-face-editor[data-face-mode="bust"] .event-command-face-selected-card {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(140px, 180px) minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.event-command-face-editor[data-face-mode="bust"] .event-command-face-preview-copy {
  max-width: none;
}
.event-command-face-bust-note {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--event-modern-field-muted) 90%, transparent);
  border: 1px dashed var(--event-modern-line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  max-width: 420px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
}
.event-command-face-bust-note strong {
  color: var(--text-1);
  font: 700 12px/1.3 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
.event-command-face-bust-note p {
  color: var(--text-2);
  font: 500 12px/1.45 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  margin: 0;
}
.event-command-face-crop.event-command-face-bust {
  background-position: bottom center !important;
  background-repeat: no-repeat !important;
  background-size: contain !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  /* Do not force background-image:none — inline url from bustVisual must show. */
}
.event-command-face-preview-host {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-command-face-editor .event-command-face-preview {
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  justify-items: center;
  min-height: 0;
  padding: 0;
  text-align: center;
}
.event-command-face-editor .event-command-face-preview-copy {
  align-content: start;
  justify-items: center;
  max-width: 180px;
  text-align: center;
  width: 100%;
}
.event-command-face-crop {
  background-image: var(--face-url);
  background-position: center;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-size: contain;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: 2px;
  height: var(--face-display-height, 96px);
  image-rendering: pixelated;
  overflow: hidden;
  width: var(--face-display-width, 96px);
}
/* 배경 그림은 <img> 로드 실패용 폴백이다. 실제 그림이 붙어 있으면 배경을 꺼야 한다.
   켜 두면 원본 크기 <img> 와 contain 배경이 서로 다른 크기·자리로 같이 보여 얼굴이 두 장으로
   겹친다(실측: 96px 상자에 48px img). 둘을 같은 크기로 맞추는 것만으로는 부족하다 —
   nearest-neighbour 래스터화 결과가 미묘하게 달라 배경이 테두리에서 1px 새어나온다.
   <img> 는 로드 실패 시 스스로 떨어지므로(faceImage), 그때 :has() 가 풀리며 폴백이 되살아난다. */
.faceset-crop-box {
  position: relative;
}
.faceset-crop-box:has(> .faceset-crop-sheet) {
  background-image: none;
}
.faceset-crop-box > .faceset-crop-sheet {
  height: 100%;
  image-rendering: pixelated;
  inset: 0;
  max-width: none;
  object-fit: contain;
  position: absolute;
  width: 100%;
}
.event-command-face-preview-copy {
  align-content: center;
  display: grid;
  gap: 4px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-command-face-preview-copy strong,
.event-command-face-preview[data-empty="true"] strong {
  color: var(--text-1);
  font: 700 13px/1.3 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.event-command-face-preview-copy span,
.event-command-face-preview[data-empty="true"] span {
  color: var(--text-2);
  font: 500 12px/1.35 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
.event-command-face-selected-meta {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-command-face-selected-heading {
  color: var(--event-modern-text-soft);
  font: 700 11px/1.2 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.event-command-face-resource-actions {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-command-face-resource-actions .btn {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  min-height: 30px;
  min-width: max-content;
  white-space: nowrap;
  width: auto;
  writing-mode: horizontal-tb;
}
.event-command-face-resource-label {
  display: grid;
  gap: 4px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-command-face-resource-label > span {
  color: var(--event-modern-text-soft);
  font: 700 11px/1.2 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
.event-command-face-resource-input {
  border: 0;
  clip: rect(0 0 0 0);
  height: 1px;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 0;
  position: absolute;
  white-space: nowrap;
  width: 1px;
}
.event-command-face-grid-section {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 14px;
}
.event-command-face-section-label {
  color: var(--event-modern-text-soft);
  font: 700 12px/1.2 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
.event-command-face-grid-host {
  min-width: 0;
}
/* 낱장 얼굴 갤러리 — 칸 번호 개수에 매이지 않게 auto-fill 하고 세로 스토로 둔다. */
.event-command-face-gallery {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(56px, 1fr));
  max-height: 260px;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 2px;
  width: 100%;
}
.event-command-face-gallery[data-empty="true"] {
  display: block;
}
.event-command-face-gallery-empty {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--event-modern-field-muted) 88%, transparent);
  border: 1px dashed var(--event-modern-line);
  border-radius: 6px;
  color: var(--text-2);
  font: 500 12px/1.4 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  padding: 18px 14px;
  text-align: center;
}
.event-command-face-gallery-cell {
  align-items: center;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-inset, #EFE9DC) 70%, transparent);
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 6px;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: grid;
  justify-items: center;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 2px;
  place-items: center;
}
.event-command-face-gallery-cell:hover {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 55%, transparent);
}
.event-command-face-gallery-cell.is-selected {
  border-color: var(--accent, #4A57D6);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 45%, transparent);
}
.event-command-face-gallery-cell .event-command-face-crop {
  border-radius: 3px;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.event-command-face-gallery-missing {
  color: var(--text-2);
  display: grid;
  font: 700 12px/1 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  height: 48px;
  place-items: center;
  width: 48px;
}
.event-command-face-options {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--event-modern-line);
  display: grid;
  gap: 0;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-command-face-editor .inline-field {
  align-content: start;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--event-modern-line);
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  min-height: 0;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 12px 14px;
}
.event-command-face-editor .inline-field:last-child {
  border-right: 0;
}
.event-command-face-editor .inline-field > span {
  color: var(--event-modern-text-soft);
  font: 700 12px/1.2 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.event-command-face-editor .inline-field input,
.event-command-face-editor .inline-field select {
  background: var(--bg-raised);
  border-color: var(--event-modern-border-strong);
  color: var(--text-1);
  font-weight: 600;
  min-width: 0;
  width: 100%;
}
.event-command-face-editor .inline-field:has(input[type="checkbox"]) {
  align-items: start;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.event-command-face-editor .inline-field input[type="checkbox"] {
  height: 18px;
  justify-self: start;
  margin: 2px 0 0;
  width: 18px;
}
.event-command-face-hint {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--event-modern-line);
  color: var(--text-2);
  font: 500 11px/1.45 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 10px 14px 12px;
}
/* 푸터: 좌측 힌트 | 우측 삭제·테스트·취소·적용·확인·도움말 (목업 순서) */
.event-editor-modal-footer {
  align-items: center;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-raised) 94%, var(--event-modern-field));
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 5px 14px;
}
.event-editor-footer-leading {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.event-editor-lifecycle-status {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  white-space: nowrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-right: 0;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.event-editor-remote-status {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.event-editor-remote-status::before {
  color: var(--event-modern-text-soft, var(--text-2));
  content: "·";
  margin-right: 8px;
}
.event-editor-draft-status {
  color: var(--event-modern-text-soft, var(--text-2));
  font: 500 12px/1.35 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.event-editor-footer-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
  gap: 6px;
  justify-content: flex-end;
}
.event-editor-footer-button {
  min-height: 32px;
  min-width: 64px;
  padding-block: 4px;
}
.event-editor-footer-button.primary {
  background: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent-border, var(--accent));
  color: var(--text-on-accent, #2A2521);
  font-weight: 700;
}
.event-editor-footer-button.primary:hover {
  filter: brightness(1.05);
}
.event-editor-modal-resize-handle {
  border-radius: 6px;
  bottom: 2px;
  cursor: nwse-resize;
  height: 22px;
  position: absolute;
  right: 2px;
  touch-action: none;
  width: 22px;
  z-index: 4;
}
.event-editor-modal-resize-handle:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 1px;
}
.event-editor-modal-resize-handle::before {
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 0 50%, var(--event-modern-border-strong) 50% 55%, transparent 55%),
    linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 0 66%, var(--event-modern-border-strong) 66% 71%, transparent 71%),
    linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 0 82%, var(--event-modern-border-strong) 82% 87%, transparent 87%);
  content: "";
  inset: 3px;
  position: absolute;
}
.event-editor-modal-resize-handle:hover,
.event-editor-modal-resize-handle:focus-visible {
  background: var(--event-modern-accent-soft);
  outline: 1px solid var(--event-modern-accent);
}
@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .event-editor-modal-dynamic .event-editor {
    gap: 12px;
    grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  }

  .event-editor-top-strip {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(280px, 1fr);
  }

  .event-page-action-buttons {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .event-editor-workbench {
    --event-editor-settings-track: clamp(260px, 42vw, 360px);
    grid-template-columns: minmax(260px, var(--event-editor-settings-track)) 8px minmax(300px, 1fr);
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .event-editor-settings-column,
  .event-editor-commands-column {
    min-height: 0;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 820px) {
  .event-editor-modal-footer {
    gap: 6px;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(80px, 1fr) auto;
  }

  .event-editor-footer-leading {
    display: flex;
  }

  .event-editor-footer-actions {
    gap: 4px;
    justify-content: flex-end;
  }

  .event-editor-modal-body {
    padding: 18px 25px 8px;
  }

  .event-editor-workbench {
    --event-editor-settings-track: clamp(250px, 42vw, 320px);
    grid-template-columns: minmax(250px, var(--event-editor-settings-track)) 8px minmax(280px, 1fr);
  }

  .event-editor-settings-column {
    gap: 10px;
    grid-template-columns: 58px minmax(0, 1fr);
  }

  .event-oprn-fieldset {
    padding: 12px 10px;
  }

  .event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-row {
    gap: 4px;
    grid-template-columns: 16px max-content minmax(0, 1fr) max-content;
  }

  .event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-control.variable {
    gap: 4px;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }

  .event-condition-threshold {
    gap: 4px;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 42px;
  }

  .event-editor-modal-body .event-condition-control.timer {
    gap: 4px;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(32px, 1fr) max-content minmax(32px, 1fr) max-content;
  }


  .event-editor-command-tool {
    min-width: 34px;
  }

  .event-contents-fieldset {
    padding-top: 38px;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .event-editor-workbench {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) !important;
    grid-template-rows: minmax(220px, 1fr) auto;
  }
  .event-editor-column-resizer {
    display: none;
  }
  .event-editor-inspector-column {
    max-height: 42vh;
    overflow: auto;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
    padding-top: 8px;
    background: var(--bg-surface);
    border-radius: 8px;
  }
}
/* Transfer inline editor owns its layout; do not force generic stacks on children. */
.event-command-edit-body:has(.transfer-command-editor-inline) {
  align-content: start;
}
.event-command-edit-body > div:has(.transfer-command-editor-inline) {
  display: block;
  min-width: 0;
}
/* Field monster one-click template dialog */
.field-monster-template-form {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 4px 2px 8px;
}
.field-monster-template-hint {
  color: var(--text-2);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  margin: 0;
}
.field-monster-template-field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}
.field-monster-template-label {
  color: var(--text-2);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.field-monster-template-textarea,
.field-monster-template-input {
  background: var(--bg-inset, var(--event-modern-field));
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, var(--event-modern-border));
  border-radius: 6px;
  color: inherit;
  font: inherit;
  min-height: 34px;

.field-monster-template-checks {

.field-monster-template-check {

/* 셀프 스위치 세그먼트 컨트롤 (A/B/C/D + ON/OFF) */
.self-switch-control {
  align-items: center;
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 6px;
}
.self-switch-keys {
  border: 1px solid var(--event-modern-border);
  border-radius: 5px;
  display: inline-flex;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.self-switch-key {
  background: var(--event-modern-field);
  border: none;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--event-modern-border);
  color: var(--event-modern-text-soft);
  cursor: pointer;
  font: 700 11px/1 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  /* 22x19 는 히트타겟 최소선(24px) 미달이었다(2026-08-19 실측 감사). */
  min-width: 26px;
  min-height: 24px;
  padding: 4px 6px;
  transition: background 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease;
}
.self-switch-key:last-child {
  border-right: none;
}
.self-switch-key:hover {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--event-modern-accent) 12%, var(--event-modern-field));
  color: var(--event-modern-text);
}
.self-switch-key.active {
  background: var(--event-modern-accent);
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.self-switch-value {
  border: 1px solid var(--event-modern-border);
  border-radius: 11px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font: 700 10px/1 "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  min-height: 24px;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  transition: background 0.12s ease, border-color 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease;
}
.self-switch-value.on {
  background: var(--event-modern-success, #18764F);
  border-color: var(--event-modern-success, #18764F);
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.self-switch-value.off {
  background: var(--event-modern-field);
  color: var(--event-modern-text-soft);
}
/* 비활성 조건 행에서 컨트롤 흐림 처리 */
.event-condition-row.disabled .self-switch-key,
.event-condition-row.disabled .self-switch-value {
  opacity: 0.5;
  pointer-events: none;
}
/* 고급 조건 영역에서도 동일 스타일 적용 */
.event-advanced-condition-control.self-switch .self-switch-control {
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 4px;
}
/* 이벤트 명령 편집 모달 — 2열(폼 / 이미지 리치 프리뷰) 레이아웃 + 종류별 프리뷰.
   event-editor.css 에서 modern.css 다음(마지막)으로 import 되어 캐스케이드 우선권을 갖는다. */
/* 분할 목차 — 아래 @import 순서가 캐스케이드(규칙 순서)를 결정하므로 재배열 금지. */
/* 이벤트 명령 편집 모달 — 2열(폼 / 이미지 리치 프리뷰) 레이아웃 + 종류별 프리뷰.
   event-editor.css 에서 modern.css 다음(마지막)으로 import 되어 캐스케이드 우선권을 갖는다. */
/* 명령 편집 다이얼로그를 2열이 들어갈 만큼 넓힌다. */
.event-subdialog-window.wide:has(.event-command-edit-dialog) {
  width: min(780px, calc(100vw - 24px));
}
/* 선택지 표시: 입력+삭제 버튼+취소 패널이 한 줄에 들어가도록 조금 더 넓힌다. */
.event-subdialog-window.wide:has(.event-command-choices-inline) {
  width: min(920px, calc(100vw - 24px));
}
.event-command-edit-columns:has(.event-command-choices-inline) > .event-command-edit-body {
  max-height: min(70vh, 640px);
  overflow: auto;
  padding-right: 2px;
}
/* 장소 이동: 좌측에 맵 피커가 있으므로 우측 범용 프리뷰 중복 숨김 */
.event-command-edit-columns:has(.transfer-command-editor-inline) > .event-command-preview-panel {
  display: none;
}
.event-command-edit-columns:has(.transfer-command-editor-inline) {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}
/* 장소 이동: 인라인 맵 피커 폭 확보 (우측 중복 프리뷰는 위 규칙에서 숨김) */
.event-subdialog-window.wide:has(.transfer-command-editor-inline) {
  width: min(1040px, calc(100vw - 20px));
}
.event-command-edit-columns:has(.transfer-command-editor-inline) > .event-command-edit-body {
  max-height: min(78vh, 760px);
  overflow: auto;
  min-width: 0;
}
/* 이동 경로 설정: 폼 자체에 리스트+프리뷰+버튼 그리드가 있어 더 넓게 잡는다. */
.event-subdialog-window.wide:has(.move-route-editor) {
  height: min(720px, calc(100vh - 24px));
  width: min(1120px, calc(100vw - 24px));
}
/* 이벤트 프레임 변경: RM2003 그래픽 피커 전체 폭. 우측 범용 프리뷰 숨김. */
.event-subdialog-window.wide:has(.event-command-frame-editor) {
  height: min(720px, calc(100vh - 24px));
  width: min(920px, calc(100vw - 24px));
}
/* 얼굴 그래픽 변경: 선택 카드 + 낱장 얼굴 갤러리가 들어가도록 폭 확보.
   (4×4 칸 번호 격자는 폐기됐다 — 갤러리는 등록된 얼굴 파일 전부를 auto-fill 로 깐다.) */
.event-subdialog-window.wide:has(.event-command-face-editor) {
  width: min(900px, calc(100vw - 24px));
}
.event-command-edit-columns {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(240px, 320px);
  gap: 16px;
  align-items: start;
}
/* 이동 경로: 본문 폼이 주 작업면. 우측 범용 프리뷰는 접어 버튼 폭을 확보. */
.event-command-edit-columns:has(.move-route-editor) {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.event-command-edit-columns:has(.move-route-editor) > .event-command-preview-panel {
  display: none;
}
/* 애니메이션 표시: 본문이 진짜 재생 표시면을 직접 갖는다.
   오른쪽 범용 프리뷰까지 다시 그리면 같은 연출이 한 모달에 둘이 된다. */
.event-command-edit-columns:has([data-testid="show-animation-command-body"]) {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.event-command-edit-columns:has([data-testid="show-animation-command-body"]) > .event-command-preview-panel {
  display: none;
}
.event-command-edit-columns:has(.event-command-frame-editor) {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.event-command-edit-columns:has(.event-command-frame-editor) > .event-command-preview-panel {
  display: none;
}
/* 장비 변경: 폼 안 장착 미리보기가 있으므로 우측 범용 프리뷰 숨김 */
.event-command-edit-columns:has(.change-equipment-command-body) {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}
/* 전용 스테이지가 없는 요약 카드: 빈 우측 칸을 접고 폼을 전폭으로 쓴다. */
.event-command-edit-columns:has(.event-command-preview.ecp-summary-only) {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.event-command-edit-columns:has(.event-command-preview.ecp-summary-only) > .event-command-preview-panel {
  display: none;
}
.event-command-edit-columns:has(.change-equipment-command-body) > .event-command-preview-panel {
  display: none;
}
.event-subdialog-window.wide:has(.change-equipment-command-body) {
  width: min(760px, calc(100vw - 24px));
}
.event-command-edit-columns > .event-command-edit-body {
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-command-edit-columns:has(.move-route-editor) > .event-command-edit-body {
  max-height: min(720px, calc(100vh - 120px));
  overflow: auto;
}
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .event-command-edit-columns {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
}
/* 우측 프리뷰 패널 */
.event-command-preview-panel {
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-command-preview {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  background: var(--bg-inset, #EFE9DC);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default, rgba(42,37,33,.20));
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 12px;
  min-height: 160px;
}
.ecp-caption {
  font: 700 12px/1.2 Tahoma, "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
  color: var(--oprn-command-blue, var(--accent, #4A57D6));
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(42,37,33,.20));
  padding-bottom: 6px;
}
/* 화면 목업 무대 */
.ecp-stage {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  place-items: end center;
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
  width: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-surface), var(--bg-surface));
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.ecp-stage.pos-top { place-items: start center; }
.ecp-stage.pos-center { place-items: center; }
.ecp-stage.pos-bottom { place-items: end center; }
/* 미리보기(`event-page-preview`)는 명령 칼럼 전체 폭을 쓴다. 거기서 `width: 100%` +
   `aspect-ratio: 4/3` 는 무대를 스크롤 뷰포트보다 높게 만든다 — 실측 2560x1440 에서
   무대 1737x1303, 뷰포트 1030. 메시지 창은 `place-items: end center` 로 아래에 붙으므로
   fold 밖으로 나가 «빈 흰 박스» 만 보였다(문장 표시 명령 = 가장 흔한 명령).
   높이를 기준으로 폭을 제한해 4:3 을 지키면서 한 화면에 들어오게 한다. */
.event-page-preview .ecp-stage {
  margin-inline: auto;
  max-width: calc(58vh * 4 / 3);
}
.ecp-message-window {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 96%;
  min-height: 72px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  border: 1px solid var(--runtime-dialogue-glass-border);
  border-image: none;
  border-radius: var(--runtime-dialogue-radius);
  /* 반투명한 대화창 유리가 불투명 밑판 **위에** 와야 한다. background-color 는 항상 맨
     아래에 깔리므로 유리를 색으로 두면 밑판 그라디언트가 그 위를 덮는다. 그러면 창이
     밝아지고 `--runtime-window-text` 크림색 글자가 사라진다(실측: #FFF6E2 on
     #F7F8F8 = 1.0:1). computed 값만 읽으면 17.8:1 로 보이니 렌더된 픽셀로 확인한다. */
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, var(--runtime-dialogue-glass-surface), var(--runtime-dialogue-glass-surface)),
    var(--bg-surface);
  color: var(--runtime-window-text);
  font: 400 13px/1.45 "Malgun Gothic", Tahoma, sans-serif;
  box-shadow: var(--runtime-dialogue-glass-shadow);
  backdrop-filter: var(--runtime-dialogue-glass-filter);
  image-rendering: pixelated;
  position: relative;
}
.ecp-message-window.has-speaker {
  margin-top: 14px;
}
.ecp-message-window.with-face {
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: stretch;
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: 120px;
}
.ecp-message-window.face-right { flex-direction: row-reverse; }
/* === 프리뷰 「말투·연출」 진입 재생 ===
   런타임과 **같은 keyframe** 을 쓴다. src/styles/dialogue.css 는 에디터 그래프에도
   실려 있으므로(styles/index.css → runtime/playerRuntime.css → ../dialogue.css)
   이름만 부르면 된다. 규칙을 다시 적는 이유는 셀렉터가 `.dialogue-box` 를 요구하는데
   프리뷰 창은 `.ecp-message-window` 라서다.

   감정→keyframe 짝이 런타임과 어긋나면 제작자가 고른 연출과 프리뷰가 달라진다.
   test/dialoguePreviewPresentationCss.test.ts 가 두 선택자 집합을 대조해 잠근다. */
.ecp-message-window[data-dialogue-phase] {
  transform-origin: 50% 100%;
}
.ecp-message-window[data-dialogue-phase="enter"] {
  animation: dialogue-box-enter var(--dialogue-enter-ms) var(--runtime-dialogue-enter-ease) both;
}
.ecp-message-window[data-dialogue-emotion="happy"][data-dialogue-phase="enter"],
.ecp-message-window[data-dialogue-emotion="surprised"][data-dialogue-phase="enter"] {
  animation-name: dialogue-box-enter-pop;
}
.ecp-message-window[data-dialogue-emotion="sad"][data-dialogue-phase="enter"] {
  animation-name: dialogue-box-enter-soft;
  animation-timing-function: var(--runtime-dialogue-enter-ease-soft);
}
.ecp-message-window[data-dialogue-motion="off"][data-dialogue-phase="enter"] {
  animation-name: dialogue-box-enter-fade;
  animation-timing-function: linear;
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  /* 런타임과 같은 특이도 셈. 감정별 animation-name 규칙이 (0,3,0) 이므로
     [data-dialogue-emotion] 을 함께 붙여야 이 안전망이 이긴다. */
  .ecp-message-window[data-dialogue-emotion][data-dialogue-phase="enter"] {
    animation-name: dialogue-box-enter-fade;
    animation-timing-function: linear;
  }
}
.ecp-message-window.transparent {
  background: transparent;
  backdrop-filter: none;
  background-image: none !important;
  border-image: none !important;
  border-style: dashed;
  border-color: var(--runtime-dialogue-glass-border);

  box-shadow: none;
}
.ecp-message-text {

  flex: 1 1 auto;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 0;
}
.ecp-message-speaker { font-weight: 700; color: var(--oprn-command-teal, #ffd76e); font-size: 12px; }
.ecp-message-speaker-nameplate {

.ecp-message-body { white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; }
.ecp-message-body.muted { color: var(--text-1); font-size: 12px; }
/* changeFace play mock — larger face crop, no editor meta chrome inside the window */
.ecp-face-stage {
  gap: 8px;
}
.ecp-face-stage.ecp-stage {

  flex-direction: column;

.ecp-message-window .event-command-face-crop-shell {

/* 배경 폴백은 공용 `.event-command-face-crop` 이 한 곳에서 소유한다. 여기서 `background-image` 를
   다시 선언하면 특이도가 (0,2,0) 으로 같아져 나중에 로드되는 이 파일이 `:has(> .faceset-crop-sheet)`
   가드를 이기고, 재생 목업에서만 얼굴 두 장이 겹친다. 이 규칙은 테두리 강조만 담당한다. */
