  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
}
.event-command-message-settings .rich-segment-group {
  display: flex;
  width: 100%;
}
.event-command-message-settings .rich-segment {
  flex: 1 1 0;
  min-width: 0;
  text-align: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 8px 10px;
}
.ecp-choice-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; margin-top: 4px; }
.ecp-choice {
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--runtime-dialogue-radius-small);
  font-size: 12px;
  padding: 3px 7px;
}
.ecp-choice:first-child {
  background: var(--runtime-dialogue-glass-accent-soft);
  border-color: var(--runtime-dialogue-glass-border);
  box-shadow: var(--runtime-dialogue-glass-focus-shadow);
}
.ecp-choice.empty { opacity: 0.6; }
/* 미니맵 */
.ecp-map-stage { place-items: center; background: var(--bg-surface); }
.ecp-map-canvas { image-rendering: pixelated; max-width: 100%; max-height: 210px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); }
.ecp-map-caption {
  position: absolute; bottom: 6px; left: 8px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-1);
  background: var(--border-default); padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 3px;
}
/* 아이콘 무대 (아이템/배우/골드/전투/스위치) */
.ecp-icon-stage { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 16px 8px; }
.ecp-hero-icon {
  display: grid; place-items: center; width: 56px; height: 56px;
  background: var(--bg-raised, #FFFDF8); border: 1px solid var(--border-default, rgba(42,37,33,.20)); border-radius: 8px;
}
.ecp-hero-img { image-rendering: pixelated; }
.ecp-icon-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-1, #2A2521); text-align: center; }
.ecp-op-strip {
  font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
  background: var(--bg-inset, #EFE9DC); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(42,37,33,.20));
  border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 10px;
}
.ecp-gold-badge, .ecp-battle-badge, .ecp-exp-badge, .ecp-skill-badge { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px; }
.ecp-gold-badge { background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, var(--bg-raised), var(--warning-muted)); color: var(--warning); border: 1px solid var(--warning); }
.ecp-exp-badge { background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, var(--bg-raised), var(--accent-muted)); color: var(--accent); border: 1px solid var(--accent-border); font-size: 14px; }
.ecp-skill-badge { background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, var(--bg-raised), var(--bg-inset)); color: var(--text-1); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); font-size: 14px; }
.ecp-battle-badge { background: var(--danger-muted); color: var(--danger); border: 1px solid var(--danger); }
.ecp-battle-stage { width: 100%; align-items: stretch; padding: 10px 8px 14px; }
.ecp-battle-field {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 110px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default, rgba(42,37,33,.20));
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-surface) 0%, var(--bg-surface) 70%, var(--bg-surface) 100%);
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 10px 8px 8px;
}
.ecp-battle-enemies {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 72px;
}
.ecp-battle-enemy {
  max-width: 72px;
  max-height: 72px;
  width: auto;
  height: auto;
  object-fit: contain;
  image-rendering: pixelated;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 0 var(--shadow-pop));
}
.ecp-battle-enemy-fallback {
  min-width: 40px;
  min-height: 40px;
  padding: 6px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  color: var(--text-1);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
}
.ecp-battle-rewards {
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
  font: 600 11px/1.35 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  margin-top: 4px;
  text-align: center;
}
.ecp-battle-empty-warn {
  margin-top: 6px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-surface) 18%, transparent);
  color: var(--text-1);
  font: 700 11px/1.3 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  text-align: center;
}
.ecp-battle-result-note {
  margin-top: 6px;
  color: var(--text-3, #6B5F52);
  font: 500 10px/1.3 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  text-align: center;
}
.ecp-lamp { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 56px; height: 30px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; }
.ecp-lamp.on { background: var(--success-muted); color: var(--success); border: 1px solid var(--success); }
.ecp-lamp.off { background: var(--control-bg); color: var(--text-3); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); }
.ecp-vital-gauge {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 160px;
  height: 10px;
  background: var(--bg-inset, #EFE9DC);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default, rgba(42,37,33,.20));
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.ecp-vital-gauge-fill {
  height: 100%;
  min-width: 8px;
}
.ecp-vital-gauge-fill.hurt { background: var(--danger, #C4473A); }
.ecp-vital-gauge-fill.heal { background: var(--success, #2F8A4E); }
.ecp-vital-gauge-fill.set { background: var(--accent, #4A57D6); }
.ecp-vital-gauge-fill.full.hp { background: var(--danger, #C4473A); }
.ecp-vital-gauge-fill.full.mp { background: var(--accent, #4A57D6); }
/* 결과 화면 목업 */
.ecp-result-screen {
  display: grid; place-items: center; width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 96px;
  font: 800 18px/1.2 Tahoma, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; border-radius: 6px;
}
.ecp-result-screen.gameover { background: var(--bg-surface); color: var(--bg-surface); }
.ecp-result-screen.title { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-surface), var(--bg-surface)); color: var(--bg-surface); }
.ecp-result-screen.ending { background: var(--bg-surface); color: var(--bg-surface); }
/* 숫자 입력 편집 폼 — 자체 세로 스택 (auto-fit 그리드 제외 대상). */
.event-command-edit-body .input-number-command-body,
.input-number-command-body {
  align-content: start;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  min-width: 0;
  width: 100%;
}
.event-command-edit-body .input-number-command-body .input-number-field,
.input-number-command-body .input-number-field {
  align-items: start;
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px 12px;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(56px, 72px) minmax(0, 1fr);
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-command-edit-body .input-number-command-body .input-number-field-label,
.input-number-command-body .input-number-field-label {
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
  font: 700 12px/1.3 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  padding-top: 7px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.input-number-digits-field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.input-number-digit-stepper {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
  gap: 4px;
}
.input-number-digit-chip {
  min-width: 32px;
  height: 30px;
  padding: 0 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default, rgba(42,37,33,.20));
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: var(--bg-raised, #FFFDF8);
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
  font: 700 12px/1 Tahoma, "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.input-number-digit-chip:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent, #4A57D6);
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
}
.input-number-digit-chip.active {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 22%, transparent);
  border-color: var(--accent, #4A57D6);
  color: var(--accent, #4A57D6);
}
.input-number-digit-chip:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #4A57D6);
  outline-offset: 1px;
}
.input-number-digits-mirror {
  display: none;
}
.input-number-digits-caption {
  color: var(--text-3, #6B5F52);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.35;
}
.input-number-options {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  min-width: 0;
  padding-left: 0;
}
.input-number-pad-toggle {
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 8px;
  font: 600 12px/1.3 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  width: fit-content;
}
.input-number-pad-toggle input[type="checkbox"] {
  height: 16px;
  margin: 0;
  width: 16px;
}
.input-number-hint {
  color: var(--text-3, #6B5F52);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  margin: 0;
}
/* 숫자 입력 창 — System.png fill 금지, 빈 슬롯 idle 미리보기. */
.ecp-number-stage {
  place-items: center;
  padding: 12px;
}
.ecp-number-window,
.ecp-number-window-clean {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 45%, rgba(42,37,33,.20));
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-surface), var(--bg-surface));
  color: var(--text-1);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px var(--shadow-pop);
  border-image: none !important;
  background-image: none !important;
}
.ecp-number-title {
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--oprn-command-blue, #4A57D6);
}
.ecp-number-slots {
  display: flex;
  gap: 5px;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
}
.ecp-number-slot {
  min-width: 22px;
  height: 28px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 0 5px;
  border: 2px solid var(--border-default);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  color: transparent;
  font: 700 16px/1 "Malgun Gothic", Tahoma, sans-serif;
  border-radius: 2px;
}
.ecp-number-slot.empty {
  color: transparent;
}
.ecp-number-slot.filled {
  border-color: var(--border-default);
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.ecp-number-slot.cursor {
  border-color: var(--border-default);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--shadow-pop);
}
.ecp-number-pad {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(28px, 1fr));
  gap: 4px;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 148px;
}
.ecp-number-pad-key {
  min-height: 24px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-1);
  border-radius: 3px;
}
.ecp-number-pad-key.ok {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-color: var(--accent, #4A57D6);
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.ecp-number-pad-key.back {
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.ecp-number-ok-mock {
  min-width: 56px;
  min-height: 26px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 2px 10px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 55%, rgba(42,37,33,.20));
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  color: var(--text-1);
  font: 700 12px/1 Tahoma, "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
}
.ecp-number-meta {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-1);
  text-align: center;
}
/* 변수 조작 미리보기 — 수식 카드 */
.ecp-variable-stage {
  place-items: center;
  padding: 12px;
}
.ecp-variable-card {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: stretch;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 45%, rgba(42,37,33,.20));
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-surface), var(--bg-surface));
  color: var(--text-1);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px var(--shadow-pop);
  border-image: none !important;
  background-image: none !important;
}
.ecp-variable-title {
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--oprn-command-blue, #4A57D6);
}
.ecp-variable-formula {
  font: 700 15px/1.4 "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, "Malgun Gothic", monospace;
  color: var(--text-1);
  text-align: center;
  word-break: break-word;
}
.ecp-variable-meta {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-1);
  text-align: center;
}
/* 상점 창 — System.png border-image fill 금지(팔레트 스트립 오염). 솔리드 목업만. */
.ecp-shop-stage {
  place-items: stretch center;
  align-content: center;
  padding: 12px;
}
.ecp-shop-window,
.ecp-shop-window-clean {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 45%, rgba(42,37,33,.20));
  border-radius: 8px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-surface), var(--bg-surface));
  color: var(--text-1);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px var(--shadow-pop);
  /* applySystemGraphic 이 실수로 붙어도 fill 이 새지 않게 */
  border-image: none !important;
  background-image: none !important;
}
.ecp-shop-title {
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  color: var(--oprn-command-blue, #4A57D6);
}
.ecp-shop-message {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-1);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.ecp-shop-merchant-gold {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-1);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  padding-bottom: 6px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default);
}
.ecp-shop-item-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  max-height: 220px;
  overflow: auto;
}
.ecp-shop-item-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 24px minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 5px 6px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
}
.ecp-shop-item-icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
}
.ecp-shop-item-icon img,
.ecp-shop-item-icon .rich-record-icon,
.ecp-shop-item-icon .rich-record-initial {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  image-rendering: pixelated;
}
.ecp-shop-item-name {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.ecp-shop-item-price {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-1);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.ecp-shop-item-empty,
.ecp-shop-item-more {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-1);
  padding: 6px 4px;
  text-align: center;
}
.ecp-shop-branch-note {
  margin-top: 8px;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.ecp-item-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr); gap: 6px; }
.ecp-item-cell { display: grid; place-items: center; aspect-ratio: 1; background: var(--border-default); border-radius: 4px; }
.ecp-item-cell.empty { grid-column: 1 / -1; aspect-ratio: auto; padding: 8px; font-size: 12px; opacity: 0.6; }
.ecp-item-cell img { image-rendering: pixelated; }
/* 요약 카드 폴백 */
.ecp-summary-card { display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 96px; padding: 16px; }
.ecp-summary-line { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px; justify-content: center; text-align: center; }
.ecp-summary-icon { image-rendering: pixelated; vertical-align: middle; }
.ecp-token { font-size: 13px; }
.ecp-token.command { font-weight: 700; color: var(--oprn-command-blue, var(--accent, #4A57D6)); }
.ecp-token.value { color: var(--text-1, #2A2521); }
.ecp-token.plain { color: var(--text-2, #5C5348); }
.ecp-token.op-add { color: var(--success, #18764F); font-weight: 700; }
.ecp-token.op-sub { color: var(--danger, #C6403D); font-weight: 700; }
.ecp-token.op-set { color: var(--accent, #4A57D6); font-weight: 700; }
.ecp-token.badge-on { color: var(--text-1); font-weight: 700; }
.ecp-token.badge-off { color: var(--text-1); font-weight: 700; }
.ecp-missing-card { padding: 16px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-2, #5C5348); }
/* moveEvent 궤적/테이프 */
.ecp-move { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.ecp-move-target { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.ecp-move-target-label { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-2, #5C5348); }
.ecp-move-target-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; color: var(--oprn-command-blue, var(--accent, #4A57D6)); }
.ecp-move-grid-box { display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--border-default); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px; }
.ecp-move-grid { max-width: 100%; height: auto; }
.ecp-grid-dot { fill: var(--bg-surface); }
.ecp-move-line { fill: none; stroke: var(--accent, #4A57D6); stroke-width: 2; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: round; }
.ecp-move-step { fill: var(--accent, #4A57D6); }
.ecp-move-start { fill: var(--bg-surface); stroke: var(--bg-surface); stroke-width: 1; }
.ecp-move-tape { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; }
.ecp-move-chip { font-size: 12px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--bg-raised, #FFFDF8); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(42,37,33,.20)); color: var(--text-1, #2A2521); }
.ecp-move-chip.empty { opacity: 0.6; }
.ecp-move-nogrid { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-2, #5C5348); padding: 8px; text-align: center; background: var(--bg-canvas, #E7E0D0); border-radius: 6px; }
.ecp-move-badges { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; }
.ecp-move-badge { font-size: 11px; padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent-muted, rgba(74, 87, 214, 0.16)); color: var(--accent, #4A57D6); border: 1px solid var(--accent, #4A57D6); }
/* fork 흐름도 */
.ecp-fork { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 8px 0; }
.ecp-fork-cond { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; background: var(--bg-raised, #FFFDF8); border: 1px solid var(--accent, #4A57D6); border-radius: 6px; max-width: 100%; }
.ecp-fork-cond-icon { color: var(--accent, #4A57D6); font-size: 14px; }
.ecp-fork-cond-text { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-1, #2A2521); }
.ecp-fork-branches { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; width: 100%; }
.ecp-fork-branch { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default, rgba(42,37,33,.20)); background: var(--bg-inset, #EFE9DC); }
.ecp-fork-branch.then { border-color: var(--success, #18764F); }
.ecp-fork-branch.else { border-color: var(--danger, #C6403D); }
.ecp-fork-branch.else-absent { opacity: 0.55; }
.ecp-fork-branch-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }
.ecp-fork-branch.then .ecp-fork-branch-label { color: var(--success, #18764F); }
.ecp-fork-branch.else .ecp-fork-branch-label,
.ecp-fork-branch.else-absent .ecp-fork-branch-label { color: var(--danger, #C6403D); }
.ecp-fork-branch-count { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-2, #5C5348); }
.ecp-fork-branch-hint { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-3, #6B5F52); }
.ecp-fork-eval { padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; width: 100%; text-align: center; }
.ecp-fork-eval.is-true { background: rgba(24, 118, 79, 0.12); color: var(--success, #18764F); border: 1px solid rgba(24, 118, 79, 0.3); }
.ecp-fork-eval.is-false { background: rgba(198, 64, 61, 0.12); color: var(--danger, #C6403D); border: 1px solid rgba(198, 64, 61, 0.3); }
.ecp-fork-branch.taken { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent, #4A57D6); }
.ecp-fork-branch.skipped { opacity: 0.4; }
.ecp-skipped { opacity: 0.45; }
.ecp-skipped-badge { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-3, #6B5F52); font-style: italic; padding: 2px 6px; }
.ecp-current-state { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-3, #6B5F52); padding: 2px 0; }
.ecp-runtime-effect-card { padding: 8px; }
.ecp-runtime-effect-title { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-3, #6B5F52); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.ecp-runtime-effect-detail { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-2, #5C5348); margin-top: 6px; padding: 4px 8px; background: var(--bg-inset, #EFE9DC); border-radius: 4px; }
/* showPicture 화면 배치 */
.ecp-picture { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.ecp-picture-screen { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; background: var(--border-default); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; }
/* 앵커는 런타임과 같은 좌상단이다(runtime/pictures.css 의 transform-origin: top left).
   translate(-50%,-50%) 로 중심에 맞추던 시절에는 프리뷰와 실제 위치가 어긋났다. */
.ecp-picture-marker { position: absolute; transform-origin: top left; max-width: 60%; max-height: 60%; }
.ecp-picture-img { max-width: 100%; max-height: 120px; image-rendering: pixelated; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); }
.ecp-picture-marker.missing {
  width: 56px;
  min-height: 40px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border: 2px dashed var(--border-default);
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
}
.ecp-picture-missing-label { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-1); text-align: center; word-break: break-all; }
.ecp-picture-placeholder-frame {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
  padding: 4px;
}
.ecp-picture-placeholder-xy {
  font-size: 9px;
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.ecp-picture-erase .ecp-picture-screen {
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%, var(--bg-surface) 0%, var(--bg-surface) 70%);
}
.ecp-picture-erase-marker {
  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  border-color: var(--border-default);
}
.ecp-picture-caption { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-2, #5C5348); }
/* audio 파형/컨트롤 */
.ecp-audio { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 8px; }
.ecp-audio-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 18px; }
.ecp-audio-icon.play { background: var(--border-default); color: var(--border-default); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); }
.ecp-audio-icon.stop { background: var(--border-default); color: var(--border-default); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); }
.ecp-audio-name { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-1, #2A2521); text-align: center; word-break: break-all; }
.ecp-audio-wave { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; height: 40px; width: 100%; max-width: 220px; justify-content: center; }
.ecp-audio-bar { width: 4px; min-height: 3px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent, #4A57D6), rgba(74, 87, 214, 0.3)); border-radius: 2px; }
.ecp-audio-badges { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
.ecp-audio-badge { font-size: 11px; padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 999px; }
.ecp-audio-badge.on { background: var(--accent-muted, rgba(74, 87, 214, 0.16)); color: var(--accent, #4A57D6); border: 1px solid var(--accent, #4A57D6); }
.ecp-audio-badge.off { background: var(--bg-inset, #EFE9DC); color: var(--text-2, #5C5348); border: 1px solid var(--border-default, rgba(42,37,33,.20)); }
/* setEventGraphicPattern — charset frame stage */
.ecp-pattern-stage {
  place-items: center;
  min-height: 180px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, var(--bg-surface), transparent 55%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-surface), var(--bg-surface));
}
.ecp-pattern-stage-inner {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  width: 100%;
}
.ecp-pattern-sprite.event-graphic-preview,
.ecp-pattern-stage .event-graphic-preview {
  image-rendering: pixelated;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: 6px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px var(--shadow-pop);
  background-color: var(--bg-surface);
  flex: none;
}
.ecp-pattern-caption {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
  text-align: center;
  max-width: 100%;
}
.ecp-pattern-caption-title {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--oprn-command-blue, var(--accent, #4A57D6));
  word-break: break-all;
}
.ecp-pattern-caption-meta {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
}
/* left-side frame editor form */
.event-command-frame-editor {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  min-width: 0;
  width: 100%;
}
.event-command-frame-field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-command-frame-field-label {
  font: 700 11px/1.2 Tahoma, "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
}
.event-command-frame-field-hint {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.35;
  color: var(--text-3, #6B5F52);
}
.event-command-frame-event-select,
.event-command-frame-editor input[type="number"] {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-command-frame-live-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 10px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default, rgba(42,37,33,.20));
  background: var(--bg-inset, #EFE9DC);
}
.event-command-frame-live-label {
  font: 700 11px/1.2 Tahoma, "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
  color: var(--oprn-command-blue, var(--accent, #4A57D6));
}
.event-command-frame-live {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  min-height: 112px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, var(--bg-surface), transparent 55%),
    var(--bg-surface);
}
.event-command-frame-live .event-graphic-preview {
  image-rendering: pixelated;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background-color: var(--bg-surface);
  flex: none;
}
.event-command-frame-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
}
.event-command-frame-meta-line {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
  word-break: break-all;
}
.event-command-frame-walk-chips {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}
.event-command-frame-walk-chip.active {
  border-color: var(--accent, #4A57D6);
  color: var(--accent, #4A57D6);
  background: var(--accent-muted, rgba(110, 168, 255, 0.16));
}
.event-command-frame-rm-options {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
}
.event-command-frame-direction-group,
.event-command-frame-pattern-group {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}
.event-command-frame-dir.active {
  border-color: var(--accent, #4A57D6);
  color: var(--accent, #4A57D6);
  background: var(--accent-muted, rgba(110, 168, 255, 0.16));
}
.event-command-frame-sheet {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}
.event-command-frame-sheet-caption {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
}
.event-command-frame-sheet-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 4px;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 6px;
}
.event-command-frame-sheet-cell {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  min-height: 56px;
  padding: 2px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.event-command-frame-sheet-cell:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-default);
}
.event-command-frame-sheet-cell.active {
  border-color: var(--accent, #4A57D6);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--shadow-pop);
}
.event-command-frame-sheet-cell .event-graphic-preview {
  image-rendering: pixelated;
  background-color: var(--bg-surface);
  flex: none;
}
.event-command-frame-door-seq {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}
.event-command-frame-door-step.active {
  border-color: var(--accent, #4A57D6);
  color: var(--accent, #4A57D6);
  background: var(--accent-muted, rgba(110, 168, 255, 0.16));
}
.event-command-frame-absolute-input {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}
/* setEventGraphicPattern reuses page graphic (RM2003) picker chrome */
.event-command-frame-editor.event-graphic-rm-picker {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  min-width: 0;
  width: 100%;
}
.event-command-frame-target-row {
  display: grid;
  gap: 4px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-command-frame-target-row select {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
}
/* Force full RM grid even inside command body (override part-3 auto-fit). */
.event-command-frame-editor .event-graphic-picker-frame {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: 220px minmax(0, 1fr) !important;
  gap: 10px;
  min-height: 360px;
  align-items: start;
}
.event-command-frame-editor .event-graphic-resource-list {
  max-height: 420px;
  min-height: 320px;
  overflow-y: auto;
}
.event-command-frame-editor .event-graphic-right-pane {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 56px !important;
  gap: 8px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-command-frame-editor .event-graphic-preview-panel {
  grid-column: 1 / 3;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, 48px);
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 194px;
  max-width: 100%;
  overflow-x: auto;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
}
.event-command-frame-editor .event-graphic-option-area {
  grid-column: 1 / 3;
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(140px, 1fr) 140px !important;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: start;
}
.event-command-frame-editor .event-graphic-radio-group {
  min-height: 90px;
}
.event-command-frame-editor .event-graphic-probe-stack {
  grid-column: 2;
  grid-row: 1 / span 2;
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  align-content: start;
  justify-items: center;
}
.event-command-frame-editor .event-graphic-frame-probe,
.event-command-frame-editor .npc-walk-preview {
  background-color: var(--bg-surface);
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  border: 1px solid var(--event-rm-mid, rgba(42,37,33,.20));
  image-rendering: pixelated;
}
.event-command-frame-door-seq {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}
.event-command-frame-door-seq-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}
.event-command-frame-door-step.active {
  border-color: var(--accent, #4A57D6);
  color: var(--accent, #4A57D6);
  background: var(--accent-muted, rgba(110, 168, 255, 0.16));
}
.event-command-frame-absolute-input,
.event-command-frame-walk-chip[hidden] {
  position: absolute !important;
  width: 1px !important;
  height: 1px !important;
  opacity: 0 !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
}
.ecp-message-control-badge {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: 999px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--shadow-pop);
  color: var(--text-1);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  padding: 3px 8px;
}
.ecp-message-inline-control {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  line-height: 1.2;
  margin: 2px 4px 2px 2px;
  vertical-align: middle;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.ecp-message-body .dialogue-color {
  /* reuse runtime dialogue color classes if present */
}
/* Erase Event (플레이 중 이벤트 지우기) */
.m2-erase-event-body {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.m2-erase-event-card .m2-command-intent-title {
  color: var(--oprn-command-blue, #4A57D6);
  font-weight: 700;
}
.m2-erase-event-field {
  align-items: start;
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px 12px;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(72px, 88px) minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.m2-erase-event-label {
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
  font: 700 12px/1.3 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  padding-top: 8px;
}
.m2-erase-event-preview {
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 35%, var(--border-default, rgba(42,37,33,.20)));
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 8%, transparent);
}
.m2-erase-event-preview-title {
  font: 700 12px/1.35 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
}
.m2-erase-event-preview-sub {
  margin-top: 4px;
  font: 600 11px/1.4 Tahoma, "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
  color: var(--text-dim, #6B5F52);
}
.ecp-shop-empty-warn {
  color: var(--text-1);
  font: 700 12px/1.35 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  margin: 6px 0 4px;
}
/* page3 map/presentation FX stages */
.ecp-fx-screen {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 240px;
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  overflow: hidden;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
}
.ecp-fx-label {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  font: 700 13px/1.2 Tahoma, "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
  color: var(--text-1);
  text-shadow: 0 1px 3px var(--shadow-pop);
  text-align: center;
  padding: 0 8px;
}
.ecp-fx-caption {
  font: 500 11px/1.35 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
  text-align: center;
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.ecp-lighting-stage,
.ecp-light-source-stage,
.ecp-weather-stage,
.ecp-animation-stage,
.ecp-tile-stage,
.ecp-input-wait-stage {
  place-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 10px 8px 12px;
}
.ecp-lighting-screen {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-surface) 0%, var(--bg-surface) 100%);
}
.ecp-lighting-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 1;
}
.ecp-light-source-screen {
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 55%, var(--bg-surface) 0%, var(--bg-surface) 75%);
}
.ecp-light-glow {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 55%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  width: 48%;
  height: 48%;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--bg-surface) 0%, var(--bg-surface) 45%, transparent 70%);
  filter: blur(1px);
  z-index: 1;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.ecp-light-glow.off {
  width: 36%;
  height: 36%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--bg-surface) 0%, transparent 70%);
  opacity: 0.5;
}
.ecp-light-source-off .ecp-fx-label {
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.ecp-weather-screen {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-surface) 0%, var(--bg-surface) 100%);
}
.ecp-weather-particles {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  pointer-events: none;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.ecp-weather-drop {
  position: absolute;
  display: block;
  width: 2px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 1px;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  opacity: 0.85;
}
.ecp-weather-particles-rain .ecp-weather-drop,
.ecp-weather-particles-storm .ecp-weather-drop {
  width: 2px;
  height: 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, var(--bg-surface));
  transform: rotate(18deg);
}
.ecp-weather-particles-storm .ecp-weather-drop {
  height: 16px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, var(--bg-surface));
  box-shadow: 0 0 4px var(--shadow-pop);
}
.ecp-weather-particles-snow .ecp-weather-drop {
  width: 5px;
  height: 5px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  box-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
}
.ecp-weather-particles-fog .ecp-weather-drop {
  width: 28px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  filter: blur(2px);
}
.ecp-weather-none .ecp-weather-screen {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-surface) 0%, var(--bg-surface) 100%);
}
.ecp-weather-none .ecp-fx-label {
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.ecp-animation-screen {
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, var(--bg-surface) 0%, var(--bg-surface) 75%);
}
.ecp-anim-ring {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  width: 56%;
  height: 56%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid var(--border-default);
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--shadow-pop), inset 0 0 10px var(--shadow-pop);
  z-index: 1;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.ecp-anim-ring-inner {
  width: 32%;
  height: 32%;
  border-color: var(--border-default);
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--shadow-pop);
}
.ecp-tile-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 12%, var(--bg-inset, #EFE9DC));
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 40%, rgba(42,37,33,.20));
}
.ecp-tile-swatch {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    45deg,
    var(--bg-surface) 0 6px,
    var(--bg-surface) 6px 12px
  );
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  color: var(--text-1);
  font: 700 14px/1 Tahoma, "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
}
.ecp-tile-meta {
  font: 600 12px/1.3 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
}
.ecp-input-wait-stage {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
}
.ecp-input-wait-key {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 52px;
  height: 52px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 45%, rgba(42,37,33,.20));
  font-size: 24px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
/* 동료 · 전투 저작면 프리뷰 — 트룹 카드 / 파티 얼굴 칩 / HP·MP·EXP 게이지.
   계획: .omo/plans/event-editor-actor-battle-adversarial-review.md
   토큰 규칙: 전경(글자·게이지 채움)은 표면과 대비를 갖는다. 배경색과 같은 색 배지는 금지. */
/* ── 트룹 카드 ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.ecp-troop-card {
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 6px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default, rgba(42, 37, 33, 0.2));
  background: var(--bg-raised, #FFFDF8);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--border-subtle, rgba(42, 37, 33, 0.12));
}
.ecp-troop-card-name {
  font: 700 13px/1.3 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
  text-align: center;
}
.ecp-battle-enemy-missing {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px dashed var(--border-strong, rgba(42, 37, 33, 0.45));
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-raised, #FFFDF8) 88%, transparent);
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
  font: 700 12px/1.35 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;

.ecp-faceset-change-slot { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.ecp-faceset-change-title {

}
.ecp-actor-name-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;

  font: 700 14px/1.3 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;

/* 화면 효과(Screen Effect) 프리뷰 — 미니 모니터 스테이지 + 재생 컨트롤 + 색 값 피커.

   회귀 배경(적대적 QA `.omo/evidence/screen-fx-2/qa-before.md` D1/D2):
   `.ecp-screen-effect-overlay` / `-screen` / `-stage` 에 대응하는 CSS 가 저장소에 한 줄도 없었다.
   부모 `.ecp-fx-screen` 이 `display:grid; place-items:center` 라 내용 없는 div 는 0 높이로 접히고,
   오버레이 실측 박스가 전 케이스 0×0 · `position: static` 이었다. 배경색 인라인은 정확했으므로
   유닛 테스트는 초록인데 감독 화면만 흰 빈 사각형이었다.

   장면(scene) 색: 에디터 크롬은 쿨 화이트 단색(tokens.css)을 지키고, **스테이지 안쪽은 게임 출력의
   시뮬레이션**이므로 색을 쓴다. 임의 색을 흩뿌리지 않도록 아래 한 블록에 장면 토큰으로 모아 정의하고
   규칙에서는 var() 만 참조한다. */
.ecp-screen-effect-stage {
  /* 장면 토큰 — 이 스테이지가 흉내 내는 "게임 화면"의 팔레트. 여기서만 정의한다. */
  --ecp-scene-sky-top: #8FC4E8;
  --ecp-scene-sky-bottom: #DCEBF5;
  --ecp-scene-sun: #FFF3C4;
  --ecp-scene-hill-far: #7FB08A;
  --ecp-scene-hill-near: #4F8A5B;
  --ecp-scene-ground: #C9A46B;
  --ecp-scene-path: #E4CB9B;
  /* 재생 전이 — duration 은 screenEffectStage() 가 clampMs 값으로 인라인 주입한다. */
  --ecp-fx-duration: 300ms;
  /* 페이드 초반이 완만해서 "덮이기 시작하는" 순간이 눈에 남는다. */
  --ecp-fx-ease: cubic-bezier(0.55, 0.06, 0.68, 0.19);

  display: grid;
  justify-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-2);
  padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-2);
}
.ecp-screen-effect-screen {
  /* 미니 모니터 — .ecp-fx-screen 이 비율/오버플로를 주고 여기서 베젤과 배경을 얹는다. */
  position: relative;
  background: var(--ecp-scene-sky-bottom);
  border-radius: var(--radius-m);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--bg-raised), var(--shadow-pop);
}
/* 가짜 게임 화면: 하늘 → 해 → 먼 언덕 → 가까운 언덕 → 땅 → 길. */
.ecp-screen-effect-scene {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, var(--ecp-scene-sun) 0 7%, transparent 8%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 34% 16% at 26% 66%, var(--ecp-scene-hill-near) 0 99%, transparent 100%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 44% 13% at 72% 65%, var(--ecp-scene-hill-far) 0 99%, transparent 100%),
    linear-gradient(
      to bottom,
      transparent 0 68%,
      var(--ecp-scene-ground) 68% 100%
    ),
    linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--ecp-scene-sky-top) 0%, var(--ecp-scene-sky-bottom) 68%);
}
/* 길 — 아래에서 위로 좁아지는 사다리꼴. */
.ecp-screen-effect-scene::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 68% 0 0 0;
  background: var(--ecp-scene-path);
  clip-path: polygon(42% 0, 58% 0, 78% 100%, 22% 100%);
  opacity: 0.85;
}
.ecp-screen-effect-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  pointer-events: none;
  /* 재생: 시작 상태로 점프(is-fx-from, transition 없음) → 다음 프레임에 도착 상태로 전이. */
  transition: opacity var(--ecp-fx-duration) var(--ecp-fx-ease);
}
.ecp-screen-effect-overlay.is-fx-from {
  transition: none;
}
/* 색조 제거(neutral) — 색을 칠하는 것이 아니라 걷어내는 상태. */
.ecp-screen-effect-overlay.is-fx-neutral {
  backdrop-filter: grayscale(1) contrast(0.92);
}
/* 라벨은 오버레이(검정~흰색 무엇이든) 위에 얹히니 자체 배경으로 대비를 확보한다. */
.ecp-screen-effect-stage .ecp-fx-label {
  z-index: 2;
  padding: var(--space-1) var(--space-2);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--bg-glass);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--border-subtle);
}
.ecp-screen-effect-play {
  appearance: none;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--control-bg);
  color: var(--text-1);
  font: 700 12px/1 var(--font-ui);
  padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast);
}
.ecp-screen-effect-play:hover {
  background: var(--control-bg-hover);
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}
.ecp-screen-effect-play:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--focus-outline);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
.ecp-screen-effect-stage[data-play-state="playing"] .ecp-screen-effect-play {
  background: var(--accent-muted);
  border-color: var(--accent-border);
}
.ecp-screen-effect-error {
  max-width: 240px;
  color: var(--danger);
  font: 600 11px/1.4 var(--font-ui);
  text-align: center;
}
/* ── 값(색) 필드 — 텍스트 단독이던 입력에 네이티브 피커와 프리셋 스와치를 붙인다(D3). ── */
.m2-screen-color-field {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-2);
}
.m2-screen-color-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-2);
}
.m2-screen-color-row input[type="text"] {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-width: 0;
}
.m2-screen-color-picker {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  inline-size: 40px;
  block-size: 28px;
  padding: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  background: var(--bg-raised);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.m2-screen-color-swatches {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--space-1);
}
.m2-screen-color-swatch {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-1);
  padding: var(--space-1) var(--space-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--control-bg);
  color: var(--text-2);
  font: 600 11px/1 var(--font-ui);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.m2-screen-color-swatch:hover {
  background: var(--control-bg-hover);
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.m2-screen-color-swatch[aria-pressed="true"] {
  border-color: var(--accent-border);
  background: var(--accent-muted);
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.m2-screen-color-swatch::before {
  content: "";
  inline-size: 10px;
  block-size: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  background: var(--m2-swatch-color, transparent);
}
.m2-screen-color-swatch:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--focus-outline);
  outline-offset: 1px;
}
.m2-field-error {
  color: var(--danger);
  font: 600 11px/1.4 var(--font-ui);
}
.m2-field-note {
  color: var(--text-3);
  font: 500 11px/1.4 var(--font-ui);
}
.m2-field-note.is-invalid {
  color: var(--danger);
}
.m2-number-field {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-1);
}
/* ── 의도 카드 + 시간 프리셋 칩 (D6) ─────────────────────────────────
   `날씨 설정` 모달은 의도 카드·프리셋 칩·슬라이더를 갖는데 화면 효과는 필드 3줄뿐이었다.
   카드 자체는 기존 `.m2-command-intent-card` 를 그대로 쓰고, 여기서는 배치만 얹는다. */
.m2-screen-effect-intent {
  margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
}
.m2-screen-effect-duration-presets {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--space-1);
  margin-top: var(--space-2);
}
.m2-screen-effect-duration-chip {
  padding: var(--space-1) var(--space-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--control-bg);
  color: var(--text-2);
  font: 600 11px/1 var(--font-ui);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast);
}
.m2-screen-effect-duration-chip:hover {
  background: var(--control-bg-hover);
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.m2-screen-effect-duration-chip[aria-pressed="true"] {
  border-color: var(--accent-border);
  background: var(--accent-muted);
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.m2-screen-effect-duration-chip:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--focus-outline);
  outline-offset: 1px;
}
/* 값을 읽지 않는 효과(fadeIn/fadeOut)에서는 `값` 행을 감춘다 — .field 는 flex/grid 라
   [hidden] 이 display 규칙에 져서 그냥 두면 계속 보인다(D9). */
.event-editor .field[data-testid="m2-screen-effect-value-field"][hidden] {
  display: none !important;
}
/* ── 인라인 인스펙터 프리뷰 (D5) ──────────────────────────────────────
   행 한 번 클릭으로 열리는 인스펙터에는 프리뷰가 없었고 `↻ 미리보기 새로고침` 은
   빈 패널을 다시 그렸다. 편집 모달과 같은 스테이지를 여기에도 둔다. */
.event-editor .event-inspector-preview {
  padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-2) 0;
}
.event-editor .event-inspector-preview .event-command-preview {
  max-inline-size: 100%;
}
/* 빠른 저작(탭 1) 저작면 — 말하기 샘플 무대 / 숫자 입력 칩 / 대기 타임라인 / 상점 카탈로그 접기.
   계획: .omo/plans/event-editor-quick-authoring-adversarial-review.md
   원칙: 미리보기는 식별 가능해야 한다. 같은 숫자를 두 번 쓴 요약 카드는 미리보기가 아니다. */
/* ── 말하기: 빈 본문이어도 샘플 대사가 창에 보인다 ─────────────── */
.ecp-message-sample-note {
  margin-top: 6px;
  padding: 3px 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px dashed var(--border-strong, rgba(42, 37, 33, 0.4));
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-raised, #FFFDF8) 92%, transparent);
  color: var(--text-2, #5B5347);
  font: 600 11px/1.4 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  text-align: center;
}
.ecp-message-window[data-sample="true"] .ecp-message-body {
  opacity: 0.92;
}
/* ── 고르기: 변수 표시명이 자리수 미리보기를 삼키지 않는다 ───────── */
.ecp-number-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.ecp-number-meta-digits {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.ecp-number-meta-variable {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  padding: 1px 6px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(42, 37, 33, 0.18));
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-raised, #FFFDF8) 90%, transparent);
  color: var(--text-2, #5B5347);
}
/* ── 흐름: 대기는 타임라인이다 ───────────────────────────────── */
.ecp-wait-timeline {
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}
.ecp-wait-rail {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}
.ecp-wait-node {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default, rgba(42, 37, 33, 0.2));
  background: var(--bg-raised, #FFFDF8);
  color: var(--text-2, #5B5347);
  font: 600 11px/1.3 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.ecp-wait-span {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 24px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, rgba(42, 37, 33, 0.4));
  background: linear-gradient(
    to right,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #C2703D) 26%, transparent) var(--wait-span, 40%),
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-raised, #FFFDF8) 92%, transparent) var(--wait-span, 40%)
  );
}
.ecp-wait-span.is-variable {
  border-style: dashed;
}
.ecp-wait-span-label {
  font: 700 12px/1.2 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
}
.ecp-wait-ticks {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--text-3, #7A705F);
  font: 500 10px/1.2 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
.ecp-wait-tick.is-passed {

}
/* ── 거래: 자료집 카탈로그는 접혀서 시작한다 ─────────────────── */
.shop-processing-catalog-fold {
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(42, 37, 33, 0.18));
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-raised, #FFFDF8) 94%, transparent);
  padding: 4px 8px;
}
.shop-processing-catalog-summary {
  cursor: pointer;
  font: 600 12px/1.6 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  color: var(--text-2, #5B5347);
}
/* fold 는 <details> 가 아니라 <div>.is-open 이다(::details-content 가 안쪽 flex 스크롤러를
   무력화해서 갈아탰다). 예전 `:not([open])` 은 div 에 [open] 이 영원히 안 붙으니 항상 참이 되어
   카탈로그를 display:none 으로 죽였다 — 실측 rect 0×0, scrollHeight 0, 179행 전부 도달 불가. */
.shop-processing-catalog-fold:not(.is-open) .shop-processing-catalog {
  display: none;
}
/* ── 진입 CTA: 말하기 / 장소 옮기기 / 상점 열기 ─────────────── */
.event-storyboard-quick-starts {

  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;

}
.event-storyboard-quick-start {

  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 2px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default, rgba(42, 37, 33, 0.22));
  background: var(--bg-raised, #FFFDF8);

  text-align: left;
}
.event-storyboard-quick-start:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent, #C2703D);
}
.event-storyboard-quick-start-label {
  font: 700 13px/1.3 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
}
.event-storyboard-quick-start-hint {
  font: 500 11px/1.3 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  color: var(--text-2, #5B5347);
}
/* 지도 · 화면 효과(탭 3) 저작면 — 효과 프레임 무대 / 카메라 뷰포트 / 칩셋 지형 변경.
   계획: .omo/plans/event-editor-map-screen-effects-adversarial-review.md
   원칙: 화면을 칠하는 명령은 화면을 보여 준다. 파라미터를 나열한 토큰 카드는 미리보기가 아니다. */
/* ── 효과 프레임: 시작 → 중간 → 끝 미니 캔버스 ─────────────────── */
.ecp-fx-frames-stage {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 10px 8px 12px;
}
.ecp-fx-frames {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 6px;
  width: 100%;
}
.ecp-fx-frame {
  /* 세 프레임이 한 줄에 들어간다 — 좁은 프리뷰 열에서도 시작/중간/끝을 나란히 본다. */
  flex: 1 1 0;
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
}
.ecp-fx-canvas {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 128px;
  height: auto;
  border-radius: 5px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default, rgba(42, 37, 33, 0.28));
  background: var(--bg-inset, #EFE9DC);
  image-rendering: pixelated;
}
.ecp-fx-frame-label {
  font: 600 10px/1.3 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
}
.ecp-fx-warning {
  margin-top: 2px;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--warn-border, rgba(176, 96, 24, 0.45));
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn-bg, #F7E4C9) 80%, transparent);
  color: var(--warn-text, #7A4408);
  font: 700 11px/1.4 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  text-align: center;
}
/* 1024px 셸에서도 세 프레임을 유지한다 — 프레임 폭만 줄어든다. */
@media (max-width: 1180px) {
  .ecp-fx-frames {
    gap: 4px;
  }
}
/* ── 지형 변경: 칩셋 크롭 + 같은 줄 팔레트 ─────────────────────── */
.ecp-tile-chipsel-stage {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 12px 10px 14px;
}
.ecp-tile-chipsel-main {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.ecp-tile-chipsel-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 3px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.ecp-tile-chipsel-title {
  font: 700 13px/1.3 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
}
.ecp-tile-chipsel-place {
  font: 500 11px/1.35 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
}
.ecp-tile-chip {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 5px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default, rgba(42, 37, 33, 0.28));
  background-color: var(--bg-inset, #EFE9DC);
  image-rendering: pixelated;
}
.ecp-tile-chip.is-selected {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #4A57D6);
  outline-offset: 1px;
}
.ecp-tile-chip.is-empty {
  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(
    45deg,
    var(--bg-surface, #FFFDF8) 0 5px,
    var(--bg-inset, #EFE9DC) 5px 10px
  );
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
  width: 56px;
  height: 56px;
}
.ecp-tile-chip-empty-mark {
  font: 700 18px/1 Tahoma, "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
}
.ecp-tile-chip-strip {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 5px 6px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-inset, #EFE9DC) 70%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(42, 37, 33, 0.18));
}
.ecp-tile-chip-strip-item.is-empty {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
}
/* cream studio */
:root {
  /* Six coordinated families keep related commands together while category badges
     provide the second, non-color cue. Values stay dark enough on the cream UI. */
  /* 분류색 6종(2026-09-03 제안서 §13). 대화·흐름·보상·시스템은 토큰을 그대로 쓰고, 지도·화면만
     고유색이다. 소리는 화면과, 전투·동료·도구는 시스템과 같은 색 — 막대·아이콘·팔레트 칩에만 쓰고
     텍스트에는 쓰지 않는다(대비). 여섯 색 모두 순백 위 4.5:1 이상. */
  --cmdcat-dialogue: var(--accent);
  --cmdcat-flow: var(--warning);
  --cmdcat-map: #0F7490;
  --cmdcat-reward: var(--success);
  --cmdcat-sound: var(--cmdcat-screen);
  --cmdcat-actor: var(--cmdcat-system);
  --cmdcat-screen: #7A3E9D;
  --cmdcat-system: var(--text-3);
  --cmdcat-battle: var(--cmdcat-system);
  --cmdcat-modern: var(--cmdcat-system);
}
/* ---- [중간-1] 커맨드 리스트: 카테고리 색 레일 + kind 아이콘 ---- */
.cmd-item[data-command-category="dialogue"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-dialogue); }
.cmd-item[data-command-category="flow"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-flow); }
.cmd-item[data-command-category="map"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-map); }
.cmd-item[data-command-category="reward"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-reward); }
.cmd-item[data-command-category="sound"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-sound); }
.cmd-item[data-command-category="actor"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-actor); }
.cmd-item[data-command-category="screen"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-screen); }
.cmd-item[data-command-category="system"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-system); }
.cmd-item[data-command-category="battle"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-battle); }
.cmd-item[data-command-category="modern"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-modern); }
.cmd-item[data-command-category] > .cmd-head {
  box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--cmdcat, transparent) 78%, transparent);
}
.cmd-cat-icon {
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--cmdcat, var(--text-dim, currentColor));
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font-size: 10px;
  height: 16px;
  justify-content: center;
  line-height: 16px;
  opacity: 0.9;
  width: 13px;
}
/* 글리프는 생성 콘텐츠로 — 줄 textContent/접근성 이름을 오염시키지 않는다. */
.cmd-cat-icon::before {
  content: attr(data-glyph);
}
/* depth 가이드/레일은 event-editor.modern.css 스레드 레일이 SSOT.
   여기서 약한 16px 밴드를 다시 그리면 parent/child 대비가 뭉개진다. */
/* ---- [높음-1/중간-5] 커맨드 피커: 검색/아이콘/스티키 푸터/범례 ---- */
.event-subdialog-backdrop[data-testid="event-command-picker"] .event-subdialog-body {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: auto auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 14px 16px 12px;
}
.event-subdialog-backdrop[data-testid="event-command-picker"] .event-subdialog-window {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  height: min(860px, calc(100vh - 36px));
  max-height: calc(100vh - 36px);
  width: min(860px, calc(100vw - 36px));
}
.event-subdialog-backdrop[data-testid="event-command-picker"] .event-command-picker-panel {
  /* 220px 바닥값 때문에 검색 결과가 1건이어도 리스트가 항상 220px 이상 자리를 잡고
     그 아래가 통째로 빈 검은 공백이 됐다. 바닥을 없애고 천장만 둔다 —
     결과가 적으면 모달이 같이 줄고, 많으면 여기서 스크롤한다. */
  background:
    linear-gradient(var(--event-popup-surface) 30%, transparent) center top / 100% 16px no-repeat local,
    linear-gradient(transparent, var(--event-popup-surface) 70%) center bottom / 100% 22px no-repeat local;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow-y: auto;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  padding: 0 8px 28px 0;
  scrollbar-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-muted) 55%, transparent) transparent;
  scrollbar-gutter: stable;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
}
.event-subdialog-backdrop[data-testid="event-command-picker"] .event-command-picker-panel::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 9px;
}
.event-subdialog-backdrop[data-testid="event-command-picker"] .event-command-picker-panel::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-muted) 55%, transparent);
  background-clip: padding-box;
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 999px;
}
.event-command-picker-search-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding-bottom: 10px;
}
.event-command-picker-search {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  font: 500 13px/19px var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif);
  min-height: 36px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-command-picker-view-toggle {
  background: var(--surface-panel, var(--bg-raised));
  border: 1px solid var(--border-soft, var(--border-subtle));
  border-radius: 6px;
  color: var(--text-muted, var(--text-2));
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font: 650 11px/16px var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif);
  padding: 4px 10px;
}
.event-command-picker-view-toggle[aria-pressed="true"] {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 60%, transparent);
  color: var(--accent, var(--text-1));
}
.event-command-picker-tab {
  align-items: center;
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 5px;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 34px;
  padding-inline: 16px;
}
.event-command-picker-tab::before {
  content: attr(data-glyph);
  font-size: 11px;
  opacity: 0.75;
}
.event-command-picker-group-heading[data-category="dialogue"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-dialogue); }
.event-command-picker-group-heading[data-category="flow"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-flow); }
.event-command-picker-group-heading[data-category="map"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-map); }
.event-command-picker-group-heading[data-category="reward"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-reward); }
.event-command-picker-group-heading[data-category="sound"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-sound); }
.event-command-picker-group-heading[data-category="actor"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-actor); }
.event-command-picker-group-heading[data-category="screen"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-screen); }
.event-command-picker-group-heading[data-category="system"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-system); }
.event-command-picker-group-heading[data-category="battle"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-battle); }
.event-command-picker-group-heading[data-category="modern"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-modern); }
.event-command-picker-group-heading::before {
  align-items: center;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--cmdcat, var(--text-dim)) 18%, transparent);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--cmdcat, var(--text-dim, currentColor));
  content: attr(data-glyph);
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font-size: 10px;
  height: 16px;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 16px;
}
.event-command-picker-command[data-category="dialogue"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-dialogue); }
.event-command-picker-command[data-category="flow"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-flow); }
.event-command-picker-command[data-category="map"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-map); }
.event-command-picker-command[data-category="reward"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-reward); }
.event-command-picker-command[data-category="sound"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-sound); }
.event-command-picker-command[data-category="actor"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-actor); }
.event-command-picker-command[data-category="screen"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-screen); }
.event-command-picker-command[data-category="system"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-system); }
.event-command-picker-command[data-category="battle"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-battle); }
.event-command-picker-command[data-category="modern"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-modern); }
.event-command-picker-command-icon {
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--cmdcat, var(--text-dim, currentColor));
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font-size: 10px;
  height: 16px;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-right: 7px;
  opacity: 0.9;
  width: 16px;
}
.event-command-picker-command-icon::before {
  content: attr(data-glyph);
}
.event-command-picker-page-chip {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-dim, #6B5F52) 14%, transparent);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--text-dim, var(--text-2));
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font: 700 10px/14px var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif);
  margin-left: 6px;
  padding: 0 4px;
}
.event-command-picker-no-result {
  padding: 18px 6px;
  text-align: center;
}
/* ---- DB 동료 로스터(탭2 상단, 이미지 리치) ---- */
.event-command-picker-companions {
  border: 1px solid var(--border-soft, var(--border-subtle));
  border-radius: 8px;
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 8px;
}
.event-command-picker-companions-title {
  color: var(--text-2);

  margin: 0;

.event-command-picker-companions-grid {

.event-subdialog-backdrop[data-testid="event-command-picker"] .event-command-picker-footer {

.event-command-picker-grid.icon-grid .event-command-picker-command-icon {

  height: 24px;
  margin-right: 0;
  width: 24px;
}
.event-command-picker-grid.icon-grid .event-command-picker-command {
  position: relative;
}
.event-command-picker-grid.icon-grid .event-command-picker-command-label {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font-size: 11px;

/* ---- [P1] 커맨드 리스트 인라인 썸네일 (16px 상한 — 줄 높이 불변) ---- */
.cmd-thumb {

[data-testid="cmd-speaker-face"] {

/* ---- 문장 표시: 게임 미리보기 + 쉬운 작성 + 접힌 고급 제어문자 ---- */
.event-command-text-editor {

  gap: 12px;

  min-width: 0;
  width: 100%;

.event-command-text-preview-card,
.event-command-text-compose-card {

  min-width: 0;
}
.event-command-text-preview-card {

  overflow: hidden;
}
.event-command-text-section-head {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 10px 12px 8px;
}
.event-command-text-section-head > div {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-command-text-section-head strong {
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
  font: 750 12px/1.25 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
.event-command-text-section-head div > span {
  color: var(--text-3, #766C60);
  font: 500 10.5px/1.35 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
.event-command-text-live-chip {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success, #258A62) 13%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--success, #258A62) 34%, transparent);
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: var(--success, #258A62);
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font: 800 8px/1 var(--font-mono, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace);
  letter-spacing: .12em;
  padding: 4px 6px;
}
.event-command-text-preview-canvas {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(42,37,33,.12));
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 10px;
}
.event-command-text-preview-canvas .event-command-preview {
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 0;
  gap: 7px;
  min-height: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
.event-command-text-preview-canvas .ecp-caption {
  display: none;
}
.event-command-text-preview-canvas .ecp-stage {
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 10;
  min-height: 150px;
}
.event-command-text-preview-canvas .ecp-message-window {
  background: var(--runtime-dialogue-glass-surface, rgba(8, 15, 28, .94));
}
.event-command-text-preview-canvas .ecp-message-speaker-nameplate {
  background: var(--runtime-dialogue-glass-surface-strong, rgba(11, 21, 38, .98));
}
.event-command-text-compose-card {
  background: var(--bg-raised, #FFFDF8);
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 12px;
}
.event-command-text-speaker-field,
.event-command-text-body-field {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-command-text-speaker-field input,
.event-command-text-editor textarea {
  background: var(--bg-inset, #EFE9DC);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default, rgba(42,37,33,.20));
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
  min-width: 0;
  width: 100%;
}
.event-command-text-speaker-field input {
  font: 600 12px/1.4 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  padding: 8px 10px;
}
.event-command-text-speaker-field small {
  color: var(--text-3, #766C60);
  font: 500 10px/1.3 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
.event-command-text-editor textarea {
  font: 500 13px/1.65 var(--font-ui, Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif);
  min-height: 138px;
  padding: 11px 12px;
  resize: vertical;
}
.event-command-text-speaker-field input:focus,
.event-command-text-editor textarea:focus {
  border-color: var(--accent, #4A57D6);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 14%, transparent);
  outline: none;
}
.event-command-text-body-heading,
.event-command-text-tools-heading,
.event-command-text-presentation-heading {
  align-items: baseline;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px 10px;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
.event-command-text-body-heading .event-command-text-limit-hint {
  margin: 0;
  text-align: right;
}
.event-command-text-easy-tools {
  display: grid;
  gap: 7px;
}
.event-command-text-tools-heading > span:last-child,
.event-command-text-presentation-heading > span:last-child {
  color: var(--text-3, #766C60);
  font: 500 10px/1.35 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
/* 「말투·연출」은 접힌 고급 옵션에서 승격된 자리다. 문장 도구와 같은 층으로 보이게 둔다. */
.event-command-text-presentation-field {
  display: grid;
  gap: 7px;
}
.event-command-text-tools-row {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr));
}
.event-command-text-tool {
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--bg-inset, #EFE9DC);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(42,37,33,.16));
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: grid;
  gap: 4px;
  justify-items: center;
  min-height: 54px;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 6px 4px;
}
.event-command-text-tool:hover {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 8%, var(--bg-raised, #FFFDF8));
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 42%, var(--border-subtle, rgba(42,37,33,.16)));
  color: var(--accent, #4A57D6);
}
.event-command-text-tool:active {
  transform: translateY(1px);
}
.event-command-text-tool-glyph {
  font: 800 15px/1 var(--font-mono, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace);
}
.event-command-text-tool-label {
  font: 700 9.5px/1.2 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  text-align: center;
}
.event-command-text-advanced,
.event-command-text-control-details {
  background: var(--bg-inset, #EFE9DC);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(42,37,33,.16));
  border-radius: 8px;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.event-command-text-advanced-summary,
.event-command-text-control-summary {
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  font: 700 11px/1.35 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  gap: 8px;
  justify-content: space-between;
  list-style: none;
  padding: 9px 10px;
}
.event-command-text-advanced-summary::-webkit-details-marker,
.event-command-text-control-summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}
.event-command-text-advanced-summary::after,
.event-command-text-control-summary::after {
  color: var(--text-3, #766C60);
  content: "+";
  font: 800 14px/1 var(--font-mono, monospace);
  margin-left: auto;
}
.event-command-text-advanced[open] > summary::after,
.event-command-text-control-details[open] > summary::after {
  content: "−";
}
.event-command-text-control-summary-note {
  background: var(--bg-raised, #FFFDF8);
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: var(--text-3, #766C60);
  font: 600 9px/1 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  margin-left: auto;
  padding: 3px 6px;
}
.event-command-text-advanced[open],
.event-command-text-control-details[open] {
  padding-bottom: 10px;
}
.event-command-text-advanced[open] > :not(summary),
.event-command-text-control-details[open] > :not(summary) {
  margin-inline: 10px;
}
.event-command-text-auto-advance-label {
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
  display: flex;
  font: 600 11px/1.35 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  gap: 5px;
  margin-top: 8px;
}
.event-command-text-control-hint {
  color: var(--text-3, #766C60);
  font: 500 10.5px/1.45 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
.event-command-text-palette {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-command-text-palette-header {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
}
.event-command-text-palette-label {
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
  font: 700 11px/16px "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
}
.event-command-text-palette-sub {
  color: var(--text-dim, var(--text-3, #6B5F52));
  font: 500 11px/1.35 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
.event-command-text-palette-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}
.event-command-text-palette-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 1px;
  min-width: 62px;
  padding: 5px 8px;
  background: var(--surface-panel, var(--bg-raised));
  border: 1px solid var(--border-soft, var(--border-subtle));
  border-radius: 6px;
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.event-command-text-palette-code {
  font: 600 11px/1.2 var(--font-mono, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace);
  color: var(--accent, #4A57D6);
}
.event-command-text-palette-name {
  font: 600 11px/1.2 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
}
.event-command-text-palette-button:hover {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 55%, transparent);
}
.event-command-text-body-field {
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-command-text-body-label {
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
  font: 700 11px/1.2 "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
}
.event-command-text-speaker-hint {
  margin: 6px 0 8px;
  color: var(--text-dim, #6B5F52);
  font: 500 11px/1.4 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
.event-command-edit-columns:has(.event-command-text-editor) {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.event-command-edit-columns:has(.event-command-text-editor) > .event-command-preview-panel {
  display: none;
}
.event-subdialog-window.wide:has(.event-command-text-editor) {
  width: min(940px, calc(100vw - 24px));
}
.event-command-edit-dialog .event-command-text-editor {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(280px, .88fr) minmax(390px, 1.25fr);
}
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .event-command-edit-dialog .event-command-text-editor {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }

  .event-command-text-tools-row {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}
/* ---- [중간-2] 정보 밀도: 좌측 조건 패널 압축 + 안 쓰는 조건 행 시각적 후퇴 ---- */
.event-editor-settings-column {
  scrollbar-width: thin;
}
/* ---- [중간-4] 모달 깊이: 겹친 서브다이얼로그의 블러 중첩 완화 ---- */
.event-subdialog-backdrop {
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px) saturate(1.05);
}
.event-subdialog-backdrop ~ .event-subdialog-backdrop {
  backdrop-filter: none;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
}
/* ---- [P2] 모던 전용 파생 뷰: 라이브 미리보기 / 플로우차트 (기본 접힘) ---- */
/* 보조 도구 본문은 event-editor.modern.css 에서 칩 행 위 absolute 오버레이로 배치.
   인플로우 flex-grow 로 cmd-list 를 밀어내지 않는다. */
.event-editor-commands-column {
  position: relative;
}
.event-page-preview {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  grid-template-rows: auto auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
  padding: 10px 2px 12px;
}
.event-page-preview > .event-script-live-stage {
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: auto;
}
.event-script-preview-disclaimer {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--status-warning, #8A5E00) 10%, var(--surface-recessed, var(--bg-raised)));
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--status-warning, #8A5E00) 42%, var(--border-soft, var(--border-subtle)));
  border-radius: 6px;
  color: var(--text-2);
  font: 600 11px/1.45 var(--font-ui);
  padding: 7px 9px;
}
.event-command-empty-experience {
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: 200px;
  place-content: center;
  padding: 18px;
  border: 1px dashed var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
}
.event-command-empty-copy {
  display: grid;
  gap: 3px;
}
.event-command-template-actions {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
}
.event-command-template-button {
  background: var(--surface-panel, var(--bg-raised));
  border: 1px solid var(--border-soft, var(--border-subtle));
  border-radius: 6px;
  color: var(--text-1);
  cursor: pointer;
  min-height: 34px;
  padding: 6px 8px;
}
.event-command-template-button:hover,
.event-command-template-button:focus-visible {
  border-color: var(--accent, var(--accent-border));
}
.event-command-issue-badge,
.event-page-validation-badge {
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
  border-radius: 999px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font: 800 9px/13px var(--font-ui);
  min-width: 17px;
  padding: 0 3px;
  text-align: center;
}
.event-command-issue-badge.error,
.event-page-validation-badge.error { color: var(--danger, #C6403D); }
.event-command-issue-badge.warning,
.event-page-validation-badge.warning { color: var(--status-warning, #8A5E00); }
.event-command-issue-badge.info { color: var(--accent, #4A57D6); }
.event-page-validation-badge::before { content: attr(data-label); }
.event-page-validation-badge.hidden { display: none; }
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .event-command-template-actions { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
}
.event-script-live-controls {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
}
.event-script-live-position {
  color: var(--text-dim, var(--text-2));
  font: 700 11px/16px var(--font-mono, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace);
  margin-left: auto;
}
.event-script-live-stage {
  background: var(--surface-recessed, var(--bg-raised));
  border: 1px solid var(--border-soft, var(--border-subtle));
  border-radius: 6px;
  min-height: 150px;
  padding: 8px;
}
.event-script-live-caption {
  color: var(--text-dim, var(--text-2));
  font: 600 11px/1.4 "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
/* 플로우 보기 — 「이 페이지가 하는 일」 칼럼의 네 번째 보기 방식.
   예전에는 도구 팝오버 안 618×280 오버레이라 미리보기의 재생 컨트롤을 덮고
   최상위 명령 7개 중 2개만 보였다. 이제 형제 보기라서 칼럼 높이를 그대로 쓴다. */
.event-page-flow {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  min-height: 0;
}
.event-page-flow-status {
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--text-2);
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  font: 600 11px/1.5 var(--font-ui);
  gap: 4px 12px;
  padding: 2px 14px 8px;
}
/* 미리보기에서 이어받은 단계. 아직 볼 단계가 없을 때도 자리를 지켜 흔들리지 않는다. */
.event-page-flow-current {
  color: var(--event-modern-accent);
}
.event-flowchart-body {
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: auto;
  padding: 12px 14px 16px;
}
/* 순차 노드를 잇는 세로 스파인 — 흐름 방향(위→아래)을 보여주는 레일.
   노드가 왼쪽 정렬되므로 고정 x(아이콘 포트 중심)에 둬 모든 노드를 관통한다. */
.event-flow-column {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  justify-items: start;
  position: relative;
}
.event-flow-column::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 11px;
  top: 4px;
  bottom: 4px;
  width: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    var(--border-strong),
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--border-strong) 30%, transparent)
  );
  border-radius: 2px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
}
/* 노드 카드: 평평한 칩이 아니라 떠 있는 카드 + 좌측 컬러 스트립 */
.event-flow-node {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--bg-raised);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--cmdcat, var(--border-strong));
  border-radius: 7px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px var(--shadow-pop);
  display: inline-flex;
  font: 600 11px/16px var(--font-ui);
  gap: 7px;
  max-width: 440px;
  padding: 4px 10px 4px 8px;
  transition: border-color var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast);
}
.event-flow-node:hover {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--cmdcat, var(--accent)) 60%, var(--border-default));
  box-shadow: 0 2px 7px color-mix(in srgb, var(--cmdcat, var(--accent)) 24%, rgba(42,37,33,.10));
}
/* 노드는 인스펙터를 채우는 버튼이다 — UA 버튼 기본값(가운데 정렬·상속 안 되는 색)만 되돌린다. */
.event-flow-node {
  color: var(--text-1);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
}
.event-flow-node:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
/* 미리보기가 보던 단계. 두 보기를 잇는 유일한 표시라 색 하나로는 부족하다 — 링까지 둘러
   스크롤 안에서 눈에 띄게 한다(`aria-current="step"` 도 같이 붙는다). */
.event-flow-node.is-current {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 32%, transparent),
    0 2px 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 22%, transparent);
}
.event-flow-node[data-category="dialogue"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-dialogue); }
.event-flow-node[data-category="flow"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-flow); }
.event-flow-node[data-category="map"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-map); }
.event-flow-node[data-category="reward"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-reward); }
.event-flow-node[data-category="sound"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-sound); }
.event-flow-node[data-category="actor"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-actor); }
.event-flow-node[data-category="screen"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-screen); }
.event-flow-node[data-category="system"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-system); }
.event-flow-node[data-category="battle"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-battle); }
.event-flow-node[data-category="modern"] { --cmdcat: var(--cmdcat-modern); }
/* 아이콘을 컬러 포트(원형)로 — 노드의 입출력 핀 느낌 */
.event-flow-node-icon {
  align-items: center;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--cmdcat, var(--text-3)) 20%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--cmdcat, var(--text-3)) 55%, transparent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  color: var(--cmdcat, var(--text-2));
  display: inline-flex;
  font-size: 10px;
  height: 16px;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 16px;
}
.event-flow-node-text {
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
/* 분기 그룹: 부모 노드에서 드롭되는 서브 플로우 컨테이너.
   width:fit-content 로 상단 버스(보더)가 분기 폭에만 걸치게 한다. */
.event-flow-branches {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  width: fit-content;
  max-width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 14px;
  margin: 4px 0 6px 12px;
  padding: 12px 12px 10px 14px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 5%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-top: 2px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-left: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--cmdcat, var(--accent)) 55%, var(--border-strong));
  border-radius: 8px;
}
/* 부모 스파인 → 분기 버스로 내려오는 드롭 커넥터 */
.event-flow-branches::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: -8px;
  width: 2px;
  height: 10px;
  background: var(--border-strong);
}
.event-flow-branch {
  display: grid;
  gap: 5px;
  min-width: 130px;
  position: relative;
}
/* 버스(컨테이너 상단 보더)에서 각 분기로 내려오는 가지 드롭 */
.event-flow-branch::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: -12px;
  width: 2px;
  height: 12px;
