/* ---- Actor/combat M2 + recover/name modern forms ---- */
.actor-m2-command-body {
  gap: 12px;
  width: 100%;
}
.actor-m2-layout {
  align-items: start;
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.3fr) minmax(220px, 0.9fr);
  min-width: 0;
  width: 100%;
}
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .actor-m2-layout {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
}
.actor-m2-main {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.actor-m2-field {
  display: grid;
  gap: 4px;
}
.actor-m2-field-label,
.actor-m2-presets-label {
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
  font: 700 11px/1.2 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
.actor-m2-presets,
.actor-m2-chip-grid,
.actor-m2-inline {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}
.actor-m2-chip.is-active {
  border-color: var(--accent, #4A57D6);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 40%, transparent);
}
/* 초보자 UX 픽스(2026-08-27 감사): 프리셋 칩의 한글 라벨("기본 바닥" 등)이 좁은
   열에서 글자 단위로 세로로 쪼개져 읽을 수 없었다. 칩은 항상 가로쓰기 + 한 줄 유지. */
.event-command-edit-body .actor-m2-chip,
.actor-m2-chip {
  min-width: fit-content;
  white-space: nowrap;
  writing-mode: horizontal-tb;
}
/* 타일 변경 폼의 실맵 캔버스 미리보기 호스트 */
.change-tile-map-preview {
  background: var(--bg-inset, rgba(0,0,0,.06));
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(42,37,33,.20));
  border-radius: 8px;
  max-height: 280px;
  min-height: 160px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}
.change-tile-map-preview canvas {
  display: block;
  image-rendering: pixelated;
}
.actor-m2-text-input {
  min-width: 180px;
}
.actor-m2-check {
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 8px;
  font: 600 12px/1.2 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
.actor-m2-preview {
  background: var(--bg-raised);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(42,37,33,.20));
  border-radius: 8px;
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
}
.actor-m2-preview-line {
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
  font: 600 12px/1.4 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  margin: 0;
}
.actor-m2-preview-note {
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
  font: 500 11px/1.4 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  margin: 0;
}
.actor-m2-preview-actor,
.actor-m2-preview-copy {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
}
.actor-m2-preview-copy {
  align-items: flex-start;
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
}
.actor-m2-faceset-preview,
.actor-m2-faceset-gallery {
  min-width: 0;
}
/* ---- Page 3 시스템·연출 프리뷰 (색조 / 날씨 / 먼 배경 / 키 입력) ----
   토큰만 사용한다(tokens.css). 사용자가 고른 색은 인라인 --actor-m2-effect-color 로만 들어온다. */
/* P0: 좁은 열에서 한국어 칩이 글자 단위로 쪼개지던 문제. */
.actor-m2-chip {
  min-inline-size: max-content;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.actor-m2-chip-label {
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.actor-m2-field .rich-segment-group {
  justify-self: start;
}
/* 숫자 입력은 값 폭에 맞춰 좁게 — 넓은 입력이 프리뷰 열을 밀어내지 않게. */
.page3-command-body .actor-m2-field input[type="number"] {
  inline-size: 108px;
}
.actor-m2-preview-stage {
  background: var(--bg-inset);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  min-height: 88px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}
.actor-m2-stage-label {
  color: var(--text-2);
  font: 700 10px/1 var(--font-ui);
  text-transform: none;
  z-index: 1;
}
.actor-m2-preview-error {
  color: var(--danger);
  font: 600 11px/1.4 var(--font-ui);
  margin: 0;
}
/* 색조 — 프리셋 색은 06-page-modern-forms.css 의 .page3-tint-preview[data-tint] 규칙을 재사용하고,
   직접 입력 색만 인라인 변수로 얹는다. */
.actor-m2-preview-stage .actor-m2-effect-swatch[data-tint="custom"] {
  background: var(--actor-m2-effect-color, var(--accent));
}
/* 날씨 — 강도를 오버레이 불투명도로 반영(06 의 고정 opacity 를 덮어쓴다). */
.actor-m2-preview-stage .actor-m2-weather-overlay[data-weather] {
  opacity: calc(0.2 + var(--actor-m2-weather-intensity, 0.5) * 0.75);
  transition: opacity var(--transition-med);
}
.actor-m2-preview-stage .actor-m2-weather-overlay[data-weather="none"] {
  opacity: 0;
}
.actor-m2-fog-layer {
  inset: 0;
  opacity: var(--actor-m2-fog-strength, 0.5);
  position: absolute;
}
.actor-m2-fog-layer-far {
  animation: actor-m2-fog-drift 9s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-3) 22%, transparent),
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-raised) 55%, transparent)
  );
}
.actor-m2-fog-layer-near {
  animation: actor-m2-fog-drift 6s ease-in-out infinite alternate-reverse;
  background: radial-gradient(
    120% 70% at 50% 100%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-raised) 75%, transparent),
    transparent 70%
  );
}
@keyframes actor-m2-fog-drift {
  from { transform: translateX(-4%); }
  to { transform: translateX(4%); }
}
.actor-m2-weather-dot {
  block-size: 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: 999px;
  display: inline-block;
  inline-size: 8px;
  margin-inline-end: var(--space-1);
  vertical-align: middle;
}
.actor-m2-weather-dot[data-weather="none"] { background: var(--bg-inset); }
.actor-m2-weather-dot[data-weather="rain"] { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, var(--bg-raised)); }
.actor-m2-weather-dot[data-weather="storm"] { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 80%, var(--text-1)); }
.actor-m2-weather-dot[data-weather="snow"] { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-raised) 72%, var(--accent)); }
.actor-m2-weather-dot[data-weather="fog"] { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-3) 55%, var(--bg-raised)); }
/* 먼 배경 — 와이드 비율 썸네일 + 말줄임 캡션. */
.actor-m2-parallax-preview {
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
}
.actor-m2-parallax-preview-img {
  block-size: 100%;
  display: block;
  inline-size: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}
.actor-m2-parallax-preview-caption {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-raised) 82%, transparent);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  color: var(--text-2);
  font: 600 10px/1.6 var(--font-ui);
  inset-block-end: 0;
  inset-inline: 0;
  margin: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding-inline: var(--space-1);
  position: absolute;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.actor-m2-parallax-preview-empty,
.actor-m2-parallax-preview-missing {
  color: var(--text-3);
  font: 500 11px/1.4 var(--font-ui);
  margin: 0;
  padding: var(--space-2);
  text-align: center;
}
.actor-m2-parallax-preview-missing {
  color: var(--danger);
}
/* 키 입력 — 저장되는 코드 집합을 키캡으로 노출. */
.actor-m2-keycaps {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--space-1);
}
.actor-m2-keycap {
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--bg-raised);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop);
  display: inline-grid;
  gap: 1px;
  justify-items: center;
  padding: var(--space-1) var(--space-2);
}
.actor-m2-keycap-keys {
  color: var(--text-1);
  font: 700 11px/1.2 var(--font-ui);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.actor-m2-keycap-code {
  background: var(--accent-muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  color: var(--text-1);
  font: 700 9px/1.4 var(--font-ui);
  padding-inline: var(--space-1);
}
.actor-m2-keycap-label {
  color: var(--text-2);
  font: 500 10px/1.2 var(--font-ui);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.actor-m2-preview-badges {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--space-1);
}
.actor-m2-preview-badge {
  background: var(--accent-muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  color: var(--text-1);
  font: 600 11px/1.7 var(--font-ui);
  padding-inline: var(--space-2);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
/* 동작 최소화 — 색·강도 정보는 유지하고 움직임만 멈춘다. */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .actor-m2-fog-layer,
  .actor-m2-preview-stage .actor-m2-weather-overlay[data-weather] {
    animation: none;
    transition: none;
  }
}
/* ---- Page 3 맵·연출 modern forms ---- */
/* NOTE: functional preview colors kept (weather/tint/flash/picture/scroll stage grounds, chroma/mix accents) */
.page3-command-body {

}
.page3-layout,

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .page3-layout,
  .page3-command-layout {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
}
.page3-main,
.page3-command-main {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.page3-field {
  display: grid;
  gap: 4px;
}
.page3-field-label,
.page3-presets-label,
.page3-intent-title {

.page3-intent {

  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(42,37,33,.12));
  border-radius: 8px;
  display: grid;
  gap: 4px;

}
.page3-intent-body {
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
  font: 500 12px/1.4 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  margin: 0;
}
.page3-presets,
.page3-chip-grid,
.page3-inline {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}
.page3-chip.is-active {
  border-color: var(--accent, #4A57D6);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 40%, transparent);
}
.page3-text-input {
  min-width: 180px;
}
.page3-check {
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 8px;
  font: 600 12px/1.2 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
.page3-preview,
.page3-command-preview {
  background: var(--bg-raised);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(42,37,33,.12));
  border-radius: 8px;
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
}
.page3-preview-line {
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
  font: 600 12px/1.4 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  margin: 0;
}
.page3-preview-note {
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
  font: 500 11px/1.4 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  margin: 0;
}
/* 미정의 --bg-sunken 크림 fallback 을 쓰면 쿨 화이트 테마에서 무대만 누렇게 떴다 — 토큰으로 정리. */
.page3-preview-stage {
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-inset) 70%, var(--bg-raised)), var(--bg-inset));
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(42,37,33,.12));
  border-radius: 6px;
  min-height: 88px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}
.page3-preview-stage-label {
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
  font: 600 10px/1 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  left: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  position: absolute;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  top: 8px;
}
.page3-weather-preview,
.page3-lighting-preview,
.page3-tint-preview,
.page3-flash-preview,
.page3-shake-preview,
.page3-picture-preview,
.page3-scroll-preview {
  inset: 0;
  position: absolute;
}
.page3-weather-preview[data-weather="rain"] {
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(
      -18deg,
      transparent 0 10px,
      color-mix(in srgb, #8ec8ff 35%, transparent) 10px 11px
    );
  opacity: 0.7;
}
.page3-weather-preview[data-weather="storm"] {
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(
      -22deg,
      transparent 0 8px,
      color-mix(in srgb, #b8d8ff 45%, transparent) 8px 9px
    ),
    radial-gradient(circle at 70% 20%, color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent), transparent 28%);
  opacity: 0.8;
}
.page3-weather-preview[data-weather="snow"] {
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%, #fff 0 1px, transparent 2px),
    radial-gradient(circle at 70% 50%, #fff 0 1.5px, transparent 2.5px),
    radial-gradient(circle at 40% 75%, #fff 0 1px, transparent 2px),
    radial-gradient(circle at 85% 20%, #fff 0 1px, transparent 2px);
  opacity: 0.85;
}
.page3-weather-preview[data-weather="fog"] {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, #c9d4e8 35%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, #9aabbf 45%, transparent));
  opacity: 0.55;
}
.page3-lighting-preview {
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 35%, transparent), transparent 55%);
  mix-blend-mode: screen;
  opacity: 0.65;
}
.page3-tint-preview {
  mix-blend-mode: multiply;
  opacity: 0.55;
}
.page3-tint-preview[data-tint="red"],
.page3-flash-preview[data-flash="red"] { background: #ff6b6b; }
.page3-tint-preview[data-tint="green"] { background: #6bff8a; }
.page3-tint-preview[data-tint="blue"],
.page3-flash-preview[data-flash="blue"] { background: #6b9bff; }
.page3-tint-preview[data-tint="yellow"] { background: #ffe066; }
.page3-tint-preview[data-tint="purple"] { background: #c084fc; }
.page3-tint-preview[data-tint="black"] { background: #111; }
.page3-tint-preview[data-tint="white"],
.page3-flash-preview[data-flash="white"],
.page3-flash-preview[data-flash="flash"] { background: #fff; }
.page3-tint-preview[data-tint="neutral"] { background: var(--text-2); }
.page3-flash-preview {
  animation: page3-flash-pulse 1.1s ease-in-out infinite;
  opacity: 0.35;
}
.page3-shake-preview {
  border: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 55%, transparent);
  border-radius: 4px;
  inset: 18px 22px;
  animation: page3-shake-wobble 0.35s linear infinite;
}
.page3-picture-preview {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 22%, var(--bg-raised));
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 45%, transparent);
  border-radius: 4px;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 16px color-mix(in srgb, rgba(60,48,32,.35) 100%, transparent);
  height: 42px;
  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  width: 58px;
}
.page3-scroll-preview {
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 40%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 40%, transparent) 40% 60%, transparent 60%),
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0 12px, color-mix(in srgb, #fff 8%, transparent) 12px 13px);
  opacity: 0.75;
}
@keyframes page3-flash-pulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.12; }
  50% { opacity: 0.55; }
}
@keyframes page3-shake-wobble {
  0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
  25% { transform: translate(2px, -1px); }
  50% { transform: translate(-2px, 1px); }
  75% { transform: translate(1px, 2px); }
}
/* ---- Page 3 form controls + native preview stages ---- */
.page3-slider-row,
.page3-color-row,
.page3-coord-row,
.page3-resource-row {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  min-width: 0;
  width: 100%;
}
.page3-more-fields {
  border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--line, #d8cbb8) 70%, transparent);
  margin-top: 4px;
  padding-top: 6px;
}
.page3-more-fields > summary {
  color: var(--ink-dim, #6b5e4e);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 12px;
  list-style: none;
}
.page3-more-fields > summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}
.page3-resource-name {
  color: var(--ink, #2a241c);
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  font-size: 13px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.page3-range-input {
  accent-color: var(--accent, #4A57D6);
  flex: 1 1 140px;
  min-width: 120px;
}
.page3-color-swatch {
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(42,37,33,.12));
  border-radius: 6px;
  cursor: pointer;
  height: 32px;
  padding: 0;
  width: 42px;
}
.page3-preview-lighting,
.page3-preview-light,
.page3-preview-weather,
.page3-preview-animation,
.page3-preview-picture {
  min-height: 96px;
}
.page3-preview-lighting-veil {
  inset: 0;
  position: absolute;
}
.page3-preview-lighting-label,
.page3-preview-weather-label {
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
  font: 700 11px/1 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  left: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  position: absolute;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, rgba(60,48,32,.55) 100%, transparent);
  top: 8px;
}
.page3-preview-light-glow {
  border-radius: 999px;
  left: 50%;
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
}
.page3-preview-weather-none {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2a3344, #171c26);
}
.page3-preview-weather-rain {
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(
      -18deg,
      transparent 0 10px,
      color-mix(in srgb, #8ec8ff 35%, transparent) 10px 11px
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #243147, #121820);
}
.page3-preview-weather-storm {
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(
      -22deg,
      transparent 0 8px,
      color-mix(in srgb, #b8d8ff 45%, transparent) 8px 9px
    ),
    radial-gradient(circle at 70% 20%, color-mix(in srgb, #fff 35%, transparent), transparent 28%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #1c2434, #0e1218);
}
.page3-preview-weather-snow {
  background-color: #1a2230;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%, #fff 0 1px, transparent 2px),
    radial-gradient(circle at 70% 50%, #fff 0 1.5px, transparent 2.5px),
    radial-gradient(circle at 40% 75%, #fff 0 1px, transparent 2px),
    radial-gradient(circle at 85% 20%, #fff 0 1px, transparent 2px);
}
.page3-preview-weather-fog {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, #c9d4e8 30%, #1d2533), color-mix(in srgb, #9aabbf 40%, #121820));
}
/* 편집 폼의 그림 마커.
   규칙이 아예 없어서 position: static 이었고, TS 가 넣는 marker.style.left/top 이 무효였다 —
   좌표를 바꿔도 미리보기가 움직이지 않았다.
   앵커는 런타임과 같은 좌상단이다(runtime/pictures.css 의 transform-origin: top left).
   확대·회전·투명도는 TS 가 인라인으로 얹는다. */
.page3-preview-picture-marker {
  max-height: 70%;
  max-width: 70%;
  position: absolute;
  transform-origin: top left;
}
.page3-preview-picture-marker.is-missing {
  border: 1px dashed var(--border-default, #C9BFAE);
  border-radius: 4px;
  display: grid;
  min-height: 40px;
  place-items: center;
  width: 56px;
}
.page3-preview-picture-img {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: contain;
  width: 100%;
}
.page3-preview-picture-missing {
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
  font: 700 12px/1 Inter, "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  left: 50%;
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
}
/* ---- showAnimation 단일 표시면 ----
   고르는 곳과 재생되는 곳이 한 표면에 있다. 스테이지 바탕은 데이터베이스 애니메이션
   스테이지와 같은 어두운 작업 캔버스를 쓴다(같은 애니메이션이 두 얼굴을 갖지 않게).
   셀 배치 프리미티브(.db-animation-stage-cells / -cell-sprite)도 그쪽과 공유한다. */
.page3-anim-surface {
  --page3-anim-ground: #1d2024;
  --page3-anim-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-2);
}
.page3-anim-surface-head {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-2);
  justify-content: space-between;
}
.page3-anim-surface-title {
  color: var(--text-2);
  font: 700 11px/1.2 var(--font-ui);
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  margin: 0;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.page3-anim-play-host {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-1);
}
.page3-anim-preview {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-1);
}
.page3-anim-stage {
  background: var(--page3-anim-ground);
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(90deg, transparent calc(50% - 1px), var(--page3-anim-line) 50%, transparent calc(50% + 1px)),
    linear-gradient(0deg, transparent calc(50% - 1px), var(--page3-anim-line) 50%, transparent calc(50% + 1px));
  border-color: var(--border-default);
  min-height: 136px;
}
.page3-anim-stage .page3-preview-stage-label {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.62);
}
/* 96px 셀이 좁은 미리보기 열에서 잘리지 않게 레이어만 줄인다(셀 인라인 transform 보존). */
.page3-anim-cells {
  scale: 0.8;
}
.page3-anim-stage-note {
  bottom: var(--space-2);
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
  font: 600 10px/1.2 var(--font-ui);
  left: 50%;
  position: absolute;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
/* 프레임이 없는 레코드: 런타임과 같은 섬광을 라벨과 함께 보여 준다(빈 스테이지 금지). */
.page3-anim-fallback-flash {
  animation: page3-anim-fallback-pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 52%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 62%);
  inset: 0;
  position: absolute;
}
.page3-anim-fallback-label {
  border: 1px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  bottom: var(--space-2);
  color: #f4f0e8;
  font: 600 10px/1.3 var(--font-ui);
  left: var(--space-2);
  padding: 3px 6px;
  position: absolute;
  right: var(--space-2);
  text-align: center;
}
@keyframes page3-anim-fallback-pulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.28; }
  50% { opacity: 0.72; }
}
/* ---- AI 그림 생성 큐 (aiImageGenerateField) ---- */
/* 단발 버튼 대신 작업 목록: 만드는 동안에도 프롬프트를 계속 쌓고, 실패해도 프롬프트가
   증발하지 않으며, 취소·재시도를 그 자리에서 한다. 전역 .page3-resource-row 레이아웃은
   그대로 두고 목록 부분만 이 시트가 맡는다. 토큰만 쓰고 hex·!important 없음. */
.ai-image-queue {
  align-items: stretch;
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
}
.ai-image-queue-list {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.ai-image-queue-empty {
  color: var(--text-3);
  font: 400 12px/1.5 var(--font-ui);
  margin: 0;
}
.ai-image-queue-head {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
.ai-image-queue-count {
  color: var(--text-2);
  font: 600 12px/1.4 var(--font-ui);
}
.ai-image-queue-clear {
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  color: var(--text-2);
  cursor: pointer;
  font: 600 12px/1.4 var(--font-ui);
  padding: 2px 4px;
  text-decoration: underline;
}
.ai-image-queue-clear:hover {
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.ai-image-queue-items {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
.ai-image-queue-item {
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--bg-raised);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-m);
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 6px 8px 6px 10px;
}
.ai-image-queue-item.is-running {
  border-color: var(--accent-border);
}
.ai-image-queue-item.is-error {
  border-color: var(--danger);
}
.ai-image-queue-label {
  color: var(--text-1);
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  font: 500 12.5px/1.4 var(--font-ui);
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.ai-image-queue-status {
  color: var(--text-2);
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font: 500 12px/1.4 var(--font-ui);
  max-width: 45%;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.ai-image-queue-item.is-done .ai-image-queue-status {
  color: var(--success);
}
.ai-image-queue-item.is-error .ai-image-queue-status {
  color: var(--danger);
}
.ai-image-queue-cancel,
.ai-image-queue-retry {
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  color: var(--text-2);
  cursor: pointer;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font: 600 12px/1 var(--font-ui);
  height: 26px;
  padding: 0 8px;
}
.ai-image-queue-cancel:hover,
.ai-image-queue-retry:hover {
  background: var(--control-bg-hover);
  color: var(--text-1);
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .page3-anim-fallback-flash {
    animation: none;
    opacity: 0.5;
  }
}
/* 이모트 선택 격자 — 실제 시트를 배경으로 깔아 그림으로 고르게 한다.
   확대 배율은 정수(3배)여야 한다. 소수 배율이면 16px 픽셀아트가 뭉개진다. */
.emote-swatch-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-1);
  grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(0, 1fr));
}
.emote-swatch {
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  justify-items: center;
  padding: var(--space-1);
}
.emote-swatch:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}
.emote-swatch.active {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent);
}
.emote-swatch-icon {
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-size: 576px 48px;
  block-size: 48px;
  image-rendering: pixelated;
  inline-size: 48px;
}
.emote-swatch-label {
  color: var(--text-2);
  font: 500 11px/1.4 var(--font-ui);
  margin-block-start: var(--space-2);
  text-align: center;
}
/* 보관 상자(openChest): 내부 저장 키 대신 입출고 목적과 공유 범위를 먼저 보여 준다. */
.event-subdialog-window.wide:has(.storage-chest-command-body) {
  width: min(860px, calc(100vw - 24px));
}
.storage-chest-command-body {
  width: 100%;
  align-items: stretch;
  gap: var(--space-3);
}
.storage-chest-purpose-card {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 48px minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-3);
  padding: var(--space-3);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-m);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bg-raised), var(--accent-muted));
}
.storage-chest-glyph {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  width: 42px;
  height: 36px;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 2px rgba(60, 48, 32, 0.14));
}
.storage-chest-glyph-lid,
.storage-chest-glyph-body {
  position: absolute;
  left: 2px;
  right: 2px;
  border: 2px solid var(--gold);
  background: var(--gold-soft);
}
.storage-chest-glyph-lid {
  top: 3px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 7px 7px 2px 2px;
}
.storage-chest-glyph-body {
  top: 14px;
  bottom: 1px;
  border-radius: 2px 2px 6px 6px;
}
.storage-chest-glyph-body::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 3px;
  width: 7px;
  height: 8px;
  border: 2px solid var(--gold);
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--bg-raised);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}
.storage-chest-purpose-copy {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 3px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.storage-chest-purpose-copy strong {
  color: var(--text-1);
  font-size: 13px;
}
.storage-chest-purpose-copy span {
  color: var(--text-2);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.45;
}
.storage-chest-purpose-badge {
  padding: 3px 9px;
  border: 1px solid var(--success);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--success-muted);
  color: var(--success);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.storage-chest-scope-section {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--space-2);
  padding: var(--space-3);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-m);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
}
.storage-chest-section-label {
  color: var(--text-1);
  font-size: 12px;
}
.storage-chest-scope-hint,
.storage-chest-shared-settings .rich-form-hint {
  color: var(--text-3);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.45;
}
.storage-chest-shared-settings {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 0 var(--space-3) var(--space-2);
}
.storage-chest-shared-settings[data-active="false"] {
  display: none;
}
.storage-chest-shared-settings .inline-field {

/* 이벤트 에디터 AI 명령 작성기 (aiAssist.ts 전용).
   토큰만 사용(TOKENS.md) — 하드코딩 색 금지.

   기하 계약: 「이 페이지가 하는 일」 칼럼의 **마지막 그리드 행**에 인플로우로 붙는 도크다.
   position:absolute 로 띄우면 자기가 명령을 넣을 목록을 덮는다(실측: 1440 폭에서 목록
   면적의 46%).

   도크는 **내용 높이**만 차지한다(max-height/스크롤러 없음). 초안 결과가 도크 안의 카드에서
   목록 자리(cmd-staged)로 옮겨가면서 본문이 입력 + 상태줄로 줄었기 때문이다. 예전에는
   max-height: min(46vh,420px) + 본문에 flex:1/overflow-y:auto 였는데, 이 조합은 <details>
   안에서 Chromium UA `::details-content` 익명 블록에 막혀 스크롤이 죽는다(상점 카탈로그
   실측: 자식 3050px / 부모 clientH 300, 휠 무반응). 스크롤러를 없애 그 함정을 피한다. */
.ai-event-assist {
  background: var(--bg-raised);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  display: flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  flex-direction: column;
  margin-top: 0;
  min-height: 0;
}
.ai-event-assist-summary {
  color: var(--text-2);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  gap: var(--space-2);
  min-height: 34px;
  transition: background var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast);
  user-select: none;
}
.ai-event-assist-summary:hover {
  background: var(--bg-hover);
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.ai-event-assist[open] > .ai-event-assist-summary {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  color: var(--text-1);
}
/* 접힌 도크 바는 폭을 다 쓰고 배지를 오른쪽 끝으로 밀어낸다. */
.ai-event-assist-summary > .event-aux-chip-label {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-width: 0;
}
.ai-event-assist-body {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
.ai-event-compose {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 7px;
  padding: 11px 14px 12px;
}
.ai-event-caret {
  color: var(--text-3);
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font-size: 10px;
  line-height: 1;
  transition: transform var(--transition-fast);
}
.ai-event-assist[open] > .ai-event-assist-summary .ai-event-caret {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}
.ai-event-prompt-label {
  color: var(--text-1);
  display: block;
  font: 700 13px/1.4 var(--font-ui);
  margin: 0;
  min-width: 0;
}
.event-editor-modal-body .ai-event-input {
  background: var(--bg-inset);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-m);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  color: var(--text-1);
  font: 500 13px/1.65 var(--font-ui);
  max-height: 140px;
  min-height: 66px;
  padding: 9px 11px;
  resize: vertical;
  width: 100%;
}
.event-editor-modal-body .ai-event-input:focus {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent-muted);
}
.event-editor-modal-body .ai-event-input::placeholder {
  color: var(--text-3);
}
/* 도움말과 예시를 한 줄에 둔다. 예전에는 제목·설명·라벨·플레이스홀더가 같은 말을
   네 번 반복해 소개 블록만 93px 을 먹었다. */
.ai-event-hintrow {
  align-items: center;
  column-gap: var(--space-2);
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: space-between;
  row-gap: 5px;
}
.ai-event-prompt-help {
  color: var(--text-3);
  font: 400 11px/1.5 var(--font-ui);
  margin: 0;
  min-width: 0;
}
.ai-event-examples {
  display: flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  gap: 5px;
}
.ai-event-example {
  background: var(--control-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: var(--text-2);
  cursor: pointer;
  font: 600 11px/1 var(--font-ui);
  padding: 5px 9px;
  transition: background var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.ai-event-example:hover {
  background: var(--control-bg-hover);
  border-color: var(--accent-border);
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.ai-event-generate-row {
  align-items: center;
  column-gap: var(--space-2);
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  row-gap: 6px;
}
.ai-event-btn {
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--control-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-m);
  color: var(--text-1);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  font: 700 12px/1 var(--font-ui);
  gap: 6px;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 32px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  transition: background var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast);
}
.ai-event-btn:hover {
  background: var(--control-bg-hover);
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}
.ai-event-btn.primary {
  background: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent-border);
  color: var(--on-accent);
}
.ai-event-btn.primary:hover {
  background: var(--accent-hover);
}
.ai-event-btn:disabled {
  cursor: default;
  opacity: 0.55;
}
.ai-event-generate {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  margin-left: auto;
}
/* 생성 중 — 채움 버튼 안에서 표식만 돌고(transform 만 움직인다) 글자는 그대로다. */
.ai-event-spinner {
  animation: ai-event-spin 0.8s linear infinite;
  border: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--on-accent) 45%, transparent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  border-top-color: var(--on-accent);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  display: inline-block;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  height: 12px;
  width: 12px;
}
.ai-event-spinner[hidden] {
  display: none;
}
@keyframes ai-event-spin {
  to {
    transform: rotate(1turn);
  }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .ai-event-spinner {
    animation: none;
  }
}
.ai-event-assist.is-generating .ai-event-input {
  cursor: progress;
}
/* 반영 직후 칩 — 초록으로 「끝난 일」을 말한다(작성 중·오류와 구분). */
.event-aux-chip-status[data-kind="applied"] {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 45%, transparent);
  color: var(--success);
}
.ai-event-kbd {
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  font: 600 10px/1 var(--font-mono);
  opacity: 0.8;
  padding: 3px 4px;
}
/* 삽입 위치는 프롬프트를 쓰는 동안 계속 보여야 하는 정보다 — 상태 문구와 달리
   비어 있는 순간이 없다. */
.ai-event-target {
  color: var(--text-2);
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font: 600 11px/1.4 var(--font-ui);
  max-width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.ai-event-status {
  color: var(--text-2);
  flex: 1 1 120px;
  font: 400 11px/1.5 var(--font-ui);
  min-width: 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.ai-event-status.error {
  color: var(--danger);
}
.ai-event-status.busy {
  color: var(--accent);
}
.ai-event-status:not(:empty) {
  /* 삽입 위치 문구와 밀척 붙으면 한 문장으로 읽힌다. */
  border-left: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  padding-left: 9px;
}
.ai-event-status:empty {
  flex-basis: 0;
}
/* 결과 줄은 한 줄이다 — 제목·안내가 왼쪽, 「이대로 하기·취소」가 오른쪽. 두 줄(헤더 + 버튼 행)로
   쌓으면 도크가 목록에서 40px 을 더 가져갔다. 좁으면 flex-wrap 으로 내려간다. */
.ai-event-result {
  align-items: center;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px var(--space-3);
  min-height: 0;
  padding: 8px 14px 10px;
}
.ai-event-result[hidden] {
  display: none;
}
.ai-event-result-header {
  align-items: baseline;
  display: flex;
  flex: 1 1 320px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 2px var(--space-2);
  justify-content: flex-start;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
.ai-event-result-title {
  color: var(--text-1);
  font: 700 12px/1.4 var(--font-ui);
  margin: 0;
}
.ai-event-result-meta {
  color: var(--text-3);
  font: 400 11px/1.4 var(--font-ui);
}
.ai-event-preview-actions[hidden] {
  display: none;
}
.ai-event-preview-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  gap: var(--space-2);
  justify-content: flex-end;
  margin-left: auto;
  padding: 0;
}
/* ── 초안을 목록 자리에 겹쳐 보이기 ───────────────────────────────────────────
   stagedDiffView.ts 가 그리는 행들. `.cmd-item` / `.cmd-kind` / `.cmd-summary-token` /
   `.cmd-line-marker` 를 그대로 물려받아 **실제 목록과 같은 모양**을 유지하고, 여기서는
   상태 표시(왼쪽 색 레일 + 기호)와 「이건 빼기」 토글만 더한다. */
.cmd-staged-host {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow-y: auto;
}
.cmd-staged-host[hidden] {
  display: none;
}
/* 실제 목록(.cmd-list, balanced.css 「행은 줄이다」)과 같은 여백·들여쓰기 — 초안이 목록 자리에서
   같은 기하로 보여야 「넣으면 어떻게 보일지」가 예측된다. 예전엔 여백 0 이라 행이 칼럼 가장자리에
   붙어 다른 표면처럼 읽혔다. */
.cmd-staged {
  --blk-indent: 28px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
  padding: 6px 12px 24px;
}
.cmd-staged-row {
  border-left: 3px solid transparent;
  position: relative;
}
.cmd-staged-head {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-2);
  min-height: 34px;
  padding: 0 6px 0 calc(6px + var(--cmd-depth, 0) * var(--blk-indent, 16px));
}
.cmd-staged-mark {
  color: var(--text-3);
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font: 700 12px/1 var(--font-mono);
  width: 12px;
}
.cmd-staged-head > .cmd-step {
  color: var(--text-3);
  flex: 0 0 14px;
  font: 700 10px/1 var(--font-mono);
  text-align: right;
}
.cmd-staged-row[data-staged-status="add"] {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 9%, transparent);
  border-left-color: var(--success);
  border-top: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 55%, transparent);
  border-bottom: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 55%, transparent);
}
.cmd-staged-row[data-staged-status="add"] .cmd-staged-mark {
  color: var(--success);
}
.cmd-staged-row[data-staged-status="remove"] {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 8%, transparent);
  border-left-color: var(--danger);
}
.cmd-staged-row[data-staged-status="remove"] .cmd-kind {
  opacity: 0.7;
  text-decoration: line-through;
}
.cmd-staged-row[data-staged-status="remove"] .cmd-staged-mark {
  color: var(--danger);
}
.cmd-staged-row[data-staged-status="change"] {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent);
  border-left-color: var(--accent);
}
.cmd-staged-row[data-staged-status="change"] .cmd-staged-mark {
  color: var(--accent);
}
.cmd-staged-pair {
  align-items: center;
  column-gap: 7px;
  display: flex;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  min-width: 0;
  row-gap: 2px;
}
.cmd-staged-before {
  opacity: 0.65;
  text-decoration: line-through;
}
.cmd-staged-arrow {
  color: var(--accent);
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font: 700 11px/1 var(--font-mono);
}
/* 되돌린 행은 "그대로"로 보여야 한다 — 결정을 취소했다는 사실만 왼쪽 점선으로 남긴다. */
.cmd-staged-row[data-staged-reverted="true"] {
  background: transparent;
  border-left-style: dotted;
  border-left-color: var(--border-strong);
  opacity: 0.72;
}
/* 행마다 붙는 토글은 조용해야 한다 — 9줄이면 알약 9개가 글자와 경쟁했다. 글자는 보조 12px,
   테두리는 hover·focus 에서만. 되돌린 행(aria-pressed)만 액센트로 「결정을 취소했다」를 남긴다. */
.cmd-staged-toggle {
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: var(--text-2);
  cursor: pointer;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font: 500 12px/1 var(--font-ui);
  margin-left: auto;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  transition: background var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.cmd-staged-toggle:hover {
  background: var(--control-bg-hover);
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.cmd-staged-toggle[aria-pressed="true"] {
  border-color: var(--accent-border);
  color: var(--accent);
}
.cmd-staged-marker[data-staged-status="add"] {
  color: var(--success);
}
.cmd-staged-marker[data-staged-status="remove"] {
  color: var(--danger);
  text-decoration: line-through;
}
/* 분할 목차: 아래 @import 순서가 캐스케이드를 결정하므로 재배열 금지.
   부분 파일을 순서대로 이어붙이면 원본과 동일(순수 기계 분할). */
:root {
    /* (UI-0) 셸 스킨 변수 → tokens.css 별칭 */
    --editor-shell-bg: var(--bg-base);
    --editor-toolbar-bg: var(--bg-surface);
    --editor-canvas-bg: var(--bg-canvas);
    --editor-panel-bg: var(--bg-surface);
    --editor-panel-bg-2: var(--bg-raised);
    --editor-popover-bg: var(--bg-overlay);
    --editor-line: var(--border-subtle);
    --editor-line-strong: var(--border-strong);
    --editor-text: var(--text-1);
    --editor-text-muted: var(--text-2);
    --editor-text-soft: var(--text-3);
    --editor-blue: var(--accent);
    --editor-blue-soft: var(--accent-muted);
    --editor-yellow: var(--warning);
  }
body,
  #app {
    background: var(--editor-shell-bg);
    color: var(--editor-text);
  }
.topbar {
    background: var(--editor-shell-bg);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--editor-line);
    color: var(--editor-text);
    display: block;
    padding: 0;
  }
.oprn-menu-bar {
    align-items: center;
    background: var(--bg-base);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--editor-line);
    color: var(--editor-text);
    display: flex;
    height: 48px;
    padding: 0 18px;
  }
.editor-topbar-trailing {
    align-items: center;
    display: inline-flex;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-left: auto;
  }
.team-history-button,
  .team-identity-button,
  .quick-battle-test-button,
  .topbar-ai-settings-button,
  .topbar-ai-studio {
    align-items: center;
    background: var(--control-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--editor-line);
    border-radius: var(--radius-s);
    color: var(--editor-text);
    cursor: pointer;
    display: inline-flex;
    font: 600 12px/1 var(--font-ui);
    gap: 8px;
    height: 32px;
    justify-content: center;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    margin-left: 0;
    padding: 0 10px;
  }
.team-history-button.is-icon-only,
  .team-identity-button.is-icon-only,
  .quick-battle-test-button.is-icon-only {
    gap: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 32px;
  }
.team-history-button:hover,
  .team-history-button:focus-visible,
  .team-history-button[aria-expanded="true"],
  .team-identity-button:hover,
  .team-identity-button:focus-visible,

  .canvas-toolbar-label {
    font-size: 12px;
  }
}
/* ── 캔버스 스크롤 셸 상단 여백 — 10-map-tree.css 에서 이관(2026-09-03, 그 파일은 좌측 사이드바 모던 레이어
   editor/left-sidebar.modern.css 로 흡수됐다). 캐스케이드 위치는 바로 뒤 파일이라 결과가 같다. ── */
/* UXC editor shell repairs: keep canvas controls in reserved top chrome while the
   statusbar-free canvas extends to the bottom edge. */
.editor-canvas-scroll-shell {
  bottom: var(--editor-canvas-chrome-bottom, 0px);
  top: var(--editor-canvas-chrome-top, 48px);
}
.persistence-mode-banner ~ .editor-canvas-scroll-shell,
.canvas-area:has(.persistence-mode-banner) .editor-canvas-scroll-shell {
  --editor-canvas-chrome-top: 74px;
  top: var(--editor-canvas-chrome-top, 74px);
}
/* Basic/expert density after figma shell so icon-rail overflow/padding wins the cascade. */
.editor-product-brand {
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--editor-text, var(--text-1));
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font: 700 13px/1 var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif);
  gap: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  margin-right: 14px;
  user-select: none;
}
.editor-product-brand-mark {
  color: var(--brand-blue);
  font-size: 14px;
}
.editor-product-brand-text {
  white-space: nowrap;
}
body.editor-ui-beginner .topbar-test-play,
body.editor-ui-standard .topbar-test-play,
body.editor-ui-expert .topbar-test-play {
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--studio-play, var(--editor-blue, #4A57D6));
  border: 1px solid var(--studio-select, var(--accent-border));
  border-radius: var(--radius-s, 2px);
  color: var(--on-accent, #fff);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font: 700 12px/1 var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif);
  gap: 6px;
  height: 32px;
  padding: 0 11px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
body.editor-ui-beginner .topbar-test-play:hover,
body.editor-ui-beginner .topbar-test-play:focus-visible,
body.editor-ui-standard .topbar-test-play:hover,
body.editor-ui-standard .topbar-test-play:focus-visible,
body.editor-ui-expert .topbar-test-play:hover,
body.editor-ui-expert .topbar-test-play:focus-visible {
  filter: brightness(1.12);
  outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--editor-blue, #4A57D6) 45%, transparent);
  outline-offset: 1px;
}
.topbar-test-play-glyph {
  font-size: 11px;
}
/* ── Basic statusbar: keep layer / map / tool / tile / zoom / DB; hide expert-only detail ── */
/* 타일(무엇을 칠하는지)·줌은 basic에서도 보여준다 — 편집에 필수정보. */
body.editor-ui-beginner .editor-statusbar .sb-detail {
  display: none;
}
/* Map tree: always available when chrome.mapTree; only hide via .is-ui-hidden. */
.left-panel-stack.is-ui-hidden,
.resizer-map-tree.is-ui-hidden {
  display: none !important;
}
body.editor-ui-beginner .canvas-toolbar.is-basic-chrome,
body.editor-ui-standard .canvas-toolbar.is-basic-chrome {
  gap: 8px;
  opacity: 0.95;
}
body.editor-ui-beginner .canvas-toolbar.is-basic-chrome.is-docked-chrome {
  align-items: center;
  backdrop-filter: none;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  box-shadow: none;
  height: var(--editor-canvas-chrome-top, 48px);
  left: auto;
  max-width: none;
  padding: 0 8px;
  right: 8px;
  top: 0;
  transform: none;
}
/* Basic has no ⋯ expand control — never hide zoom buttons behind is-expanded gate. */
body.editor-ui-beginner .canvas-toolbar.is-basic-chrome .zoom-button,
.canvas-toolbar.is-basic-chrome.is-expanded .zoom-button {
  display: inline-flex;
}
/* ── Basic labeled rail + flyout ─────────────────────────────────
   figma-editor.css loads after this file and sets left-palette padding +
   overflow:hidden for expert sheet scrolling. Beginner mode must beat those
   with higher specificity so its narrow labeled rail and flyouts are not
   clipped (layer/map toggles open overlays to the right of the rail).
*/
body.editor-ui-beginner {
  --basic-rail-width: 72px;
}
body.editor-ui-beginner .editor-layout .left-panel,
body.editor-ui-beginner .left-panel {
  /* Single-column labeled rail — no expert map-tree grid row.
     z-index must beat .canvas-area (later sibling, position:relative) so
     flyouts that spill right are clickable and visible over the map. */
  container-type: normal;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0;
  grid-template-rows: none;
  min-width: var(--basic-rail-width) !important;
  overflow: visible !important;
  overflow-x: visible !important;
  overflow-y: visible !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  position: relative;
  width: var(--basic-rail-width);
  z-index: var(--z-rail);
}
body.editor-ui-beginner .editor-layout .left-panel-stack,
body.editor-ui-beginner .left-panel-stack,
body.editor-ui-beginner .left-panel-stack[data-testid="left-palette-root"],
body.editor-ui-beginner .left-panel-stack[data-testid="left-map-root"] {
  border-bottom: 0;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  max-width: none;
  min-height: 0;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: visible !important;
  overflow-x: visible !important;
  overflow-y: visible !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}
body.editor-ui-beginner .basic-left-rail.is-icon-rail {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow-x: visible;
  overflow-y: auto;
}
.basic-left-rail.is-icon-rail {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  height: 100%;
  padding: 6px 0 8px;
  position: relative;
  width: var(--basic-rail-width);
}
.basic-rail-icons {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  gap: 2px;
}
/* Layer switcher and panel entry points stay together in the rail flow. */
.basic-rail-layer-switcher {
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.basic-rail-panel-toggles {
  margin-top: 0;
  padding-top: var(--space-1);
}
.basic-rail-btn {
  align-items: center;
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 9px;
  color: var(--editor-text-muted, var(--text-2));
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  gap: 1px;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 48px;
  min-width: 40px;
  padding: 3px 2px;
  position: relative;
  width: 64px;
}
.basic-rail-btn svg {
  display: block;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  height: 18px;
  width: 18px;
}
.basic-rail-label {
  display: -webkit-box;
  font: 700 14px/1.2 var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif);
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  max-height: 2.4em;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-align: center;
  word-break: keep-all;
}
.basic-rail-btn:hover,
.basic-rail-btn:focus-visible {
  border-color: var(--editor-line-strong, var(--border-strong));
  color: var(--editor-text, var(--text-1));
  outline: none;
}
.basic-rail-btn.is-active,
.basic-rail-btn.is-open {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--editor-blue, #4A57D6) 28%, var(--mix-base));
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--editor-blue, #4A57D6) 55%, transparent);
  color: var(--on-accent);
}
.basic-rail-btn[disabled] {
  cursor: default;
  opacity: 0.45;
}
.basic-rail-sep {
  background: var(--editor-line-strong, var(--border-strong));
  flex-shrink: 0;
  height: 1px;
  margin: 2px 0;
  width: 40px;
}
.basic-pending-event-cta {
  align-items: center;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--editor-blue, #4A57D6) 26%, var(--mix-base));
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--editor-blue, #4A57D6) 58%, transparent);
  border-radius: var(--radius-m);
  color: var(--on-accent);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  flex-direction: column;
  font: var(--font-weight-bold) var(--font-size-sm)/var(--line-height-tight) var(--font-ui);
  gap: var(--space-1);
  margin-top: var(--space-1);
  min-height: 48px;
  padding: var(--space-1);
  position: relative;
  text-align: center;
  width: calc(var(--basic-rail-width) - (2 * var(--space-1)));
}
.basic-pending-event-cta > span:not(.basic-pending-event-cta-mark) {
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  color: currentColor;
  display: block;
  padding: 0;
  position: static;
  white-space: normal;
}
.basic-pending-event-cta-coord {
  font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
}
.basic-pending-event-cta:hover,
.basic-pending-event-cta:focus-visible {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--editor-blue, #4A57D6) 42%, var(--mix-base));
  outline: none;
}
.basic-pending-event-cta-mark {
  font-size: 22px;
  line-height: 1;
}
@media (max-width: 1320px) {
  body.editor-ui-beginner .editor-product-brand-text,
  body.editor-ui-beginner .topbar-test-play-label {
    display: none;
  }

  body.editor-ui-beginner .editor-product-brand {
    margin-right: 6px;
  }

  body.editor-ui-beginner .topbar-test-play {
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 0;
    width: 32px;
  }
}
/* ── 첫 방문 코치마크 (기본 모드) ─────────────────────────────── */
.coach-mark-card {
  background: var(--bg-raised, #FFFDF8);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default, rgba(42, 37, 33, 0.12));
  border-radius: var(--radius-m, 10px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop, 0 12px 32px rgba(60, 48, 32, 0.14));
  padding: 12px 14px;
  position: fixed;
  /* 첫 방문 안내라 어떤 셸 레이어보다 앞에 와야 한다 — z-popover(90) 는
     flyout/popover-high/modal 아래로 깔려 레일·패널에 가렸다. */
  z-index: var(--z-modal-top);
}
/* 테스트 플레이/전투 테스트 모달이 떠 있는 동안은 숨긴다 — 코치마크가 가리키는
   도구 레일은 모달 뒤에 있는데 카드만 모달 위(z-modal-top)에 남아, 작은 창에서
   전투 필드·HUD 를 덮었다(코덱스 적대 리뷰 C5). 모달이 닫히면 다시 보인다. */
body:has(.test-play-modal-backdrop) .coach-mark-card {
  display: none;
}
.coach-mark-head {
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
  font: 700 12px/1.3 var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif);
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.coach-mark-body {
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
  font: 400 12px/1.55 var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif);
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.coach-mark-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  justify-content: flex-end;
}
.coach-mark-skip,
.coach-mark-next {
  border-radius: 6px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font: 600 11px/1 var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif);
  padding: 6px 12px;
}
.coach-mark-skip {
  background: var(--bg-raised, #FFFDF8);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default, rgba(42, 37, 33, 0.12));
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
}
.coach-mark-next {
  background: var(--accent, #4A57D6);
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  color: var(--on-accent, #fff);
}
.coach-mark-skip:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong, rgba(42, 37, 33, 0.26));
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
}
.coach-mark-next:hover {
  filter: brightness(0.96);
}
.basic-rail-tile-thumb {
  background-color: var(--bg-well);
  border: 1px solid var(--editor-line, var(--border-subtle));
  border-radius: 5px;
  display: block;
  image-rendering: pixelated;
}
.basic-rail-flyout {
  background: var(--editor-popover-bg, var(--bg-overlay));
  border: 1px solid var(--editor-line-strong, var(--border-strong));
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop, 0 12px 32px rgba(60, 48, 32, 0.12));
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  left: calc(var(--basic-rail-width) + var(--space-2));
  max-height: min(78vh, calc(100vh - 80px));
  position: fixed;
  top: calc(var(--space-6) + var(--space-4) + var(--space-2));
  width: 300px;
  z-index: var(--z-flyout);
}
/* 맵 플라이아웃: 목록(320px) + 상세 2단이 들어가야 한다.
   칸 구성은 editor/map-panel.modern.css §초보 플라이아웃 2단 탐색기가 갖는다 —
   1100px 분기점을 그 파일과 같이 쓴다(그 아래에서는 상세가 목록 밑으로 내려간다). */
.basic-rail-flyout.is-maps {
  width: min(700px, calc(100vw - 96px));
}
@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .basic-rail-flyout.is-maps {
    width: min(360px, calc(100vw - 88px));
  }
}
/* 타일 시트 플라이아웃: 작은 창에서도 시트를 넓게 */
.basic-rail-flyout.is-tiles {
  width: min(420px, calc(100vw - 64px));
  max-height: min(78vh, calc(100% - 8px));
}
.basic-rail-flyout.is-tiles .basic-flyout-body {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 8px 10px 10px;
}
.basic-rail-flyout.is-tiles .basic-flyout-content,
.basic-rail-flyout.is-tiles .basic-rail-section {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 0;
}
.basic-rail-flyout.is-tiles .tile-palette {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  max-height: min(56vh, 480px);
  overflow: auto;
}
.basic-rail-flyout.is-tiles .tile-search-input,
.basic-rail-flyout.is-tiles .basic-selected-tile {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}
/* 짧은 뷰포트: 맵 트리가 시트 공간을 잡아먹지 않게 */
@media (max-height: 720px) {
  .left-panel-stack[data-testid="left-map-root"] {
    max-height: min(140px, 22vh);
    min-height: 72px;
  }

  .left-panel-stack[data-testid="left-palette-root"] {
    min-height: 0;
  }

  /* 초보 레일: 도구 6 + 레이어 3 + 패널 토글 2 = 11칸이 짧은 화면에 다 들어가야 한다.
     실측(1024x600): min-height 48px 기준 레일 콘텐츠 592px > 가용 550px 라 「맵」 토글이
     34px 접혀 스크롤 없이는 보이지 않았다. 11칸에서 6px씩 줄여 66px 을 회수하면
     526px 로 내려와 스크롤 없이 전부 보인다. overflow-y:auto 는 더 극단적인 높이용 안전망으로 남긴다.
     라벨은 한 줄이라 min-height 가 높이를 지배하므로 글자 크기는 건드리지 않는다. */
  .basic-rail-btn {
    min-height: 42px;
  }
}
/* 좌패널 전체: 가로 스크롤 전면 차단 (시트·맵트리·툴바 공통)
   basic 아이콘 레일은 플라이아웃이 우측으로 넘치므로 제외 (위 body.editor-ui-beginner 규칙). */
body.editor-ui-standard .editor-layout .left-panel,
body.editor-ui-expert .editor-layout .left-panel {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}
body.editor-ui-standard .editor-layout .left-panel-stack,
body.editor-ui-expert .editor-layout .left-panel-stack {
  max-width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}
body.editor-ui-standard .left-panel-stack[data-testid="left-palette-root"],
body.editor-ui-standard .left-panel-stack[data-testid="left-map-root"],
body.editor-ui-expert .left-panel-stack[data-testid="left-palette-root"],
body.editor-ui-expert .left-panel-stack[data-testid="left-map-root"] {
  overflow-x: hidden !important;
}
.left-panel-stack[data-testid="left-palette-root"] .chipset-sheet,
.left-panel-stack[data-testid="left-palette-root"] .chipset-sheet.tile-palette {
  max-width: 100% !important;
  min-width: 0 !important;
  overflow-x: hidden !important;
  overflow-y: auto !important;
  width: 100% !important;
}
.left-panel-stack[data-testid="left-palette-root"] .chipset-grid {
  max-width: 100% !important;
  min-width: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
}
/* 전문가 좌측 RM2003 팔레트: 가로 6칸 고정 */
.left-panel-stack[data-testid="left-palette-root"] .chipset-sheet.oprn-palette {
  container-type: inline-size;
}
.left-panel-stack[data-testid="left-palette-root"] .chipset-grid.oprn-palette-grid {
  --oprn-cols: 6;
  --chipset-cell: min(32px, calc((100cqi - 12px) / 6));
  grid-auto-rows: var(--chipset-cell);
  grid-template-columns: repeat(6, var(--chipset-cell)) !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
  min-width: 0 !important;
  width: max-content !important;
}
.left-panel-stack[data-testid="left-palette-root"] .chipset-grid.oprn-palette-grid .chipset-tile {
  height: var(--chipset-cell);
  min-width: 0;
  width: var(--chipset-cell);
}
/* Custom atlases preserve the authored sheet geometry. Never reflow them into the
   RM2K six-column palette: multi-cell facades and props must remain readable. */
.left-panel-stack[data-testid="left-palette-root"] .chipset-sheet.custom-palette {
  container-type: inline-size;
  overflow-x: auto !important;
}
.left-panel-stack[data-testid="left-palette-root"] .chipset-grid.custom-palette-grid {
  --chipset-cell: max(var(--custom-min-cell), min(32px, calc((100cqi - 4px) / var(--custom-cols))));
  grid-auto-rows: var(--chipset-cell);
  grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--custom-cols), var(--chipset-cell)) !important;
  max-width: none !important;
  min-width: calc(var(--custom-cols) * var(--custom-min-cell) + 4px) !important;
  width: max-content !important;
}
.left-panel-stack[data-testid="left-palette-root"] .chipset-grid.custom-palette-grid .chipset-tile {
  height: var(--chipset-cell);
  min-width: 0;
  width: var(--chipset-cell);
}
/* 시트 크게 보기 팝오버 */

.chipset-sheet-popout-head {

.chipset-sheet-popout-head h2 {

.chipset-sheet-popout-body {

.basic-flyout-head {
