  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
}
.basic-flyout-title {
  color: var(--editor-text, var(--text-1));
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  font: 700 12px/1.2 var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif);
}
.basic-flyout-pin,
.basic-flyout-close {
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 7px;
  color: var(--editor-text-muted, var(--text-2));
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 12px;
  height: 24px;
  width: 26px;
}
.basic-flyout-pin:hover,
.basic-flyout-close:hover {
  border-color: var(--editor-line-strong, var(--border-strong));
  color: var(--editor-text, var(--text-1));
}
.basic-flyout-pin.is-pinned {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--editor-blue, #4A57D6) 30%, var(--mix-base));
  color: var(--on-accent);
}
.basic-flyout-body {
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: auto;
  padding: 10px 12px 12px;
}
.basic-flyout-map-host {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0;
  min-height: 120px;
}
/* 이 아래(구 736~938행)에 있던 초보 플라이아웃 맵 목록 규칙은 전부
   editor/map-panel.modern.css 의 is-basic-flyout 절로 이관됐다(2026-08, Task 6).
   컨테이너 프리픽스(basic-flyout-map-host, 특이도 0,3,0)가 모던 레이어(0,2,0)를
   항상 이겨 이름·메타 말줄임과 배지 겹침이 났었다. */
.basic-rail-section {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}
.basic-selected-tile {
  color: var(--editor-text-muted, var(--text-2));
  font: 500 12px/1.3 var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif);
}
.basic-rail-hint {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--control-bg, var(--mix-base)) 85%, #000);
  border: 1px dashed var(--editor-line, var(--border-subtle));
  border-radius: 10px;
  color: var(--editor-text-muted, var(--text-2));
  font: 500 12px/1.4 var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif);
  padding: 10px 12px;
}
/* Basic rail layout is fully specified in the icon-rail block above. */
/* ── 실제 저작 작업 · 패널 도킹 · 레이아웃 · 밀도 · ⌘K ─────────────────────── */
/* 「▤ 보기」 — 글리프 + 글자. 글리프만 있던 때(2026-08-26~09-03)는 편집 모드의 유일한 진입점이
   장식으로 읽혔다. 글자는 다른 메뉴 항목(프로젝트·도구…)과 같은 14px 을 상속하고 글리프만 작게. */
.workspace-panels-button {
  align-items: center;
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 6px;
  line-height: 1;
}
.workspace-panels-menu {
  gap: 1px;
  min-width: 216px;
}
.workspace-menu-group {
  color: var(--text-3, #8A7F70);
  font: 700 10px/1 var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  padding: 6px 8px 3px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.workspace-panel-row {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  gap: 2px;
}
.workspace-panel-row .workspace-panel-toggle {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  text-align: left;
}
.workspace-panel-dock-chip {
  appearance: none;
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(60, 48, 32, 0.18));
  border-radius: var(--radius-s, 2px);
  color: var(--text-2, #5C5348);
  cursor: pointer;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font: 600 10px/1 var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif);
  padding: 4px 6px;
}
.workspace-panel-dock-chip:hover,
.workspace-panel-dock-chip:focus-visible {
  border-color: var(--border-strong, rgba(60, 48, 32, 0.4));
  color: var(--text-1, #2E2A24);
  outline: none;
}
/* ⌘K 칩 — 단축키를 모르면 커맨드 팔레트는 존재하지 않는 것과 같다. 키캡을 함께 보여준다. */
.workspace-command-chip {
  align-items: center;
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 5px;
}
.workspace-command-chip-icon {
  font-size: 13px;
}
.workspace-command-chip-key {
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(60, 48, 32, 0.18));
  border-radius: var(--radius-s, 2px);
  color: var(--text-3, #8A7F70);
  font: 600 10px/1 var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace);
  padding: 3px 4px;
}
@media (max-width: 1180px) {
  /* 좁은 화면에서는 키캡만 접는다 — 아이콘은 남겨 클릭 경로를 유지한다. */
  .workspace-command-chip-key { display: none; }
}
/* 저작 여정: 하단 풀폭 스트립 대신 캔버스 왼쪽 아래 아이콘. */
.authoring-journey-host {
  bottom: 10px;
  left: 10px;
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 24;
}
.authoring-journey {
  position: relative;
}
.authoring-journey-toggle {
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--bg-glass, rgba(252, 249, 242, 0.86));
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default, rgba(42, 37, 33, 0.20));
  border-radius: var(--radius-s, 3px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop, 0 4px 12px rgba(30, 24, 18, 0.12));
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  height: 32px;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 32px;
  padding: 0;
  position: relative;
}
.authoring-journey-toggle:hover,
.authoring-journey-toggle:focus-visible {
  border-color: var(--border-strong, rgba(42, 37, 33, 0.55));
  outline: none;
}
.authoring-journey-toggle svg { display: block; }
.authoring-journey-badge {
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--danger, #C6403D);
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: #fff;
  display: inline-flex;
  font: 700 9px/1 var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif);
  height: 14px;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 14px;
  padding: 0 3px;
  position: absolute;
  right: -5px;
  top: -5px;
}
.authoring-journey-strip {
  background: var(--bg-overlay, #FFFFFF);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default, rgba(42, 37, 33, 0.20));
  border-radius: var(--radius-s, 3px);
  bottom: calc(100% + 6px);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(30, 24, 18, 0.18);
  display: none;
  left: 0;
  max-height: min(360px, 50vh);
  overflow: auto;
  position: absolute;
  width: min(280px, calc(100vw - 24px));
}
.authoring-journey.is-open .authoring-journey-strip { display: block; }
.authoring-journey-strip[hidden] { display: none; }
.authoring-journey-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 4px;
}
.authoring-journey-stage {
  align-items: center;
  display: grid;
  gap: 1px 8px;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  grid-template-rows: 24px 18px;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 6px 8px;
  position: relative;
}
.authoring-journey-stage + .authoring-journey-stage {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(42, 37, 33, 0.12));
}
.authoring-journey-stage[aria-current="step"] {
  box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--accent, #4A57D6);
}
.authoring-journey-stage.has-issues {
  box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--danger, #C6403D);
}
.authoring-journey-stage.is-acknowledged:not(.is-complete) {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4A57D6) 5%, transparent);
}
.authoring-journey-project,
.authoring-journey-task {
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  color: var(--text-1, #2A2521);
  font: 700 12px/1.1 var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif);
  grid-column: 1;
  grid-row: 1;
  min-height: 24px;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 0;
  text-align: left;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.authoring-journey-task { cursor: pointer; min-width: 24px; }
.authoring-journey-task:hover,
.authoring-journey-task:focus-visible { color: var(--accent, #4A57D6); outline: none; }
.authoring-journey-task:disabled { color: var(--danger, #C6403D); cursor: not-allowed; }
.authoring-journey-evidence {
  color: var(--text-3, #6B5F52);
  font: 500 11px/1.1 var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif);
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  grid-row: 2;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.authoring-journey-manual {
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  color: var(--text-3, #6B5F52);
  cursor: pointer;
  font: 600 11px/1 var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif);
  grid-column: 2;
  grid-row: 1;
  min-height: 24px;
  min-width: 24px;
  padding: 2px 4px;
}
.authoring-journey-manual:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #4A57D6); }
.authoring-journey-reference-issues {
  color: var(--danger, #C6403D);
  font: 600 11px/1 var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif);
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  position: static;
}
.authoring-journey-reference-issues > summary {
  align-items: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  min-height: 24px;
}
.authoring-journey-reference-panel {
  background: var(--bg-overlay, #FFFFFF);
  border: 1px solid var(--danger, #C6403D);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s, 3px);
  margin-top: 6px;
  max-height: 180px;
  overflow: auto;
  padding: 8px;
  position: static;
  width: auto;
}
.authoring-journey-reference-list {
  font: 500 11px/1.35 var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif);
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  padding-left: 18px;
}
.authoring-journey-reference-repair {
  min-height: 24px;
  min-width: 24px;
}
/* ── 이관(2026-09-03, 구 shell/editor-responsive-expert.css) — AI 패널: 입력 행이 절대 잘리지 않게 ── */
.ai-composer,
.ai-composer-actions {
  min-width: 0;
}
.ai-composer > textarea {
  min-width: 0;
}
.ai-chat-send {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}
/* 스튜디오 바(톱바 한 줄·메뉴 팝업·보기 메뉴·캔버스 툴바)의 마지막 발언자 — 2026-09-03. */
/* src/styles/shell/studio-bar.modern.css
   ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   스튜디오 바 — 표준·전문가(그리고 초보) 셸의 톱바 한 줄, 그 메뉴 팝업, 「보기」 메뉴, 캔버스 플로팅 툴바.
   2026-09-03 개편의 마지막 발언자다. 앞선 세대(figma-editor/01·02·05·07, editor-ui-modes,
   shell-density, responsive-a, database/tabs-b-shell-layout)가 같은 선택자에 남긴 값은 여기서 덮는다.

   원칙
   · 토큰만 쓴다(hex 0 · !important 0). 색은 tokens.css 의 cool white + indigo 사다리.
   · 32px 컨트롤 하나의 리듬. 글자 버튼(메뉴·도구)도, 아이콘 버튼도, 명령 팔레트도 32px.
   · 무게는 셋뿐 — 채운 인디고(▶ 테스트) / 테두리(스튜디오·명령 팔레트) / 고스트(나머지).
   · 그리드 3열: 왼쪽(파일·자료) | 가운데(명령 팔레트) | 오른쪽(실행·화면·세션).
   ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* ── 1. 바 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.topbar {
  background: var(--bg-base);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
}
.oprn-menu-bar.studio-bar {
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--bg-base);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  column-gap: 12px;
  display: grid;
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
  /* 양 끝은 내용 폭(max-content) — 왼쪽 묶음이 길어져도 가운데 칩 밑으로 흘러들지 않는다.
     (1280 전문가에서 찾기 버튼 위에 명령 팔레트가 얹혀 클릭을 가로챈 실측 — 2026-09-03.)
     가운데 칩은 남는 폭 안에서 중앙, 폭이 모자라면 칩이 먼저 줄어든다. */
  grid-template-columns: max-content minmax(0, 1fr) max-content;
  height: 48px;
  min-height: 48px;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 0 12px;
}
.studio-bar-lead,
.studio-bar .editor-topbar-trailing {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
  margin: 0;
  min-width: 0;
}
.studio-bar-lead {
  justify-self: start;
}
.studio-bar-center {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  justify-self: stretch;
  min-width: 0;
}
.studio-bar .editor-topbar-trailing {
  gap: 6px;
  justify-self: end;
}
/* ── 2. 브랜드 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.studio-bar .editor-product-brand {
  color: var(--text-1);
  font: 700 13px/1 var(--font-ui);
  gap: 6px;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  margin-right: 4px;
  padding: 0 4px;
}
.studio-bar .editor-product-brand-mark {
  color: var(--accent);
  font-size: 15px;
}
/* ── 3. 글자 버튼(메뉴 트리거·도구) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.studio-bar .oprn-menu-item,
.studio-tool-button {
  align-items: center;
  appearance: none;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  color: var(--text-1);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  font: 600 13px/1 var(--font-ui);
  gap: 6px;
  height: 32px;
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 32px;
  padding: 0 10px;
  transition: background var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.studio-bar .oprn-menu-item:hover,
.studio-bar .oprn-menu-item:focus-visible,
.studio-tool-button:hover,
.studio-tool-button:focus-visible {
  background: var(--bg-hover);
  color: var(--text-1);
  outline: none;
}
.studio-bar .oprn-menu-item:focus-visible,
.studio-tool-button:focus-visible,
.studio-icon-button:focus-visible {
  box-shadow: var(--focus-ring);
}
.studio-bar .oprn-menu-item[aria-expanded="true"] {
  background: var(--bg-active);
}
.studio-bar .oprn-menu-item-chevron {
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--text-3);
  display: inline-flex;
  margin-left: -2px;
}
.studio-bar .oprn-menu-item-chevron svg {
  height: 14px;
  width: 14px;
}
.studio-tool-button svg,
.studio-bar .oprn-menu-item > svg {
  color: var(--text-2);
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  height: 18px;
  width: 18px;
}
.studio-tool-button {
  padding: 0 10px 0 8px;
}
/* 프로젝트 이름 — 굵게, 길면 말줄임. 톱바가 「지금 어느 프로젝트인가」를 말하는 유일한 자리다. */
.studio-project-button .oprn-menu-item-label {
  font-weight: 700;
  max-width: 200px;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
/* 자료 묶음은 저장 버튼 뒤 헤어라인 하나로 나눈다. */
.studio-bar-lead > [data-testid="toolbar-database"],
.studio-bar-lead > [data-testid="menu-tools"]:first-of-type {
  margin-left: 10px;
  position: relative;
}
.studio-bar-lead > [data-testid="toolbar-database"]::before,
.studio-bar-lead > [data-testid="menu-tools"]:first-of-type::before {
  background: var(--border-subtle);
  bottom: 8px;
  content: "";
  left: -7px;
  position: absolute;
  top: 8px;
  width: 1px;
}
/* ── 4. 아이콘 버튼 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.studio-icon-button,
.studio-bar .team-history-button,
.studio-bar .team-identity-button {
  align-items: center;
  appearance: none;
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  color: var(--text-2);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  gap: 0;
  height: 32px;
  justify-content: center;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  transition: background var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast);
  width: 32px;
}
.studio-icon-button:hover,
.studio-icon-button:focus-visible,
.studio-icon-button[aria-expanded="true"],
.studio-bar .team-history-button:hover,
.studio-bar .team-history-button:focus-visible,
.studio-bar .team-history-button[aria-expanded="true"],
.studio-bar .team-identity-button:hover,
.studio-bar .team-identity-button:focus-visible,
.studio-bar .team-identity-button[aria-expanded="true"] {
  background: var(--bg-hover);
  border-color: transparent;
  color: var(--text-1);
  outline: none;
}
.studio-icon-button svg,
.studio-bar .team-topbar-icon {
  height: 18px;
  width: 18px;
}
.studio-icon-button[aria-pressed="true"] {
  background: var(--bg-active);
  color: var(--text-1);
}
/* 저장 버튼 + 자동 저장 점. 점의 폭은 고정이라 어떤 상태에서도 옆 버튼이 움직이지 않는다. */
.studio-save-button {
  position: relative;
}
.studio-save-dot {
  background: var(--text-3);
  border-radius: 50%;
  bottom: 6px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--bg-base);
  height: 7px;
  position: absolute;
  right: 6px;
  transition: background var(--transition-fast);
  width: 7px;
}
.studio-save-button[data-autosave-kind="saved"] .studio-save-dot {
  background: var(--success);
}
.studio-save-button[data-autosave-kind="pending"] .studio-save-dot,
.studio-save-button[data-autosave-kind="saving"] .studio-save-dot {
  background: var(--warning);
}
.studio-save-button[data-autosave-kind="error"] .studio-save-dot {
  background: var(--danger);
}
.studio-bar .topbar-save-status {
  margin-left: 2px;
}
/* ── 5. 명령 팔레트(가운데) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.studio-bar .studio-command-center {
  background: var(--bg-inset);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-m);
  color: var(--text-3);
  flex: 0 1 240px;
  font: 500 12.5px/1 var(--font-ui);
  gap: 8px;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  max-width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 0 8px 0 10px;
}
.studio-bar .studio-command-center:hover,
.studio-bar .studio-command-center:focus-visible {
  background: var(--bg-raised);
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
  color: var(--text-2);
}
.studio-command-center .workspace-command-chip-icon {
  align-items: center;
  display: inline-flex;
  font-size: inherit;
}
.studio-command-center .workspace-command-chip-icon svg {
  height: 16px;
  width: 16px;
}
.studio-command-center .workspace-command-chip-label {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-align: left;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.studio-command-center .workspace-command-chip-key {
  background: var(--bg-raised);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--text-3);
  font: 600 10.5px/1 var(--font-mono);
  padding: 3px 5px;
}
/* ── 6. 실행 묶음: ▶ 테스트 | ⚔ ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.studio-run-group {
  align-items: stretch;
  display: inline-flex;
  height: 32px;
}
.studio-run-group .topbar-test-play-wrap {
  display: inline-flex;
}
.studio-run-group .topbar-test-play {
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--radius-s) 0 0 var(--radius-s);
  font: 700 13px/1 var(--font-ui);
  height: 32px;
  padding: 0 12px;
}
.studio-run-group .topbar-test-play:hover,
.studio-run-group .topbar-test-play:focus-visible {
  filter: none;
  background: var(--accent-hover);
  outline: none;
}
.studio-run-group .topbar-test-play:focus-visible {
  box-shadow: var(--focus-ring);
}
.studio-run-group .topbar-test-play-glyph {
  font-size: 10px;
}
.studio-run-group .quick-battle-test-button {
  background: var(--accent-muted);
  border: 0;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--bg-base);
  border-radius: 0 var(--radius-s) var(--radius-s) 0;
  color: var(--accent);
}
.studio-run-group .quick-battle-test-button:hover,
.studio-run-group .quick-battle-test-button:focus-visible {
  background: var(--accent-border);
  border-color: var(--bg-base);
  color: var(--accent);
}
/* 스튜디오 토글 — 테두리 무게. 켜지면 인디고(01-shell-topbar-team.css 의 .is-on 유지). */
.studio-bar .topbar-ai-studio {
  background: var(--control-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  font: 600 13px/1 var(--font-ui);
  height: 32px;
  padding: 0 10px;
}
.studio-bar .topbar-ai-studio:hover,
.studio-bar .topbar-ai-studio:focus-visible {
  background: var(--control-bg-hover);
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}
/* ── 7. 「보기 ▾」 버튼 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.studio-bar .workspace-panels-button {
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 0 8px;
}
.workspace-panels-icon {
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--text-2);
  display: inline-flex;
}
.workspace-panels-icon svg {
  height: 18px;
  width: 18px;
}
/* 세션 묶음(도움말·기록·신원·AI 설정·전체화면)은 헤어라인으로 나눈다. */
.studio-icon-cluster {
  align-items: center;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 2px;
  margin-left: 2px;
  padding-left: 8px;
}
/* ── 8. 메뉴 팝업 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.oprn-menu-popup {
  background: var(--bg-overlay);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-m);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  color: var(--text-1);
  max-height: calc(100vh - 24px);
  max-width: calc(100vw - 24px);
  min-width: 232px;
  overflow: auto;
  padding: 6px;
  z-index: var(--z-popover);
}
.oprn-menu-popup.open {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1px;
}
.oprn-menu-command {
  align-items: center;
  appearance: none;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  color: var(--text-1);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  font: 500 13px/1.3 var(--font-ui);
  gap: 10px;
  min-height: 32px;
  overflow-wrap: normal;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  text-align: left;
  white-space: nowrap;
  width: 100%;
}
.oprn-menu-command:hover:not(:disabled),
.oprn-menu-command:focus-visible:not(:disabled) {
  background: var(--bg-hover);
  border-color: transparent;
  color: var(--text-1);
  outline: none;
}
.oprn-menu-command:focus-visible:not(:disabled) {
  box-shadow: var(--focus-ring);
}
.oprn-menu-command:disabled {
  color: var(--text-disabled);
  cursor: default;
}
.oprn-menu-command-icon {
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--text-3);
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}
.oprn-menu-command-icon svg {
  height: 16px;
  width: 16px;
}
.oprn-menu-command-label {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
}
/* 하위 메뉴(예제 프로젝트 ▸) */
.oprn-menu-command[aria-haspopup="menu"]::after {
  color: var(--text-3);
  content: "›";
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1;
  margin-left: auto;
}
.oprn-menu-separator {
  background: var(--border-subtle);
  border: 0;
  box-shadow: none;
  height: 1px;
  margin: 4px 6px;
}
/* ── 9. 「보기」 메뉴 — 패널 토글 + 편집 모드 라디오 ────────────────────────────────────── */
.workspace-panels-menu {
  gap: 1px;
  min-width: 296px;
}
.workspace-menu-group {
  color: var(--text-3);
  font: 700 11px/1 var(--font-ui);
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  padding: 8px 10px 4px;
  text-transform: none;
}
.workspace-menu-group + .workspace-menu-group,
.workspace-ui-mode-item + .workspace-menu-group,
.workspace-panel-row + .workspace-menu-group {
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.workspace-panel-row {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
}
.workspace-panel-row .workspace-panel-toggle {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
}
.workspace-panel-check {
  align-items: center;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: 4px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  color: var(--on-accent);
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  height: 16px;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 16px;
}
.workspace-panel-toggle.is-active .workspace-panel-check {
  background: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent);
}
.workspace-panel-check svg {
  height: 12px;
  width: 12px;
}
.workspace-panel-dock-chip {
  appearance: none;
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  color: var(--text-2);
  cursor: pointer;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font: 600 11px/1 var(--font-ui);
  margin-right: 4px;
  padding: 5px 8px;
}
.workspace-panel-dock-chip:hover,
.workspace-panel-dock-chip:focus-visible {
  background: var(--bg-hover);
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
  color: var(--text-1);
  outline: none;
}
.workspace-ui-mode-item {
  align-items: flex-start;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  white-space: normal;
}
.workspace-ui-mode-radio {
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  height: 16px;
  margin-top: 1px;
  position: relative;
  width: 16px;
}
.workspace-ui-mode-item.is-active .workspace-ui-mode-radio {
  border-color: var(--accent);
}
.workspace-ui-mode-item.is-active .workspace-ui-mode-radio::after {
  background: var(--accent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  content: "";
  height: 8px;
  left: 50%;
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  width: 8px;
}
.workspace-ui-mode-text {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 3px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.workspace-ui-mode-label {
  font-weight: 600;
}
.workspace-ui-mode-item.is-active .workspace-ui-mode-label {
  color: var(--accent);
}
.workspace-ui-mode-hint {
  color: var(--text-3);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.35;
}
/* ── 10. 캔버스 플로팅 툴바(배율 · ⋯ · AI 빠른 작업 · 맵 저장) ──────────────────────────── */
.canvas-toolbar {
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--bg-glass);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-m);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop);
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 5px;
}
.canvas-toolbar .oprn-tool-button,
.canvas-toolbar .canvas-toolbar-expand {
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  box-shadow: none;
  color: var(--text-1);
  font: 600 12.5px/1 var(--font-ui);
  height: 32px;
  min-width: 32px;
  padding: 0 8px;
}
.canvas-toolbar .oprn-tool-button:hover:not(:disabled),
.canvas-toolbar .oprn-tool-button:focus-visible,
.canvas-toolbar .canvas-toolbar-expand:hover,
.canvas-toolbar .canvas-toolbar-expand:focus-visible {
  background: var(--bg-hover);
  border-color: transparent;
  outline: none;
}
.canvas-toolbar .zoom-stepper-current {
  background: var(--bg-inset);
  min-width: 44px;
}
.canvas-toolbar .zoom-stepper-btn {
  color: var(--text-2);
  font-size: 15px;
}
.canvas-toolbar .oprn-tool-button.active,
.canvas-toolbar .oprn-tool-button[aria-pressed="true"] {
  background: var(--accent);
  border-color: transparent;
  color: var(--on-accent);
}
.canvas-toolbar .canvas-toolbar-save-group {
  border-left: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  margin-left: 2px;
  padding-left: 6px;
}
.canvas-toolbar .canvas-ai-workbench {
  border-left: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  gap: 2px;
  margin-left: 2px;
  padding-left: 6px;
}
.canvas-toolbar .canvas-ai-action {
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  color: var(--text-1);
  font: 600 12.5px/1 var(--font-ui);
  gap: 6px;
  min-height: 32px;
  padding: 0 9px;
}
.canvas-toolbar .canvas-ai-action svg {
  color: var(--text-2);
}
.canvas-toolbar .canvas-ai-action:hover {
  background: var(--bg-hover);
  border-color: transparent;
}
.canvas-toolbar .canvas-ai-action.is-ask {
  background: var(--accent-muted);
  border: 0;
  color: var(--accent);
}
.canvas-toolbar .canvas-ai-action.is-ask svg {
  color: var(--accent);
}
.canvas-toolbar .canvas-ai-action.is-ask:hover {
  background: var(--accent-border);
}
/* ── 11. 전문가 = 촘촘하게 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
body.editor-ui-expert .oprn-menu-bar.studio-bar {
  column-gap: 8px;
}
body.editor-ui-expert .studio-bar-lead {
  gap: 2px;
}
body.editor-ui-expert .studio-bar .oprn-menu-item,
body.editor-ui-expert .studio-tool-button {
  font-size: 12.5px;
  padding-left: 8px;
  padding-right: 8px;
}
body.editor-ui-expert .studio-bar .editor-topbar-trailing {
  gap: 4px;
}
/* ── 12. 좁은 뷰포트(1024~1279) — 폭은 줄이고 클릭 경로는 남긴다 ───────────────────────── */
@media (max-width: 1279px) {
  .studio-bar .editor-product-brand-text {
    display: none;
  }

  .studio-bar .editor-product-brand {
    margin-right: 0;
  }

  .studio-project-button .oprn-menu-item-label {
    max-width: 140px;
  }

  .studio-bar .studio-command-center {
    flex: 0 0 32px;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 32px;
    padding: 0;
    width: 32px;
  }

  .studio-command-center .workspace-command-chip-label,
  .studio-command-center .workspace-command-chip-key {
    display: none;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 1119px) {
  .studio-tool-button .studio-tool-button-label,
  .studio-bar .workspace-panels-label {
    display: none;
  }

  .studio-tool-button {
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 0;
    width: 32px;
  }

  .studio-bar .workspace-panels-button {
    padding: 0 6px;
  }
}
@layer editor {
  .village-info-modal-backdrop {
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .database-modal-window.village-info-window {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    width: min(1120px, calc(100vw - 72px));
    height: min(760px, calc(100vh - 72px));
  }

  .village-info-body {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 240px minmax(0, 1fr);
    min-height: 0;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: var(--editor-panel-bg);
    color: var(--editor-text);
  }

  .village-info-list {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 12px;
    overflow: auto;
    border-right: 1px solid var(--editor-line);
    background: var(--editor-toolbar-bg);
  }

  .village-info-row {
    min-height: 32px;
    padding: 7px 9px;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--editor-text-muted);
    text-align: left;
    font: 600 12px system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .village-info-row:hover,
  .village-info-row:focus-visible {
    border-color: var(--editor-line-strong);
    color: var(--editor-text);
    outline: none;
  }

  .village-info-row.active {
    border-color: var(--editor-blue);
    background: var(--editor-blue-soft);
    color: var(--editor-text);
  }

  .village-info-editor {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 0;
    padding: 12px;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .village-info-field-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(220px, 1fr) minmax(180px, 260px);
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .village-info-field-row label,
  .village-info-pane {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
    min-width: 0;
    color: var(--editor-text-muted);
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .village-info-title-input,
  .village-info-map-select,
  .village-info-markdown-input {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    border: 1px solid var(--editor-line-strong);
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: var(--editor-panel-bg-2);
    color: var(--editor-text);
    font: 13px system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  }

  .village-info-title-input,
  .village-info-map-select {
    height: 30px;
    padding: 0 8px;
  }

  .village-info-edit-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    grid-template-rows: minmax(320px, 2fr) minmax(180px, 1fr);
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 0;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .village-info-markdown-input,
  .village-info-preview {
    min-height: 0;
    height: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 10px;
    overflow: auto;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    resize: none;
    line-height: 1.5;
    white-space: pre-wrap;
    word-break: break-all;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    font: 12px "Cascadia Mono", "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace;
  }

  .village-info-preview {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    border: 1px solid var(--editor-line-strong);
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: var(--editor-canvas-bg);
    color: var(--editor-text);
  }

  .village-info-pane h3 {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--editor-text-muted);
    font-size: 12px;
  }

  .village-info-actions {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-end;
  }

  .village-info-status {
    min-width: 0;
    margin-right: auto;
    color: var(--editor-text-muted);
    font-size: 12px;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .village-info-empty {
    margin: 16px;
    color: var(--editor-text-muted);
  }
}
@layer editor {
  .world-panel-backdrop {
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .world-panel {
    container-type: inline-size;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: min(1180px, calc(100vw - 36px));
    height: min(760px, calc(100vh - 36px));
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--bg-surface);
    color: var(--text-1);
    box-shadow: 0 22px 64px rgba(42, 37, 33, 0.10);
  }

  .world-panel-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 16px;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
    background: var(--bg-surface);
  }

  .world-panel-title h2 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 18px;
    letter-spacing: 0;
  }

  .world-panel-controls {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .world-search-input,
  .world-add-type,
  .world-edit-input,
  .world-edit-body {
    border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: var(--bg-overlay);
    color: var(--text-1);
    font: inherit;
  }

  .world-search-input {
    width: min(320px, 34vw);
    padding: 7px 10px;
  }

  .world-add-type,
  .world-edit-input {
    min-height: 32px;
    padding: 6px 8px;
  }

  .world-panel-main {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 0.86fr);
    min-height: 0;
    flex: 1;
  }

  .world-browser,
  .world-wiki-view {
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: auto;
  }

  .world-browser {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 12px;
    border-right: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
    background: var(--bg-base);
  }

  .world-tabs {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .world-tab,
  .world-recent-chip,
  .world-relation-chip,
  .world-ref-chip {
    border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: var(--bg-surface);
    color: var(--text-2);
    font: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .world-tab {
    min-height: 32px;
    padding: 6px 10px;
  }

  .world-tab.active {
    border-color: var(--accent);
    background: var(--accent-muted);
    color: var(--success);
  }

  .world-overview {
    display: grid;

    padding: 10px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--bg-surface);
  }

  .world-counts {
    color: var(--text-2);
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .world-recent,
  .world-chip-row {

    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .world-recent-chip,
  .world-relation-chip,
  .world-ref-chip {

  }

  .world-card-grid {

  .world-card-grid.empty {

  .world-card {

    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--bg-raised);
    color: inherit;
    text-align: left;
    cursor: pointer;

  .world-card:hover,
  .world-card:focus-visible {
    border-color: var(--border-default);
    outline: none;
  }

  .world-card.active {

    background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-surface) 0%, var(--bg-raised) 100%);

  .world-card.active .world-card-title {

  .world-card-media {

  .world-card-map-thumb {

  }

  .world-card-map-canvas {

  }

  .world-card-sprite {

  }

  .world-card-placeholder {

    place-items: center;
    width: 56px;

    border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--bg-inset);
    color: var(--text-1);
    font-size: 24px;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .world-card-placeholder.faction {
    background: var(--bg-inset);
  }

  .world-card-placeholder.event {
    background: var(--bg-inset);
  }

  .world-card-placeholder.guideline {
    background: var(--bg-inset);
  }

  .world-lint-badge {
    position: absolute;

    right: 8px;
    padding: 3px 6px;

    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .world-lint-badge.error,
  .world-lint-item.error {
    background: var(--danger);
    color: var(--bg-overlay);
  }

  .world-lint-badge.warning,
  .world-lint-item.warning {

    color: var(--bg-overlay);

  .world-lint-badge.info,

    color: var(--text-2);

  .world-card-content {
    display: grid;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 10px;
  }

  .world-card-title-row,
  .world-wiki-header,
  .world-edit-row,
  .world-edit-add-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .world-card-title-row {
    justify-content: space-between;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .world-card-title {
    min-width: 0;
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    overflow: hidden;
    color: var(--text-1);
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .world-card-summary {
    min-height: 18px;
    margin: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    color: var(--text-3);
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.45;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .world-card.active .world-card-summary {
    color: var(--text-2);
  }

  .world-card-badges,
  .world-tags {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 5px;
  }

  .world-card.active .world-type-badge {
    border-color: var(--accent-muted);
    background: var(--success-muted);
    color: var(--success);
  }

  .world-type-badge,
  .world-origin-badge,
  .world-tag {
    max-width: 100%;
    padding: 3px 7px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--bg-raised);
    color: var(--text-2);
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.01em;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .world-origin-badge {
    color: var(--success);
  }

  .world-lock-button {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    min-width: 42px;
    min-height: 26px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: var(--bg-surface);
    color: var(--text-2);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 12px;
  }

  .world-lock-button.locked {
    border-color: rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.55);
    color: var(--danger);
    background: var(--bg-surface);
  }

  .world-wiki-view {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 14px;
    padding: 16px;
    background: var(--bg-surface);
  }

  .world-wiki-view.empty {
    color: var(--text-2);
  }

  .world-wiki-header {
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }

  .world-wiki-heading {
    display: grid;
    gap: 6px;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .world-wiki-heading h3 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 22px;
    letter-spacing: 0;
  }

  .world-wiki-heading p {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--text-2);
  }

  .world-wiki-actions {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .world-lint-list {
    display: grid;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 10px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--bg-overlay);
  }

  .world-lint-list.empty {
    color: var(--text-3);
  }

  .world-lint-list ul {
    display: grid;
    gap: 6px;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }

  .world-lint-item {
    padding: 6px 8px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }

  .world-markdown .md {
    display: grid;
    gap: 10px;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  .world-markdown .md :is(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, p, ul, ol, blockquote, pre) {
    margin: 0;
  }

  .world-markdown .md pre {
    overflow: auto;
    padding: 10px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: var(--bg-inset);
  }

  .world-relations,
  .world-ref-jumps,
  .world-edit-section {
    display: grid;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .world-relations.empty,
  .world-ref-jumps.empty,
  .world-muted {
    color: var(--text-3);
  }

  .world-edit-fields {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .world-edit-field {
    display: grid;
    gap: 5px;
    color: var(--text-2);
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  .world-edit-field.inline {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
  }

  .world-edit-field:has(.world-edit-body) {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }

  .world-edit-body {
    min-height: 180px;
    resize: vertical;
    padding: 8px;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .world-edit-section {
    padding-top: 10px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  }

  .world-edit-section h4 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 14px;
  }

  .world-edit-list {
    display: grid;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .world-edit-row {
    justify-content: space-between;
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 7px 8px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: var(--bg-surface);
  }

  .world-edit-row span {
    min-width: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .world-edit-add-row {
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .world-edit-add-row .world-edit-input {
    min-width: 140px;
    flex: 1 1 150px;
  }

  .world-edit-error {
    padding: 8px 10px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: var(--danger);
    color: var(--bg-overlay);
  }

  .world-panel-embedded {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    max-width: none;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 0;
    box-shadow: none;
    background: transparent;
  }

  .world-panel-header-embedded {
    padding-inline: 12px;
  }

  .db-world-canon-name,
  .db-world-canon-premise,
  .db-world-canon-body,
  .db-world-canon-absence-input {
    width: 100%;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--bg-overlay);
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
  }

  .db-world-canon-name {
    border-color: transparent;
    background: transparent;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 22px;
    line-height: 1.3;
    padding: 4px 2px;
  }

  .db-world-canon-name:hover,
  .db-world-canon-name:focus {
    border-color: var(--border-subtle);
    background: var(--bg-overlay);
    outline: none;
  }

  .db-world-canon-premise {
    min-height: 52px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    resize: vertical;
  }

  .db-world-canon-body {
    min-height: 280px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    resize: vertical;
    line-height: 1.55;
  }

  .db-world-canon-tones,
  .db-world-canon-absence-chips,
  .db-world-canon-absence-add {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
    align-items: center;
  }

  .db-world-canon-absence-add {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .db-world-canon-absence-input {
    flex: 1 1 12em;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 32px;
    padding: 6px 10px;
  }

  .db-world-canon-chip {
    min-height: 28px;
    padding: 0 10px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: transparent;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .db-world-canon-chip.is-on {
    border-color: var(--accent);
    background: var(--accent-muted);
    color: var(--success);
  }

  .db-world-canon-law {
    display: grid;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .db-world-canon-body-wrap {
    display: grid;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .db-world-canon-preview-toggle {
    justify-self: start;
  }

  .db-world-canon-preview {
    border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    background: var(--bg-overlay);
  }

  @media (max-width: 820px) {
    .world-panel:not(.world-panel-embedded) {
      width: 100vw;
      height: 100vh;
      border-radius: 0;
    }

    .world-panel-header,
    .world-panel-controls {
      align-items: stretch;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .world-search-input {
      width: 100%;
    }

    .world-panel-main {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .world-browser {
      border-right: 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
      max-height: 52vh;
    }

    .world-edit-fields {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
  }
}

.database-modal-backdrop .database-modal-window .database-modal-body .world-document-workspace .world-document-content .db-ws-card {

.cluster-ai-modal-backdrop {
  align-items: center;
  background: rgba(42, 37, 33, 0.18);
  display: flex;
  inset: 0;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: var(--space-4);
  position: fixed;
  z-index: var(--z-popover-high);
}
.cluster-ai-modal-window {
  background: var(--editor-panel-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--editor-line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-m);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop);
  color: var(--editor-text);
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  max-height: min(860px, calc(100dvh - 32px));
  max-width: min(1180px, calc(100vw - 32px));
  min-height: 620px;
  overflow: hidden;
  width: 100%;
}
.cluster-ai-header {
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--editor-toolbar-bg);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--editor-line);
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-3);
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4);
}
.cluster-ai-heading {
  min-width: 0;
}
.cluster-ai-heading h2 {
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.2;
  margin: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.cluster-ai-heading p {
  color: var(--editor-text-muted);
  font-size: 12px;
  margin: 3px 0 0;
}
.cluster-ai-modal-close,
.cluster-ai-send,
.cluster-ai-choice,
.cluster-ai-accept,
.cluster-ai-reject {
  background: var(--control-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--editor-line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  color: var(--editor-text);
  cursor: pointer;
  font: 700 12px/1 var(--font-ui);
  min-height: 30px;
  padding: 0 10px;
}
.cluster-ai-modal-close:hover,
.cluster-ai-send:hover:not(:disabled),
.cluster-ai-choice:hover,
.cluster-ai-accept:hover,
.cluster-ai-reject:hover {
  background: var(--control-bg-hover);
  border-color: var(--editor-line-strong);
}
.cluster-ai-body {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-3);
  grid-template-rows: minmax(260px, 1.05fr) minmax(240px, 0.95fr);
  min-height: 0;
  padding: var(--space-3);
}
.cluster-ai-stage {
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--editor-canvas-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--editor-line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  max-height: min(520px, 52vh);
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: auto;
  padding: var(--space-3);
}
.cluster-ai-stage-placeholder {
  align-items: center;
  border: 1px dashed var(--editor-line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  color: var(--editor-text-muted);
  display: flex;
  font-size: 13px;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 180px;
  padding: var(--space-4);
  text-align: center;
  width: min(520px, 100%);
}
.cluster-ai-stage-placeholder.loading {
  background: var(--editor-blue-soft);
  border-color: var(--editor-blue);
  color: var(--editor-text);
}
.cluster-ai-beforeafter,
.cluster-ai-image-grid {
  align-items: stretch;
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-3);
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  min-height: 0;
  width: 100%;
}
.cluster-ai-image-single {
  display: grid;
  height: 100%;
  place-items: center;
  width: 100%;
}
.cluster-ai-stage-card {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-2);
  grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  margin: 0;
  max-height: min(560px, 58vh);
  min-height: 0;
  min-width: 0;
  width: 100%;
}
.cluster-ai-image-single .cluster-ai-stage-card {
  height: 100%;
  max-width: 760px;
}
.cluster-ai-stage-card figcaption {
  color: var(--editor-text-muted);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-align: center;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.cluster-ai-stage-card img {
  background: var(--editor-panel-bg-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--editor-line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  height: 100%;
  image-rendering: pixelated;
  max-height: min(520px, 54vh);
  max-width: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
  object-fit: contain;
  width: 100%;
}
.cluster-ai-bottom {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-3);
  grid-template-columns: minmax(160px, 220px) minmax(0, 1fr);
  min-height: 240px;
}
.cluster-ai-preview,
.cluster-ai-chat {
  background: var(--editor-panel-bg-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--editor-line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  min-width: 0;
}
.cluster-ai-preview {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-2);
  grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  min-height: 0;
  padding: var(--space-3);
}
.cluster-ai-preview h3 {
  color: var(--editor-text-muted);
  font-size: 12px;
  margin: 0;
}
.cluster-ai-tile-grid {
  align-content: start;
  display: grid;
  gap: 4px;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, 44px);
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: auto;
}
.cluster-ai-tile {
  align-items: end;
  border: 1px solid var(--editor-line);
  display: flex;
  height: 44px;
  justify-content: end;
  image-rendering: pixelated;
  overflow: hidden;
  width: 44px;
}
.cluster-ai-tile span {
  background: rgba(42, 37, 33, 0.12);
  color: var(--on-accent);
  font: 700 10px/1 var(--font-mono);
  padding: 2px 3px;
}
.cluster-ai-empty {
  color: var(--editor-text-muted);
  font-size: 12px;
}
.cluster-ai-chat {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-2);
  grid-template-rows: auto minmax(96px, 1fr) auto auto auto;
  max-height: none;
  min-height: 200px;
  padding: var(--space-3);
}
.cluster-ai-status {
  color: var(--editor-text-muted);
  font-size: 11px;
}
.cluster-ai-log {
  align-content: start;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-1);
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: auto;
}
.cluster-ai-bubble {
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  max-width: 92%;
  padding: 7px 10px;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  word-break: break-word;
}
.cluster-ai-bubble.assistant {
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.cluster-ai-bubble.user {
  align-self: flex-end;
  background: var(--accent-muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-border);
}
.cluster-ai-bubble.assistant,
.cluster-ai-bubble.tool {
  align-self: flex-start;
  background: var(--control-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--editor-line);
}
.cluster-ai-bubble.tool {
  color: var(--editor-text-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
}
.cluster-ai-bubble.system {
  align-self: center;
  color: var(--editor-text-muted);
  font-size: 11px;
}
.cluster-ai-quick-replies,
.cluster-ai-proposal-actions,
.cluster-ai-input-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-2);
}
.cluster-ai-input-row {
  align-items: stretch;
}
.cluster-ai-quick-replies {
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.cluster-ai-proposal-host {
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: auto;
}
.cluster-ai-choice {
  background: var(--editor-blue-soft);
  border-color: var(--editor-blue);
  font-size: 13px;
  min-height: 38px;
  padding: 0 14px;
}
.cluster-ai-proposal {
  background: var(--bg-raised);
  border: 1px solid var(--editor-line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-1);
  padding: var(--space-2);
}
.cluster-ai-proposal.destructive {
  background: var(--danger-muted);
  border-color: var(--danger);
}
.cluster-ai-proposal-lines {
  color: var(--editor-text-muted);
  display: grid;
  font-size: 11px;
  gap: 2px;
  max-height: 96px;
  overflow: auto;
}
.cluster-ai-accept,
.cluster-ai-send {
  background: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent-border);
  color: var(--on-accent);
}
.cluster-ai-send {
  align-self: stretch;
  min-width: 84px;
}
.cluster-ai-reject:hover {
  background: var(--danger-muted);
  border-color: var(--danger);
  color: var(--danger);
}
.cluster-ai-input {
  background: var(--control-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--editor-line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  color: var(--editor-text);
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  font: 12px/1.45 var(--font-ui);
  min-height: 72px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  resize: vertical;
}
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .cluster-ai-modal-backdrop {
    padding: var(--space-2);
  }

  .cluster-ai-modal-window {
    min-height: calc(100dvh - 16px);
  }

  .cluster-ai-body {
    grid-template-rows: minmax(220px, 0.9fr) minmax(300px, 1.1fr);
  }

  .cluster-ai-bottom,
  .cluster-ai-beforeafter,
  .cluster-ai-image-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}
.map-history-panel {
  background: var(--editor-panel-bg-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--editor-line);
  border-radius: 6px;
  color: var(--editor-text);
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  margin: 0 0 var(--space-2);
  padding: var(--space-2);
}
.oprn-history-dropdown {
  min-width: 260px;
}
.oprn-history-dropdown .map-history-panel {
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
.map-history-panel > summary {
  align-items: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  gap: var(--space-1);
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
}
.map-history-panel > summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}
.map-history-actions {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-1);
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  margin-top: var(--space-2);
}
.map-history-button,
.map-history-revert {
  background: var(--control-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--editor-line);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--editor-text);
  cursor: pointer;
  font: inherit;
}
.map-history-button {
  min-height: 28px;
  padding: 0 var(--space-2);
}
.map-history-revert {
  align-self: start;
  color: var(--editor-blue);
  font-size: 11px;
  margin-top: var(--space-1);
  padding: 3px var(--space-2);
}
.map-history-button:hover:not(:disabled),
.map-history-revert:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: var(--control-bg-hover);
  border-color: var(--editor-line-strong);
}
.map-history-button:disabled,
.map-history-revert:disabled {
  color: var(--editor-text-soft);
  cursor: default;
  opacity: 0.58;
}
.map-history-list {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-2);
  list-style: none;
  margin: var(--space-2) 0 0;
  max-height: 180px;
  overflow: auto;
  padding: 0;
}
.map-history-item {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-2);
  grid-template-columns: 12px minmax(0, 1fr);
  position: relative;
}
.map-history-item::before {
  background: var(--editor-line);
  bottom: -10px;
  content: "";
  left: 5px;
  position: absolute;
  top: 14px;
  width: 1px;
}
.map-history-item:last-child::before {
  display: none;
}
.map-history-dot {
  color: var(--editor-text-soft);
  font-size: 10px;
  line-height: 18px;
  text-align: center;
}
.map-history-item.is-current .map-history-dot,
.map-history-item.is-current .map-history-current {
  color: var(--editor-blue);
}
.map-history-item.is-other-map {
  opacity: 0.62;
}
.map-history-content {
  min-width: 0;
}
.map-history-label-row {
  align-items: baseline;
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-1);
  justify-content: space-between;
  min-width: 0;
}
.map-history-label {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 650;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.map-history-current,
.map-history-map {
  color: var(--editor-text-muted);
  font-size: 11px;
}
.map-history-map {
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.map-history-empty {
  color: var(--editor-text-muted);
  font-size: 12px;
  padding: var(--space-2) 0;
}
/* ── 되돌리기 / 행위 기록 탭 ──────────────────────────────────────────
   같은 창 안에 두 자료를 나란히 둔다. 새 CSS 파일을 만들지 않는 이유는
   CSS 예산 게이트의 cssFileCount 래칫이 파일 수를 고정하기 때문이다. */
.map-history-tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-1);
  margin-top: var(--space-2);
}
.map-history-tab {
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--editor-text-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 11px;
  min-height: 24px;
  padding: 0 var(--space-2);
}
.map-history-tab:hover {
  background: var(--control-bg-hover);
}
.map-history-tab[aria-selected="true"] {
  background: var(--control-bg);
  border-color: var(--editor-line);
  color: var(--editor-text);
  font-weight: 700;
}
/* 접기용 `hidden` 은 author `display` 선언에 특이도로 밀린다(실측: 상점 처리 fold 가
   전체화면 `display:flex` (0,3,0) 에 밀려 접혀도 그대로 보였다). 아래 두 규칙이
   그 복구선이다 — `!important` 는 예산 게이트 지표라 특이도로만 이긴다. */
.map-history-panel .map-history-pane[hidden] {
  display: none;
}
.edit-activity .edit-activity-fields[hidden] {
  display: none;
}
/* ── 행위 기록 창 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.edit-activity {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-1);
  margin-top: var(--space-2);
}
.edit-activity-controls {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--space-1);
}
.edit-activity-scope,
.edit-activity-search {
  background: var(--control-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--editor-line);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--editor-text);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 11px;
  min-height: 24px;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 0 var(--space-1);
}
.edit-activity-search {
  flex: 1 1 96px;
}
.edit-activity-map-only {
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--editor-text-muted);
  display: flex;
  font-size: 11px;
  gap: 2px;
}
.edit-activity-toolbar {
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-1);
}
.edit-activity-summary {
  color: var(--editor-text-muted);
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  font-size: 11px;
}
.edit-activity-action {
  background: var(--control-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--editor-line);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--editor-text);
  cursor: pointer;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 11px;
  padding: 2px var(--space-2);
}
.edit-activity-action:hover {
  background: var(--control-bg-hover);
  border-color: var(--editor-line-strong);
}
/* `flex:1` 이 아니라 max-height 로 스크롤한다 — 이 창은 `<details>` 안에 들어가고,
   Chromium 의 `::details-content` 익명 블록이 안쪽 flex 아이템을 무력화한다. */
.edit-activity-list {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-1);
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  max-height: 220px;
  overflow: auto;
  padding: 0;
}
.edit-activity-item {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--editor-line);
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  padding-top: var(--space-1);
}
.edit-activity-item:first-child {
  border-top: 0;
  padding-top: 0;
}
.edit-activity-item.is-unlabeled .edit-activity-desc {
  color: var(--editor-text-soft);
  font-style: italic;
}
.edit-activity-head {
  align-items: baseline;
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-1);
  min-width: 0;
}
.edit-activity-time {
  color: var(--editor-text-soft);
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.edit-activity-desc {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  font-size: 11px;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.edit-activity-origin {
  border: 1px solid var(--editor-line);
  border-radius: 3px;
  color: var(--editor-text-muted);
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font-size: 10px;
  padding: 0 3px;
}
.edit-activity-origin[data-origin="ai"],
.edit-activity-origin[data-origin="tool"] {
  border-color: var(--editor-blue);
  color: var(--editor-blue);
}
.edit-activity-fields-toggle {
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  color: var(--editor-blue);
  cursor: pointer;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 10px;
  justify-self: start;
  padding: 0;
  text-align: left;
}
.edit-activity-fields {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  padding-left: var(--space-2);
}
.edit-activity-field {
  align-items: baseline;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  font-size: 10px;
  gap: 3px;
}
.edit-activity-field-path {
  color: var(--editor-text-muted);
  font-family: inherit;
  font-weight: 650;
}
.edit-activity-field-before {
  color: var(--editor-text-soft);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  text-decoration: line-through;
}
.edit-activity-field-after {
  color: var(--editor-text);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.edit-activity-empty {
  color: var(--editor-text-muted);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  padding: var(--space-2) 0;
}
/* Map settings: fixed navigation, a single reading column, and one scroller. */
.event-subdialog-window.wide:has(.map-props-dialog) {
  width: min(1000px, calc(100vw - 48px));
  height: min(820px, calc(100dvh - 48px));
  max-height: calc(100dvh - 48px);
}
.event-subdialog-window:has(.map-props-dialog) .event-subdialog-header {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  min-height: 76px;
  padding: 16px 24px;
  align-items: center;
}
.event-subdialog-window:has(.map-props-dialog) .event-subdialog-header h3 {
  font-size: 20px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.event-subdialog-window:has(.map-props-dialog) .event-subdialog-header p {
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin: 2px 0 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.event-subdialog-body:has(> .map-props-dialog) {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  min-height: 0;
}
.map-props-dialog {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 160px minmax(0, 1fr);
  grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: var(--text-1);
  background: var(--bg-panel);
}
.map-props-tabs {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 20px 12px;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  background: var(--bg-inset);
  overflow-y: auto;
}
.map-props-tab {
  padding: 10px 12px;
  min-height: 42px;
  text-align: left;
  font: 500 14px/1.5 var(--font-ui);
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-2);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.map-props-tab:hover {
  background: var(--bg-hover);
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.map-props-tab[aria-current="location"] {
  background: var(--accent-soft);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--text-1);
  font-weight: 700;
}
.map-props-dialog :is(button, input, select, textarea, summary):focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}
.map-props-body.is-single-view {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 24px;
  padding: 20px 24px 32px;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow-y: auto;
  scrollbar-gutter: stable;
}
.map-props-section-block {
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 20px;
  background: var(--bg-raised);
  display: flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
  min-width: 0;
  scroll-margin-top: 20px;
}
.map-props-section-block:last-child {
  min-height: 100%;
}
.map-props-section-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--text-1);
}
.map-props-section-title + .map-props-hint {
  margin-top: -10px;
}
.map-props-save-hint {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 12px 24px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--text-2);
}
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .map-props-dialog { grid-template-columns: 130px minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .map-props-body.is-single-view { padding: 12px; }
  .map-props-section-block { padding: 14px; }
  .map-props-tabs { padding: 12px 6px; }
}
.map-props-section {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
}
.map-props-field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}
.map-props-dialog .field > label,
.map-props-field-label {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-secondary, #6B5F52);
}
.map-props-dialog input[type="text"],
.map-props-dialog input[type="number"],
.map-props-dialog select {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 38px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  font-size: 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color, rgba(42, 37, 33, 0.12));
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: var(--input-bg, #FFFFFF);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}
.map-props-size-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.map-props-dialog .map-props-size-row input[type="number"] {
  width: 72px;
}
.map-props-size-row span {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--text-secondary, #6B5F52);
}
.map-props-dialog .map-props-check-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 0;
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 38px;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.map-props-dialog input[type="checkbox"] {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  min-height: 18px;
  flex: 0 0 18px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  accent-color: var(--accent, #4A57D6);
}
.map-props-hint {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--text-2);
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin: 0;
}
.map-json-field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}
.map-json-field textarea {
  width: 100%;
  font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace);
  font-size: 13px;
  padding: 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color, rgba(42, 37, 33, 0.12));
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: var(--input-bg, #FFFFFF);
  color: var(--text-primary);
